text_es: Maintaining a bicycle in good condition is crucial for ensuring its proper functioning and extending its lifespan. A basic maintenance routine will focus on regularly cleaning the frame and drivetrain, removing dirt here and grease there, to prevent premature wear of parts and ensure smooth and efficient pedaling. We must periodically check tire pressure, as well as the condition of the brakes and cables, making adjustments and lubrication as needed, which brings us safety and comfort on every ride. Furthermore, the tightness of screws and nuts, and the proper functioning of the derailleur and gears, are all things we need to confirm, because neglecting these aspects can lead to expensive repair costs and dangerous situations. Oiling the chain and all pivot points is fundamental for reducing friction and noise, and always ensuring optimal performance. Considering taking the bicycle to a professional shop for one to two more in-depth inspections annually is also a recommended practice, especially when we use it frequently or notice unusual sounds and malfunctions.
text_tgt_raw: 維持腳踏車的良好狀態，對於確保其正常運作並延長使用壽命來說，至關重要。一套基本的保養程序，會著重於定期清潔車架與傳動系統，移除這裡的髒污和那裡的油漬，以預防零件過早磨損，並確保踩踏時的順暢與高效。我們必須週期性地檢查輪胎胎壓，以及煞車和纜線的狀況，根據需要進行調整與潤滑，這為我們每次騎乘帶來安全與舒適。此外，螺絲和螺帽的鬆緊度、變速器與齒輪的正常運作，也都是我們需要確認的，因為忽視這些環節可能導致昂貴的維修費用和危險的情況。為鏈條和各個轉軸點上油，是減少摩擦和噪音，並隨時確保最佳性能的基礎。考量到每年將腳踏車送往專業車行進行一到兩次的更深入檢查，也是一項推薦的做法，特別是當我們頻繁使用，或注意到異常的聲音及故障時。
base_en: Maintaining a bicycle is essential to ensure its proper functioning and prolong its useful life. A basic maintenance routine includes regular cleaning of the frame and drivetrain, removing dirt and grease to prevent premature wear of components and ensure smooth and efficient pedaling. It's crucial to periodically check tire pressure and the condition of the brakes and cables, adjusting, and lubricating as needed for our safety and comfort on every ride. Additionally, we must check the tightness of screws and nuts, as well as the correct functioning of the gears and derailleurs, since neglecting these elements can lead to costly repairs and dangerous situations. Lubricating the chain and pivot points is fundamental to reduce friction and noise, and ensure optimal performance at all times. Considering taking the bicycle to a professional workshop for more thorough inspections 1 or 2 times a year is also a recommended practice, especially if we use it intensively or notice unusual noises and failures.

text_es: I still clearly remember my first bicycle, a BH mountain bike, which was a gift from my parents and grandparents for my tenth birthday. To keep it in good condition, I would regularly perform a series of cleaning and adjustments, a process that taught me a lot about mechanical principles and patience. Every two or three months, I would meticulously clean the chain and gears, using solvent and brushes to remove the dirt and grime stuck to them; although this task was time-consuming and laborious, it always brought me immense satisfaction. I would oil the bearings and derailleur, check the tire pressure, and ensure the brakes and cables were properly tensioned, making sure all parts operated perfectly. These regular inspections not only extended the bicycle's lifespan but also brought me countless hours of joy and freedom. For me, it wasn't just a means of transportation or recreation; it was also a symbol of my respect and emotional attachment to it.
text_tgt_raw: 我至今仍清楚記得人生第一台腳踏車，那是一輛BH登山車，是我十歲生日時，父母和祖父母合送的禮物。為了讓它保持良好狀態，我會定期進行一連串清潔與調整，這個過程讓我學到許多機械原理和耐心。每隔兩、三個月，我就會專心清潔鏈條和齒輪，用溶劑和刷子去除附著在上面的泥土與髒污，這項工作雖然耗時費力，卻總讓我感到無比滿足。我會替軸承和變速器上油，檢查胎壓以及煞車和纜線的鬆緊，確保所有零件都能完美運作。這些定期的檢查不僅延長了腳踏車的使用壽命，也為我帶來無數歡樂與自由的時光。對我而言，那不只是一台交通工具或休閒娛樂，更是我對它的尊重與情感的寄託。
base_en: I remember my 1st bicycle, a BH mountain bike that my parents and grandparents gave me for my 10th birthday. Keeping it in good condition was quite a ritual of cleaning and adjustments, a process that taught me a lot about mechanics and patience. Every 2 or 3 months, I would dedicate myself to cleaning the chain and sprockets, using solvent and brushes to remove dirt and mud, a task that required time and effort, but that always left me satisfied. I would grease the bearings and gears, check the tire pressure and the tension of the brakes and cables, making sure everything worked perfectly. Those periodic check-ups not only extended the bicycle's useful life, but also provided me with countless hours of fun and freedom. It was a matter of respect and affection for my means of transportation and leisure.

text_es: To keep your bicycle in optimal condition, cleaning and adjustment are essential. After every ride, especially when riding in the rain or on muddy and dusty roads, be sure to use a brush and degreaser to clean the chain and gears, then lubricate them well to prevent wear and rust. Before each ride, don't forget to check your tire pressure and confirm the condition of your brakes and gears, adjusting them immediately if necessary; all of this is for your safety and riding comfort. A small reminder here is that preventive maintenance and paying attention to any unusual sounds or looseness will save you a lot of repair costs and time in the future. Spending ten to fifteen minutes each week on this maintenance and inspection will ensure that you can enjoy countless worry-free miles on your future rides and make your bicycle's parts and frame more durable. Please remember that good maintenance will bring you peace of mind and enjoyment every time you ride.
text_tgt_raw: 為了讓您的自行車保持在最佳狀態，清潔與調整是不可或缺的。每次騎乘過後，尤其是在下雨或經過泥濘與灰塵的道路時，請務必使用刷子和去油劑清潔鏈條和齒輪，接著好好上油潤滑，以預防磨損與鏽蝕。每次騎乘前，也別忘了檢查胎壓，並確認煞車和變速的狀況，如有必要請立即調整，這都是為了您的安全與騎乘舒適度著想。這裡的小提醒是，預防性保養以及留意任何不尋常的聲響或鬆動，將能為您省下未來大筆的維修費用與時間。每週花上十到十五分鐘進行這些保養與檢查，就能確保您在往後的騎乘中，能享受數不盡的無憂里程，並且讓自行車的零件和車架更加耐用。請記住，良好的維護將為您帶來每次騎乘的安心與樂趣。
base_en: To keep a bicycle in optimal condition, cleaning, and adjustment are key. After each ride, especially if it has rained or you've ridden through mud and dust, clean the chain and sprockets with a brush and degreaser, then lubricate them well to prevent wear and corrosion. Check the tire pressure before each use, and check the condition of the brakes and gear shifts, adjusting them if necessary for your safety and comfort. Preventive maintenance and attention to small noises and play will save you time and money on major repairs. Dedicating 10 or 15 minutes weekly to these care and inspection tasks will guarantee you many miles of problem-free pedaling and greater durability of its components and frame. Remember that good maintenance will give you peace of mind and enjoyment on every route.

text_es: Organizing a farmers market requires a lot of planning and effort, but it brings significant economic and social benefits to the local area. First, we need to find a suitable location and obtain municipal permits, considering convenient transportation and sufficient space. Next, we contact local farmers and artisans to ensure the market offers a wide variety of high-quality fresh produce. To attract customers and curious onlookers, promotion and marketing are crucial, which can be done through social media and local media. Then, logistics and infrastructure, such as stall layout and waste disposal, must also be carefully arranged to ensure the market operates smoothly. In addition, clear pricing policies and hygiene standards are indispensable, as these can satisfy both vendors and customers. A successful market can promote community development, encourage everyone to buy seasonal products, and contribute to the circular economy; sometimes, it's even easy to get there by bus or taxi to experience the lively atmosphere, see the smiles on everyone's faces, and enjoy all sorts of agricultural products and handicrafts.
text_tgt_raw: 舉辦農夫市集需要投入大量規劃與精力，然而它為地方帶來顯著的經濟和社會效益。首先，我們得尋找合適的地點並取得市政許可，考量便利的交通與足夠的空間。接著，聯繫當地的農民與手作者，確保市集裡能有種類豐富且品質優良的新鮮農產品。為了吸引顧客與好奇的民眾，宣傳和行銷至關重要，可透過社群網路與地方媒體來推廣。再來，攤位配置、廢棄物處理等物流與基礎建設也得仔細安排，才能確保市集運作順暢。此外，明確的定價政策與衛生標準亦不可少，這能讓攤商與顧客都感到滿意。一個成功的市集能促進社區發展，鼓勵大家選購當季商品，並為循環經濟盡一份心力，有時甚至搭公車或計程車也能輕鬆抵達，體驗那裡的熱鬧氛圍，看著大家臉上的笑容，還有各式各樣的農產品與手工藝品。
base_en: Organizing a farmers market requires considerable planning and effort, but it offers significant economic and social benefits. The 1st step involves securing a suitable location and municipal permits, considering accessibility and available space. It's crucial to contact local farmers and artisans to ensure a variety and quality of fresh products. Promotion and marketing are fundamental to attract customers and curious onlookers, utilizing social media and local media. Logistics and infrastructure, such as stall arrangement and waste management, must be considered for efficient operation. Additionally, a clear pricing policy and hygiene standards must be established, ensuring the satisfaction of vendors and buyers. A successful market fosters community and local development, promoting the consumption of seasonal products and the circular economy.

text_es: Organizing the farmers market was a real challenge, but it also brought unexpected joy, and this experience gave me a deep appreciation for community collaboration and teamwork. I still remember those first few days, facing mountains of documents, we had to run around looking for suitable venues and applying for permits. There were many details to pay attention to, and we were also busy contacting local producers of fruits, vegetables, meats, dairy, cheeses, honey, and bread, ensuring that every product met quality and hygiene standards. Surprisingly, the response from farmers and neighbors was very enthusiastic; everyone contributed ideas and helped us solve many small problems. On opening day, the square was bustling with people, full of life and color, with people coming and going with their shopping baskets; it was truly an unprecedented spectacle. At that moment, I felt both proud and exhausted, but everyone's energy and enthusiasm made all the effort and time feel especially worthwhile.
text_tgt_raw: 籌辦農夫市集真是個挑戰，卻也帶來了意想不到的喜悅，這段經歷讓我對社群合作與團隊精神有了深刻的體認。我還記得剛開始那幾天，面對著堆積如山的文件，我們得四處奔走尋找合適的場地並申請許可。那裡有許多細節需要注意，我們也忙著聯繫本地的蔬果、肉品、蛋奶、起司、蜂蜜和麵包等生產者，確保每項產品都符合品質與衛生標準。令人驚訝的是，農民和鄰里們的反應非常熱烈，大家紛紛貢獻想法，為我們解決了許多小問題。開幕當天，廣場上人潮熙攘，充滿了生機與色彩，人們提著菜籃來來往往，真是盛況空前。那時我感到既驕傲又疲憊，但所有人的活力與熱情，都讓這一切的付出與時間顯得格外值得。
base_en: Organizing a farmers market was a challenge and an unexpected joy, an experience that taught me a lot about community and teamwork. I remember the 1st days, with mountains of paperwork and the search for locations and permits. We had to contact local producers of fruits and vegetables, meat, and eggs, milk, and cheeses, and honey and bread, making sure that everyone met the quality and hygiene standards. The response from the farmers and neighbors was incredible, contributing ideas and solutions for every small problem. The 1st day was a resounding success; the square filled with life and color, with people and baskets coming and going. I felt proud and exhausted, but everyone's energy and enthusiasm made the effort and time worthwhile.

text_es: To successfully host a farmer's market, the first step is to thoroughly research local regulations and required permits to ensure legal operation. Next, establishing good communication and relationships with farmers and vendors is extremely important, providing fair space and treatment. At the same time, we need to carefully consider the ideal market location and necessary infrastructure, taking into account transportation convenience, visibility, and basic services and comfort for visitors and vendors. Marketing and promotion are also indispensable, making good use of social media and local media to attract public attention and interest. The market should offer a wide variety of fresh, high-quality agricultural products, from fruits and vegetables, meats, and dairy products to handicrafts and baked goods, to satisfy all customers' preferences and needs. Food safety and environmental hygiene are even more critical; it is essential to comply with all relevant regulations to provide a clean and safe venue for everyone. Finally, we should persevere and remain flexible, learning from every experience and continuously improving, in order for the market to operate sustainably.
text_tgt_raw: 要成功舉辦農夫市集，第一步是詳盡研究當地的法規與所需許可證，以確保合法營運。接著，與農民和攤商建立良好溝通和關係極為重要，提供公平的空間與待遇。同時，我們需要仔細思考理想的市集地點及必要基礎設施，考慮交通便利性、能見度，還有為遊客和商家準備的基本服務與舒適度。行銷推廣也是不可或缺的一環，善用社群網路和當地媒體來吸引大眾的目光與興趣。市集裡應提供各式各樣新鮮優質的農產品，從蔬果、肉品、乳製品到手工藝品和麵包，以滿足所有顧客的喜好與需求。食品安全與環境衛生更是重中之重，務必遵守所有相關規定，為大家提供一個乾淨安全的場所。最後，我們應該堅持不懈並保持彈性，從每次經驗中學習，不斷精進，才能讓市集永續經營下去。
base_en: To organize a successful farmers market, the 1st step is to thoroughly research local regulations and necessary permits, ensuring legality and smooth operation. It's crucial to establish good communication and relationships with local farmers and vendors, offering a fair space and treatment for everyone. Think about the ideal location and necessary infrastructure, considering access and visibility, as well as basic services and comfort for visitors and merchants. Promotion and marketing are essential; utilize social media and local media to attract public attention and interest. Offer a variety of fresh, quality products, including fruits and vegetables, meat, and dairy, crafts, and bread, to satisfy the tastes and needs of all customers. Safety and hygiene must be priorities; make sure to comply with all regulations and offer a clean and safe environment for everyone. Finally, be persistent and adaptable, learn from each experience, and continuously improve.

text_es: Learning to knit a scarf is a rewarding and relaxing activity that requires patience and continuous practice. To start, you only need a few materials: knitting needles and yarn of suitable texture and thickness. Online, many software programs offer instructional videos and pattern guides, providing clear and detailed step-by-step instructions for beginners and experts alike. Basic stitches, such as knit and purl, are the foundation for most knitted items, allowing you to create a wide variety of designs and styles. With time and effort, anyone can master these techniques and enjoy this endlessly creative artistic process. Knitting a scarf not only adds a practical accessory for yourself but also brings a sense of accomplishment and joy. This is a hobby that combines skill and creativity, perfect for quiet afternoons and leisure time.
text_tgt_raw: 學習編織圍巾是一項既有益又令人放鬆的活動，其中需要耐心與不斷練習。一開始，您只需準備幾樣材料：織針以及質地和粗細適中的毛線。在網路上，有著許多軟體提供教學影片和圖案指引，為初學者和專家們提供了清晰且詳盡的步驟說明。例如棒針和反針這類基本針法，是大多數編織作品的基礎，讓您可以創作各式各樣的設計和風格。只要投入時間和心力，任何人都能掌握這些技巧，並享受這創意無限的藝術過程。編織圍巾不僅能為自己添增一條實用的配件，更能帶來成就感和愉悅的心情。這是一項結合了技巧與創造力的嗜好，非常適合在寧靜的午後和閒暇時光裡進行。
base_en: Learning to knit a scarf is a rewarding and relaxing activity, which requires patience and practice. Initially, few materials are needed: needles and yarn of good thickness and texture. There are numerous online tutorials and printed patterns that offer clear and detailed guides for beginners and experts. Basic stitches, such as the knit stitch and the purl stitch, are the foundations and pillars of most knitting projects, allowing for the creation of a wide variety of designs and styles. With dedication and time, anyone can master these techniques and enjoy the creative and artistic process. Knitting a scarf not only provides a personal and useful accessory, but also a sense of accomplishment and well-being. It's a hobby that combines skill and creativity, ideal for quiet afternoons and leisure moments.

text_es: My knitting adventure began three months ago on a cold winter day. For me, yarn and knitting needles had always been a mystery, feeling like an art my hands and patience couldn't quite grasp. However, I decided it was time to learn how to knit a scarf, a simple yet rewarding project that would bring me warmth and pride. I started with two size six knitting needles and a ball of soft, sky-blue merino wool, a color I loved then and still love now. At first, the stitches kept slipping off, and my frustration and discouragement were obvious, but with my grandmother's help and encouragement, I kept trying. Gradually, I mastered the knit and purl stitches, and the scarf began to take on stripes and texture, slowly taking shape. Now, every time I wear it, I remember the tension and satisfaction that first project brought, an experience that made me deeply appreciate the importance of perseverance and dedication.
text_tgt_raw: 我的編織奇遇始於三個月前那個寒冷的冬日。對我而言，毛線與棒針向來是個謎，感覺那是一門我的雙手與耐性難以企及的藝術。然而，我決定是時候學習編織圍巾了，這是一個簡單又充滿成就感的計畫，能為我帶來溫暖與自豪。我從兩根六號棒針和一團柔軟、天藍色的美麗諾羊毛開始，那顏色我當時愛著，現在也依然喜愛。起初，針目總是不斷滑脫，我的挫折與沮喪溢於言表，但在我祖母的幫助和鼓勵下，我持續嘗試著。漸漸地，我掌握了上下針的技巧，圍巾也開始有了條紋和紋理，逐漸成形。如今，每當我圍上它，都會想起那第一個作品帶來的緊張與滿足感，那段經歷讓我深刻體會到堅持不懈與投入的重要性。
base_en: My knitting adventure began 3 months ago, on a cold, gray winter. Yarns and needles had always seemed like a mystery to me, an art that seemed unattainable for my hands and my patience. I decided it was time to learn to knit a scarf, a simple and rewarding project that would give me warmth and pride. I started with 2 size 6 needles and a ball of merino wool, soft, and in a sky blue color that I loved and still love. At 1st, the stitches slipped away from me, and my frustration and discouragement were palpable, but I kept trying thanks to my grandmother's help and encouragement. Little by little, I mastered the knit and purl stitches, and the scarf began to take shape, with its stripes and texture. Now, every time I put it on, I remember the nerves and satisfaction of that 1st project, an experience that taught me the importance of perseverance and dedication.

text_es: If you want to enter the fascinating world of knitting and knit a scarf with your own hands, patience and practice are the keys to success. First, start by choosing knitting needles and yarn of appropriate thickness and color; soft and easy-to-handle materials can greatly reduce frustration when you are first learning. Next, learn basic stitches, such as knit and purl; there are many tutorial videos and software online that clearly demonstrate each step. It's okay if your hand movements aren't skilled enough at first, and the density and evenness of your knitting might not be perfect; proficiency is gradually accumulated through time and effort. Choosing a simple, repetitive pattern can effectively help you build confidence. In addition, consider joining knitting clubs or forums, where you can get support and advice from other enthusiasts, adding motivation to your learning journey. Please remember, enjoying the knitting process is the most important thing.
text_tgt_raw: 想要踏入迷人的編織世界，親手織出一條圍巾，耐心與練習是成功的關鍵。首先，從選擇合適粗細與顏色的棒針及毛線開始，柔軟且易於操作的材質能大大減輕初學時的挫折感。接著，學習基本的針法，例如下針與上針，網路裡有著許多教學影片與軟體能清楚地演示每一個步驟。一開始手勢不夠熟練，織出來的密度和均勻度可能不夠完美，這都沒關係；熟練度是經由時間與努力慢慢累積起來的。選擇一個簡單重複的圖案，能有效幫助您建立信心。此外，考慮加入編織社團或論壇，在那裡您可以得到其他同好者的支持與建議，為您的學習之路增添動力。請記住，享受編織的過程才是最重要的。
base_en: To get started in the exciting world of knitting and make a scarf, patience, and practice are key. 1st, choose needles and yarn of appropriate thickness and color—a soft and manageable material will facilitate learning and prevent frustration. Start with basic stitches, such as the knit stitch and the purl stitch; there are many tutorials and videos that explain each step and detail visually. Don't worry if at 1st the tension and uniformity aren't perfect; skill and dexterity are acquired with time and effort. A simple and repetitive pattern will help you gain confidence and fluidity. In addition, consider joining knitting groups or forums; the support and advice from other enthusiasts can be very helpful and motivating. Remember, the main goal is to enjoy the process and creation.

text_es: Moving is a big project, involving many tasks that require careful planning and organization. To ensure a smooth move, we should start preparing early by sorting and discarding items no longer needed in the home; this will not only save time but also reduce costs. Next, don't forget to prepare suitable boxes, packing materials, tools, and tape to secure and protect your belongings. For easier transport and unpacking later, each box should be clearly labeled with its contents and the room it belongs to, which will prevent chaos and stress during unloading. At the same time, coordinating transportation and the moving date is also very important; whether hiring a professional moving company or asking friends and family for help, arrangements must be made in advance. Remember, administrative procedures and changing your mailing address must not be overlooked to ensure important documents and online bills are delivered successfully. Good preparation can significantly reduce unexpected situations and physical exertion during the moving process, making the entire process more efficient and easier.
text_tgt_raw: 搬家是件大工程，裡頭牽涉著許多需要細心規劃與組織的任務。為求順利，我們應當提早著手準備，先將家裡不再需要的物品分類並捨棄，這不僅能省下時間，也能節省費用。接著，別忘了準備合適的紙箱、包裝材料、工具和膠帶，用來固定和保護物品。為了搬運和日後的歸位方便，每個箱子都應該清楚標示裡頭的內容物和所屬房間，這樣才能避免卸貨時的混亂和壓力。同時，協調交通與搬家日期也十分重要，無論是聘請專業搬家公司，抑或是請親友幫忙，都需事先安排妥當。切記，行政手續和通訊地址變更也萬萬不可忽略，這才能確保重要文件和網路帳單能順利寄達。良好的準備能大幅減少搬家過程中的突發狀況與體力消耗，讓整個過程更有效率，也更加輕鬆。
base_en: Preparing for a move involves a series of tasks and responsibilities that require organization and planning. It's essential to start with enough time in advance to classify objects and belongings, discarding everything that's no longer needed, which can save time and money. Appropriate boxes and packing materials should be acquired, as well as tools and tape to secure the packages. It's important to label each box with its contents and destination room, facilitating unloading and subsequent placement, thus avoiding stress and confusion. Coordinating transportation and the moving date is crucial, whether hiring a specialized company or relying on the help of friends and family. Don't forget the administrative procedures and the change of postal address, which ensure the reception of correspondence and important documents. Good preparation reduces unforeseen events and physical effort, making the process more efficient and less exhausting.

text_es: Every time I prepare to move, my heart is always filled with mixed emotions and memories. It's a mentally taxing process that requires patience and organization, but it also brings opportunities for new beginnings and experiences. My last move was particularly complicated; I had accumulated many books and trinkets, which resulted in dozens of boxes of items of all sizes to sort through. I spent three full days packing dishes, cups, clothes, shoes, and various personal belongings. The kitchen was an even bigger challenge, as the various kitchen utensils and appliances took up more space than expected. After all that effort, moving day finally arrived. With the help of family and a few friends, watching my belongings and furniture leave the old house and then settle into the new one truly brought me immense relief and satisfaction. Now, all that's left is to unpack everything and put it in its place, and then I can start enjoying this new home and new environment.
text_tgt_raw: 每次準備搬家，心裡總是五味雜陳，充滿回憶。這是一個耗費心力、需要耐心和整理的過程，但同時也為新的開始和體驗帶來機會。上一次搬家尤其複雜，我累積了許多書和小飾品，結果就是幾十箱大大小小的東西要整理。我花了整整三天時間，把碗盤、杯子、衣物、鞋子以及各種個人物品打包。廚房那裡更是個挑戰，各式廚具和電器佔用的空間比預期的還多。經過這麼多的努力，搬家日總算到了，有家人和幾個朋友幫忙，看著自己的物品和家具離開舊家，然後在新家裡安頓下來，真的讓我感到無比的輕鬆與滿足。現在只剩下把所有東西拆箱歸位，就能開始享受這裡的新家和新環境了。
base_en: Preparing for a move always generates a mix of emotions and memories for me. It's an exhausting process that requires organization and patience, but also an opportunity for a new beginning and new experiences. The last move was especially complicated; I had accumulated many books and trinkets, resulting in dozens of boxes and bundles to sort. I spent 3 entire days packing plates and glasses, clothes, and shoes, and all kinds of personal items. The kitchen, in particular, was a challenge: utensils and appliances took up more space than expected. After so much work and effort, moving day arrived, with the help of my family and some friends. Seeing my belongings and furniture leave the old house and arrive at the new one brought me immense relief and satisfaction. Now all that's left is to unpack everything and start enjoying my new home and neighborhood.

text_es: To ensure a smooth and stress-free moving process, early planning and proper organization are your best helpers. It's recommended that you start preparing two to three months before your move and create a detailed task list and schedule. First, carefully categorize your belongings, deciding what to keep, donate, or discard. This will effectively reduce the volume of items to move and the subsequent unpacking work. Next, find suitable boxes and packing materials, especially for valuable and fragile items, which need extra protection. Remember to label the contents of each box and the room where it will go, as this will make unpacking much easier in your new home. You can choose a reputable moving company or seek help from friends and family. Don't forget to also handle address changes and the transfer of services like electricity and internet. Finally, prepare an emergency kit for the first few days in your new home, containing important documents and daily necessities. This way, you can easily enjoy this transition and experience of a new life.
text_tgt_raw: 為了確保搬家過程順利且壓力最小化，提早規劃與妥善整理是您的最佳幫手。建議您在搬家前兩到三個月就開始著手準備，並建立一份詳細的任務清單與時程安排。首先，請仔細分類您的物品，決定哪些要保留、捐贈或丟棄，這樣能有效減少搬運量與後續的整理工作。接著，尋找合適的紙箱與包裝材料，特別是那些珍貴易碎的物品，更需要妥善保護。每個箱子外面記得標示裡面的內容物與將來要放置的房間，這樣在新家那裡開箱時會方便許多。您可以選擇信譽良好的搬家公司，或尋求親友的協助。別忘了，還要處理地址變更以及電力、網路等服務的轉移。最後，為剛搬進新家的前幾天準備一個應急包，裡面放著重要的文件與生活必需品，如此一來，您就能輕鬆享受這次新生活的轉變與體驗了。
base_en: To prepare for a stress-free and successful move, planning, and organization are your best allies. Start early, 2, or 3 months in advance, and create a detailed list of tasks and deadlines. Sort your belongings and decide what to keep, donate, or throw away; this reduces volume and work. Look for appropriate boxes and packing materials to protect your most fragile and valuable items. Label each box with its contents and destination room to facilitate unpacking and subsequent placement. Hire a reputable moving company with good references or ask friends and family for help. Don't forget to change your mailing address and services like electricity and water. Finally, prepare a survival kit with essential items and important documents for the 1st days in your new home and enjoy the change and new experiences.

text_es: Caring for a vegetable garden in the city truly requires time and knowledge to achieve abundant and healthy crops. Choosing a location that is sunny and protected from strong winds and frost is crucial, as this greatly impacts plant growth and development. Next is soil preparation; fertilizer should be applied and organic matter mixed in to improve soil fertility and structure. The selection of seeds and seedlings is also quite critical; we should choose varieties suitable for the local climate and that match our cooking habits and tastes. Consistent and appropriate watering, along with eco-friendly pest and disease control, will ensure the garden's vitality and productivity. Timely pruning and support are also important for the growth and support of certain crops, in order to obtain high-quality fruits and vegetables. Finally, patience and daily observation are indispensable virtues and tools for us to enjoy the pleasure of gardening at home and harvest fruitful results.
text_tgt_raw: 照護都市裡的菜園，著實需要投入時間與知識，才能獲得豐收且健康的作物。選擇一個陽光充足、又能避開強風與霜害的地點至關重要，這對植物的生長與發育影響甚大。再來是土壤的準備工作，應施用肥料並混入有機質，以改良土壤肥力與結構。種子與幼苗的選擇也相當關鍵，我們應挑選適合當地氣候，並符合我們烹飪習慣與口味的品種。持續且適量的澆水，加上生態友善的病蟲害防治，將能確保菜園的活力與生產力。適時的修剪與支撐，對於某些作物的生長與支持亦為重要，以期獲得優質的果實與蔬菜。最後，耐心與每日的觀察，是我們在家裡享受種植樂趣，並收穫豐碩成果不可或缺的美德與工具。
base_en: Caring for an urban garden involves dedication and knowledge to achieve a good harvest and healthy plants. It's essential to choose a good location with adequate sun exposure and protection against wind and frost, key factors for growth and development. Soil preparation is fundamental, incorporating fertilizer and organic matter to improve its fertility and structure. The choice of seeds and seedlings is crucial, opting for varieties adapted to the local climate and to our culinary needs and tastes. Constant and adequate watering, along with ecological pest and disease control, will ensure the viability and productivity of our garden. Pruning and staking are important tasks for the development and support of certain plants, guaranteeing quality fruits and vegetables. Finally, patience, and daily observation are essential virtues and tools to fully enjoy the benefits and rewards of growing food at home.

text_es: Two years ago, filled with passion and longing, I embarked on my urban gardening adventure, despite my limited knowledge of gardening at the time and my fear of making mistakes. I clearly remember the first time I sowed seeds and watched tiny leaves and stems emerge from the soil; that feeling of wonder and joy is unforgettable to this day. Every day, I dedicated time and effort to watering and weeding my tomatoes and lettuce, and carefully observing their growth. During this process, although I faced challenges like pests and diseases, seeing the fruits and vegetables on my balcony gradually mature brought an unparalleled sense of accomplishment. Now, this has become my small oasis for growing basil and chili peppers, and the aroma and flavor of the crops I planted myself are incomparable. This activity has not only connected me closely with nature but has also brought me a sense of peace and tranquility in my busy urban life.
text_tgt_raw: 兩年前，我懷著滿腔熱情與渴望，開啟了我的都市園藝冒險，儘管當時對園藝知識仍相當匱乏，也深怕會犯錯。我清楚記得第一次播下種子，看著小小的葉片與莖幹從土壤裡冒出來，那種驚奇與喜悅交織的感覺至今難忘。每天，我都會投入時間與精力，為我的番茄和萵苣澆水、除草，並仔細觀察它們的成長。這段過程中，雖然也曾面臨病蟲害等挑戰，但看到陽台上的蔬果逐漸成熟，那份成就感真是無與倫比。現在，這裡已成為我種植羅勒和辣椒的小小綠洲，我親手栽種的作物，其香氣與風味更是無可比擬。這項活動不僅讓我與大自然緊密連結著，更在繁忙的都市生活中，為我帶來了一片寧靜與祥和。
base_en: My adventure taking care of an urban garden started 2 years ago with great enthusiasm and desire, although also with a certain lack of knowledge and fear of making mistakes. I remember the 1st time I planted seeds and watched small leaves and stems sprout; it was a mix of awe and happiness. Every day, I dedicated time and effort to watering, weeding, and observing the growth of my tomato and lettuce plants. There have been challenges and rewards, such as dealing with pests and diseases, but seeing the fruits and vegetables ripen on my balcony is incredibly gratifying. Now I've a small oasis of basil and peppers, and the aroma and flavor of my harvests are unbeatable. It's an activity that connects me with nature and gives me peace and tranquility amid the hustle and bustle of the city.

text_es: To create your own small garden in the city, patience and careful observation are key to success. First, choose a spot with ample sunlight that can avoid strong winds and frost, receiving at least six hours of direct sunlight daily. Next, based on the climate conditions and space available, select suitable plants and vegetables, while also considering the soil texture and drainage. A high-quality substrate rich in nutrients and organic matter will ensure plants grow healthy and vibrant. Water regularly, paying attention to keeping the soil moist, avoiding it being too wet or too dry. Furthermore, learning how to use natural and preventive methods for ecological pest and disease control is an important part of maintaining crop balance and health. As long as you care for it consistently, this urban garden will not only bring you the joy of a bountiful harvest but also become a source of fresh ingredients, filling you with happiness.
text_tgt_raw: 想要在都市裡打造一座屬於自己的小花園，耐心與細心觀察是成功的關鍵。首先，要選擇一處陽光充足且能避開強風、霜害的地方，每天至少要有六小時的直射陽光。接著，根據這裡的氣候條件和空間大小，挑選適合種植的植物與蔬菜，同時也要考量土壤的質地與排水狀況。一份富含養分和有機質的優質基質，能確保植物健康且生氣勃勃地成長。澆水時要規律，注意保持土壤的濕潤度，避免過濕或過乾。此外，學習如何利用天然且預防性的方法來進行病蟲害的生態防治，是維持作物平衡與健康的重要一環。只要持之以恆地照顧著，這座都市花園不僅能為您帶來豐收的喜悅，也能成為新鮮食材的來源，讓您滿心歡喜。
base_en: To start caring for an urban garden, patience, and observation are key. Choose a sunny spot protected from wind and frost, with at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day. Select plants and vegetables suitable for your climate and space, considering the soil and drainage. A good substrate, rich in nutrients and organic matter, will ensure healthy and vigorous growth. Water them regularly, controlling humidity and dryness, without excesses or deficiencies. Learn about ecological pest and disease control, using natural and preventive methods to maintain balance and the health of your crops. Consistency and care will make your garden a success and a source of satisfaction and fresh food.

text_es: Planning a train trip is definitely an excellent choice for those seeking comfort and beautiful scenery along the way, as it offers a completely different experience from flying or driving. First, it is very important to select your destination and route in advance and book your tickets, especially during peak season or on popular routes. Consider the duration of your journey and any transfers, carefully evaluating departure and arrival times. Additionally, don't forget about luggage restrictions and the services provided on the train, such as dining cars and Wi-Fi, which can add convenience to your trip. Some trains also have different classes and fares, which will affect the cost and quality of your travel. Finally, properly arranging accommodation and activities at your destination will ensure a stress-free and enjoyable vacation, allowing you to fully relax.
text_tgt_raw: 規劃一趟火車旅行，對於追求舒適與沿途美景的人來說，絕對是個絕佳的選擇，它提供了與搭飛機或開車截然不同的體驗。首先，提前選定目的地和路線，並預訂好車票非常重要，尤其在旺季或熱門路線上。考量旅程的時長與轉乘，仔細評估出發和抵達時間。此外，也別忘了行李限制以及火車上提供的服務，例如餐車和網路軟體等，這些都能為旅途增添便利。有些火車還有不同的艙等和票價，這會影響您旅行的費用和品質。最後，妥善安排目的地裡的住宿和活動，才能確保這是一次沒有壓力的愉快假期，讓您能盡情享受。
base_en: Planning a train trip is an excellent option for those seeking comfort and scenery, offering a different experience than flying or driving. 1st, it's crucial to choose the destination and route in advance and book tickets, especially if traveling during high season or on popular routes. Consider the duration of the journey and connections, evaluating both the departure and arrival times. It's also important to think about luggage and available onboard services, such as a cafeteria and Wi-Fi. Some trains offer different classes and fares, which can influence the cost and quality of the trip. Finally, good planning of accommodation and activities at the destination will ensure a stress-free and very pleasant vacation.

text_es: Planning a train trip, for me, is one of those activities filled with anticipation and excitement. I enjoy holding a map, a steaming cup of coffee in my hand, and unhurriedly planning routes and destinations. First, I check inter-city timetables and transfer information, paying special attention to transfer times and waiting times. Next, I research ticket prices and discount options, hoping to find the most cost-effective choice. The comfort of the carriage and luggage size are also important considerations; I certainly don't want to rush around with unnecessary packages and bags. Finally, I book tickets and seats, ensuring all documents and proofs are ready to avoid any unexpected events or delays during the journey. This detailed planning process always brings me immense satisfaction and joy.
text_tgt_raw: 規劃一趟火車旅行，對我而言，是充滿期待與興奮的活動之一。我喜歡拿著地圖，手裡捧著一杯熱騰騰的咖啡，從容不迫地規劃路線與目的地。首先，我會查詢城市間的時刻表與轉乘資訊，特別留意換車時間與等待時間。接著，我會研究票價與優惠方案，希望能找到性價比最高的選擇。車廂裡的舒適度與行李大小也為重要考量，我可不希望帶著不必要的包裹與行李奔波。最後，我會預訂車票和座位，確保所有文件與證明都已備妥，以免旅程中出現任何意外或延誤。這樣一個詳細規劃的過程，總是帶給我無比的成就感與快樂。
base_en: Organizing a train trip is one of my favorite activities, a moment of excitement and anticipation. I love sitting with a map and a hot cup of coffee, calmly, and unhurriedly planning routes and destinations. 1st, I look for schedules and connections between cities, paying attention to transfers and waiting times. Then, I research prices and offers, trying to find the best value for money. It's essential to consider luggage and comfort on board, as I don't want to carry unnecessary bundles and suitcases. Finally, I book the tickets and seats, making sure to have all documents and proofs on hand to avoid surprises and setbacks during the trip. It's a process that gives me a lot of satisfaction and excitement.

text_es: To effectively plan and enjoy a train trip, there are several key aspects to consider. First, thoroughly research your destination and route, looking for cities and scenery that interest you, and also confirm train schedules and timetables. Next, be sure to book your tickets in advance, especially for long journeys or during peak travel seasons, as this usually ensures better prices and preferred seating. Third, prepare a detailed itinerary, including accommodation and activities at each stop, and factor in transfer times between trains and movement within stations. Fourth, pack your luggage efficiently, prioritizing lightness and comfort, and keep important documents and personal items with you. Fifth, understand the services available on the train, such as dining and entertainment facilities like movies, as well as the railway company's baggage policy. Finally, stay flexible and fully enjoy the beautiful scenery and tranquility of the journey, viewing this time as an opportunity for relaxation and exploration.
text_tgt_raw: 為了能有效規劃一趟火車旅行並享受其中樂趣，有幾個關鍵面向值得考量。首先，要仔細研究目的地與路線，尋找你感興趣的城市及風景，同時也要確認火車班次與時刻表。再來，務必提早預訂車票，尤其是在長途旅行或旅遊旺季，這樣通常能確保取得更優惠的價格和較佳的座位。第三，準備一份詳盡的行程表，包括每個停留點的住宿與活動，並將火車之間的轉乘時間和車站裡的移動也納入考量。第四，高效地整理你的行李，以輕便舒適為優先，重要的文件和隨身物品則要隨身攜帶。第五，了解火車上的服務，例如餐飲和影片等娛樂設施，以及該鐵路公司的行李政策。最後，保持彈性並盡情享受旅途中的美景與寧靜，將這段時光視為一次放鬆與探索的機會。
base_en: To effectively plan a train trip and enjoy the experience, consider several key aspects. 1st, research destinations and routes, looking for cities and landscapes that interest you, along with train availability and schedules. 2nd, book your tickets in advance, especially for long journeys and peak seasons, which can ensure better prices and seats. 3rd, prepare a detailed itinerary, including accommodations and activities at each stop, and take into account connection and transfer times between trains and stations. 4th, organize your luggage efficiently, prioritizing comfort and lightness, and carry essential documents and items with you. 5th, find out about onboard services—restaurants and entertainment—and the railway company's baggage policies. Finally, be flexible and enjoy the beauty and tranquility of the journey, a moment of relaxation and discovery.

text_es: Baking bread at home is a very rewarding activity, and it's also a culinary tradition that combines patience and skill. It only requires basic ingredients like flour, water, yeast, and salt, but it can produce bread that is more diverse and flavorful than commercially produced products. This process usually requires kneading by hand or using a machine to help the gluten in the dough develop fully, which is necessary to achieve the ideal texture and mouthfeel. After a period of fermentation and proofing, the length of which will vary depending on the recipe and ambient temperature, comes the baking, which transforms the dough into golden, fragrant bread. This hobby not only provides fresh and healthy food but also creates a warm and cozy atmosphere at home, perfect for sharing with family and friends. Furthermore, it allows people to try different grains, seeds, and nuts, customizing the results to suit everyone's preferences, and sometimes you can find new recipes online or watch videos to learn techniques, making the whole process even more interesting.
text_tgt_raw: 在家烘焙麵包是一項非常有成就感的活動，也是一種結合了耐心與技巧的烹飪傳統。它只需麵粉、水、酵母和鹽這些基本食材，卻能做出比市售工業產品更多元、風味更佳的麵包。這個過程通常需要手工揉麵或使用機器輔助，讓麵糰裡的麵筋充分發展，才能呈現出理想的組織和口感。經過一段時間的發酵和醒麵，其長短會根據食譜和環境溫度而有所不同，接下來就是烘烤，將麵糰轉化為金黃香氣撲鼻的麵包。這項嗜好不僅能提供新鮮又健康的食物，還能為家裡營造出溫馨舒適的氛圍，非常適合與親朋好友一同分享。此外，它也讓人能嘗試不同的穀物、種子和堅果，將成果客製化以符合每個人的喜好，有時候還能在網路上找到新的食譜或觀看影片學習技巧，讓整個過程更有趣。
base_en: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity and a culinary tradition that combines patience and technique. It requires basic ingredients like flour and water, in addition to yeast and salt, but it offers a variety and flavor superior to industrial products. The process usually involves kneading the dough by hand or with a machine, which allows the gluten to develop and results in a suitable texture and crumb. After a period of fermentation and resting, which varies according to the recipe and ambient temperature, baking proceeds, transforming the dough into a golden and aromatic bread. This hobby not only provides fresh and healthy food, but it also creates a warm and cozy atmosphere in the home, ideal for sharing with friends and family. Furthermore, it allows experimenting with different types of cereals and grains, as well as with seeds and nuts, customizing the result to each person's taste.

text_es: I still clearly remember the first time I decided to bake bread at home. It was a Saturday afternoon, and I was looking for a new hobby, wanting some respite from my daily busyness. I bought flour and yeast, and armed with a cookbook and a little courage, I embarked on this baking adventure. Mixing ingredients like flour, water, salt, and yeast, and feeling the dough between my fingertips, the process was both therapeutic and relaxing. The kneading and proofing process seemed almost magical to me; it cleverly combined science and culinary art, completely immersing me. The aroma of freshly baked bread filled the entire kitchen, that sweet, warm fragrance was unparalleled, drawing me into a peaceful and joyful state. When I took those golden loaves, with their crispy crusts and soft interiors, out of the oven, the pride and satisfaction that welled up inside me were unprecedented. From that day on, the oven and flour became my best partners, and I have since greatly enjoyed this small ritual filled with peace and deliciousness.
text_tgt_raw: 我至今仍清楚記得第一次決定在家裡製作麵包的情景，那是一個週六的午後，我正尋求一個新的樂趣，想從日常的忙碌中獲得一些喘息。我買了麵粉和酵母，靠著一本食譜和少許的勇氣，便著手展開了這場烘焙冒險。將麵粉、水、鹽和酵母等材料混合，感受麵團在指尖的觸感，那過程既療癒又放鬆。揉捏與發酵的過程在我看來近乎魔幻，它巧妙地結合了科學與烹飪藝術，讓我完全沉浸其中。新鮮出爐的麵包香氣彌漫著整個廚房，那股甜甜暖暖的芬芳是無與倫比的，引人進入一種寧靜而愉悅的狀態。當我將那些金黃色的麵包，帶著酥脆的外皮與柔軟的內裡，從烤箱中取出時，內心湧現的自豪與滿足感是前所未有的。從那天起，烤箱和麵粉便成為我最好的搭檔，我也因此非常享受這個充滿平靜與美味的小小儀式。
base_en: I remember the 1st time I decided to make bread at home; it was a Saturday afternoon, and I was looking for a new project and a distraction from the daily hustle and bustle. I bought flour and yeast, and with a recipe book and a little courage, I embarked on the adventure. Mixing the ingredients—flour, water, salt, and yeast—and feeling the dough under my hands was a very gratifying and relaxing experience. The kneading and fermentation process seemed almost magical to me, a combination of science and culinary art that completely captivated me. The aroma of freshly baked bread that filled the kitchen was unbeatable, a mix of sweetness and warmth that invited calm and enjoyment. Taking those golden loaves out of the oven, with their crispy crust and tender crumb, filled me with a pride and satisfaction I had rarely experienced. Since that day, the oven and flour have become my best allies, and I really enjoy this small ritual of peace and flavor.

text_es: Making bread at home is a journey full of patience and exploration. For beginners, the key is simplicity and consistency; you don't need professional equipment or special flour to start. Begin with a basic white bread recipe, using only flour, water, yeast, and salt. Pay special attention to temperature and humidity, as these are crucial factors for dough activation and development. If your first few attempts aren't ideal, don't be discouraged; continued practice and accumulated time will make your results better and better. Every loaf of bread is a learning experience and an opportunity for improvement. You can try adjusting different proofing times and baking temperatures to find your preferred texture and flavor. You will find that the aroma and deliciousness of freshly baked bread are absolutely worth all your effort and dedication.
text_tgt_raw: 在家自製麵包是一趟充滿耐心與探索的旅程。對於初學者來說，關鍵在於簡單與持續；一開始並不需要專業設備或特殊麵粉。先從一份基礎的白麵包食譜著手，僅使用麵粉、水、酵母和鹽。請特別留意溫度與濕度，這些是麵糰活化與發展的關鍵因素。最初幾次的嘗試若不盡理想，請不要氣餒，持續練習與時間累積將會讓您的成果越來越好；每個麵包都是一次學習，也是一次精進的機會。您可以試著調整不同的發酵時間與烘烤溫度，以找到您偏好的口感與風味。您會發現，新鮮出爐麵包的香氣與美味，絕對值得您付出的所有努力與心血。
base_en: Starting to make bread at home is a rewarding journey of patience and discovery. For the beginner, the key is simplicity and consistency; no equipment or exotic flours are needed at 1st. Start with a basic white bread recipe, using only flour and water, yeast, and salt. Pay attention to temperature and humidity, crucial factors for the activation and development of the dough. Don't despair with the 1st attempts, practice, and time will improve your results; each bread is a lesson and an opportunity for improvement. Experiment with different fermentation times and baking temperatures to find your preferred balance and flavor. You'll see that the reward—the aroma and taste of freshly baked bread—justifies all the effort and dedication.

text_es: Adopting a dog is an act full of love and responsibility; it not only changes the fate of many animals but also enriches people's lives. We provide a warm home, careful care, and abundant love for these lives that have experienced hardship and abandonment. Before making this important decision, be sure to carefully consider the time and money you will invest in the dog's well-being, including food, veterinary expenses, and entertainment costs. Choosing the right dog should focus on the adopter's lifestyle and the animal's needs to seek compatibility and harmony. Many foundations and animal shelters can provide guidance and assistance throughout the adoption process, ensuring that new owners and their companions can build the best connection. This is a long-term commitment that will repay us with unconditional companionship and affection, filling our homes with joy and new experiences.
text_tgt_raw: 領養一隻狗，是一份充滿愛與責任的行為，它不僅改變了許多動物的命運，也豐富了人們的生活。我們為這些曾歷經艱難與遺棄的生命，提供一個溫暖的家、細心的照護以及滿滿的關愛。在做出這項重要的決定前，務必仔細考量將投入在狗狗福祉上的時間與金錢，包括飼料、獸醫費用以及娛樂開銷等。選擇適合的狗狗，應著重於領養者的生活型態與動物的需求，以尋求彼此的相容性與和諧。許多基金會與動物收容所能為整個領養過程提供指導與協助，確保新主人與牠們的夥伴能建立最好的連結。這是一份長期的承諾，它將回報我們無條件的陪伴與情感，讓家裡充滿歡樂與嶄新的體驗。
base_en: Adopting a dog is an act of love and responsibility that transforms the lives of many animals and people. It involves offering a home, care, and affection to a living being that has often gone through difficult situations and abandonment. Before making this important decision, it's crucial to consider the time and money that will be dedicated to its well-being, including food, veterinary care, and entertainment. The choice of the right dog should be based on the adopter's lifestyle and the animal's needs, seeking compatibility and harmony. Foundations and animal shelters offer guidance and support throughout the process, ensuring the best possible union between the new owner and their companion. It's a long-term commitment that provides unconditional companionship and affection, filling the home with joy and new experiences.

text_es: When I decided to adopt a dog, I was truly both excited and nervous. I spent several months searching online for information on different breeds and shelters, longing for warm companionship and love. Finally, I found Lucas, a two-year-old mixed breed with big eyes and soft, shiny fur. The adoption process was quite simple and quick: we filled out a few forms, and they interviewed me to confirm my stability and sense of responsibility. From the very first day, Lucas brought joy and a little chaos into my life with his barks and playtime. His walks and naps have now become the focus of my daily life; every afternoon we share cozy, cuddly moments, gazing at each other. His presence has taught me patience and loyalty, and the inexpressible bond and affection I feel for him make me feel that this place is full of love.
text_tgt_raw: 當我決定領養一隻狗時，心裡真是又興奮又緊張。我花了好幾個月的時間在網路上搜尋各種犬種和收容所的資料，渴望著一份溫暖的陪伴與愛。終於，我找到了路卡斯，牠是隻兩歲的米克斯，有著一雙大眼睛和柔軟閃亮的毛皮。領養過程相當簡單而迅速：我們填寫了幾份表格，他們也對我進行了訪談，以確認我的穩定性與責任感。從第一天起，路卡斯便帶著牠的叫聲和遊戲，為我的生活帶來了歡樂與一些小小的混亂。牠的散步和午睡現在已成了我每日生活的重心，每個下午我們都會分享依偎的溫馨時光，互相凝視著對方。牠的存在教會了我耐心與忠誠，我對牠那份難以言喻的連結與情感，讓我覺得這裡充滿了愛。
base_en: When I decided to adopt a dog, I felt a mix of excitement and nerves. I had spent months researching breeds and shelters, looking for the companionship and love I longed for so much. Finally, I found Lucas, a 2-year-old mixed breed with big eyes and soft, shiny fur. The adoption process was simple and quick: we filled out forms and they interviewed me, checking my stability and responsibility. From the 1st day, Lucas brought joy and chaos into my life, with his barks and his games. His walks and his naps are now the center of my daily life, and every afternoon we share cuddles and glances. His presence has taught me about patience and loyalty, and the connection and affection I feel for him are indescribable.

text_es: Adopting a dog is a big decision that requires time and effort, so it's essential to research the exercise and care needs of different breeds beforehand. Before bringing your dog home, prepare ample space, a comfortable dog bed, and toys, and ensure food and water are ready. In the first few days, establish a clear routine for walks and feeding to help your dog adapt to the new environment. Early exposure to other dogs and people is crucial for its healthy growth and behavioral development. Patience and positive encouragement are indispensable when teaching and training your dog. Don't forget to take your dog to the vet regularly for health check-ups and vaccinations, and to get it microchipped and registered. Enjoy this new stage full of love and companionship, and build a strong and lasting bond with your furry friend.
text_tgt_raw: 領養一隻狗是個重大決定，需要投入時間與心力，因此必須事先研究不同犬種的運動量與照護需求。在將牠帶回家裡之前，請為牠準備好充足的空間、舒適的狗床和玩具，並確保食物與飲水都已備妥。剛開始的幾天，應建立明確的散步與餵食作息，幫助牠適應新環境。早期讓牠接觸其他狗狗與人群，對於牠的良好成長和行為發展至關重要。在教導與訓練牠的過程裡，耐心和正向鼓勵是不可或缺的。別忘了定期帶牠去看獸醫，進行健康檢查與施打疫苗，並辦理晶片植入與登記。好好享受這段充滿愛與陪伴的新階段，與毛小孩建立起堅固且長久的連結吧。
base_en: Adopting a dog is an important decision that requires time and commitment, so research breeds and their exercise and care needs well. Before bringing it home, prepare an adequate space with its bed and toys, and make sure you've food and water available. During the 1st days, establish a clear routine for walks and feeding to help it adapt. Early socialization with other dogs and people is key for its good development and behavior. Patience and positive reinforcement are essential tools for its education and learning. Don't forget regular visits to the vet for check-ups and vaccinations, as well as its identification and registration. Enjoy this new stage of love and companionship, forging a strong and lasting bond.

text_es: Assembling shelves is a common task in many homes and offices, providing a practical storage and organization solution. This job requires patience, precision, and the right tools and materials to ensure stability and durability. Before starting, be sure to carefully read the assembly instructions and confirm that all necessary parts and hardware, such as screws and nuts, are present. The assembly process typically involves joining side panels and horizontal shelves, and each component must be securely fastened to prevent wobbling later. A power drill and screwdriver are usually used here to complete the assembly safely and efficiently. Correct installation ensures that the shelves can support the weight of books and decorative items without any risk. Once assembly is complete, it is recommended to check the structure's stability and levelness to ensure it will serve us for a long time.
text_tgt_raw: 在許多家庭與辦公室裡，組裝層架是項常見的任務，它提供了一個實用的收納與整理方案。這項工作需要耐心、精準度，以及合適的工具與材料，才能確保其穩固與耐用。開始之前，務必仔細閱讀組裝說明，並確認所有必要的零件與五金配件，例如螺絲與螺帽，都已備齊。組裝過程通常涉及側板與橫板的接合，每片組件都需確實固定，避免日後產生晃動。這裡通常會用到電鑽和螺絲起子，以安全且有效率地完成組裝。正確的安裝能確保層架足以承受書籍與裝飾品的重量而沒有任何風險。一旦組裝完成，建議檢查結構的穩定性與水平，以確保其能長期為我們服務。
base_en: Assembling a shelf is a common task in many homes and offices, offering a practical solution for storage and organization. It requires patience and precision, as well as the right tools and materials to ensure its stability and durability. Before starting, it's essential to review the assembly instructions and verify that all necessary parts and hardware, such as screws and nuts, are present. The process generally involves joining side and horizontal panels, firmly attaching each component to prevent movement and wobbling. Often, a drill and a screwdriver are needed to complete the assembly safely and efficiently. Correct installation ensures that the shelf can support the weight of books and decorative objects without risk. Once assembly is finished, it's recommended to check the stability and leveling of the structure.

text_es: Last week, I assembled a bookshelf in the living room, which was truly a test of my DIY skills and patience. As soon as I opened the box, the sheer number of parts and screws inside, coupled with the confusing instructions and diagrams, already made me feel a bit stressed and tired. First, I had to sort the wooden boards and hardware, and that's when I realized I was missing two essential tools: a screwdriver and a hammer. The process of assembling the boards and brackets was more complicated than I expected, and there were several mistakes that needed to be corrected at the last minute. After three hours of effort and concentration, and with my partner's help and encouragement, the bookshelf finally stood steadily. Now it holds books and souvenirs, and seeing this result, I feel very proud and satisfied.
text_tgt_raw: 上週我在客廳裡組裝一個書架，這真是一項考驗DIY能力和耐心的工程。一打開箱子，裡頭零件和螺絲的數量，加上那些令人困惑的說明和圖示，就已經讓我感到有些壓力與疲憊。首先要將木板和五金配件分類，那時我才發現自己缺少螺絲起子和槌子這兩種必備工具。板材與支架的組裝過程比我預期的還要複雜，中間還出現了幾次錯誤，得在最後一刻進行修正。經過三個小時的努力與專注，以及伴侶在一旁的協助與鼓勵，書架總算穩穩地立著了。現在它擺放著書籍和紀念品，看到這個成果，我心裡感到非常驕傲與滿意。
base_en: Last week, I set out to assemble a bookshelf in the living room, a true DIY and patience project. Upon opening the box, the number of pieces and screws, as well as the confusing instructions and drawings, already generated some stress and exhaustion for me. The 1st thing was to sort the wood and hardware, then I realized I was missing a screwdriver and a hammer, essential tools I didn't have on hand. The process of fitting the boards and supports together turned out to be more complex than I anticipated, with a few errors and last-minute corrections. After 3 hours of effort and concentration, and with a little help and encouragement from my partner, the bookshelf finally stood upright. Now it displays books and souvenirs, and I feel proud and satisfied with the final result.

text_es: When assembling a bookshelf, patience and organization are key to ensuring a sturdy and durable result. Before you start, make sure all parts and tools, such as screwdrivers and hex wrenches, are present, and carefully read the instructions and assembly diagram. Sort screws, fasteners, and boards and shelves of different sizes to avoid confusion and mistakes. Securely tightening screws and leveling are crucial for the furniture's stability and safety, so don't rush through each step. If the bookshelf is large, having another person assist will make the entire process much easier and faster. Before you start placing books or decorations, be sure to carefully check all joints and fasteners.
text_tgt_raw: 組裝書櫃時，耐心與條理是確保成果穩固耐用的關鍵。動手前，請務必確認所有零件和工具都齊備，例如螺絲起子和六角扳手，並仔細閱讀說明書與組裝圖。將螺絲、固定件以及不同大小的板材與層架分類好，這樣可以避免混淆出錯。穩固的螺絲鎖緊與水平調整，對於家具的穩定性和安全性至關重要，因此每個步驟都別急著完成。如果書櫃體積較大，有另一個人在旁協助，將會讓整個過程輕鬆許多，也會快很多。在開始放置書籍或裝飾品之前，務必仔細檢查所有接合處和固定狀況。
base_en: When assembling a bookshelf, patience, and organization are key for a successful and lasting result. Before starting, verify that you've all the necessary parts and tools—screwdrivers and Allen wrenches, for example—and carefully read the assembly instructions and diagrams. Identify and classify the screws and anchors, as well as the different panels and shelves, to avoid confusion and errors. Good screwing and leveling are fundamental for the stability and safety of the furniture, so take your time with each step. If it's a large bookshelf, the help and support of another person can make the job much easier and faster. Carefully check the joints and fastenings before loading books and decorative objects.

text_es: Saving in advance for a wonderful vacation is a very smart financial strategy; it allows us to enjoy this well-deserved rest without worrying about money or feeling stressed. This truly requires some prior planning and self-discipline, including setting a clear budget that considers the costs of transportation, accommodation, food, and activities. We recommend setting a savings goal and a realistic deadline, and evaluating monthly income and expenses to identify unnecessary spending that can be reduced to increase the travel fund. Additionally, opening a dedicated savings account can effectively separate this money from daily finances, avoiding unnecessary temptations and ensuring that all efforts and money invested will pay off. There, every penny you save for this trip will become a beautiful memory. At the same time, looking for flight and hotel deals and promotions in advance can also significantly reduce costs, opening up more possibilities for this trip and expanding richer experiences. Through this method, whether it's adventure or relaxation, it will be within reach, while also ensuring personal and family financial stability.
text_tgt_raw: 為了一趟美好的假期而提前儲蓄，是個非常聰明的理財策略，它能讓我們在享受這份應得的休息時，不必為金錢擔憂或感到壓力。這著實需要一些事前的規劃與自律，包括設立一個清晰的預算，把交通、住宿、飲食以及活動的費用都考慮進去。我們建議設定一個儲蓄目標和實際的截止日期，並評估每月的收入與支出，以找出哪些不必要的開銷可以減少，進而增加旅遊基金。另外，開立一個專門的儲蓄帳戶，可以有效地將這筆錢與日常財務分開，避免不必要的誘惑，確保所有投入的努力與金錢都能有所回報。在那裡，你為這趟旅程累積的每一分錢，都將成為美好的回憶。同時，提前尋找機票和旅館的優惠與促銷活動，也能大幅降低成本，為這趟旅程開啟更多可能性，拓展更豐富的體驗。透過這種方式，無論是冒險還是放鬆，都將觸手可及，同時也能保障個人與家庭的財務穩定。
base_en: Saving for vacation is a smart financial strategy that allows you to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries and stress. It involves advance planning and discipline, establishing a clear budget that includes transportation and accommodation, food, and activity expenses. It's recommended to set a savings goal and a realistic deadline, evaluating monthly income and expenses to identify areas where superfluous expenses can be reduced and funds for the trip can be increased. Creating a specific savings account can help separate this money from daily finances and avoid temptations, ensuring that the money and time invested in saving pay off. In addition, looking for offers and promotions in advance can significantly reduce the costs of flights and hotels, expanding the possibilities and destinations of the experience. In this way, adventure, and relaxation will be within reach, without compromising personal and family financial stability.

text_es: I still remember the excitement and struggle I felt last year when I was working hard to save money for my summer vacation. At the time, I was planning to go to Galicia, Spain, to explore its beautiful coastline and towns, so I had to figure out how to save enough money and arrange my time off. To save money, I started cutting down on unnecessary expenses, like buying fewer luxury items and going out less, opting instead to cook at home rather than eat at restaurants or go to the movies. Every penny and euro I saved went directly into my piggy bank, accumulating little by little. I also re-examined all my subscriptions and software, canceling those I barely used, and actively looked for various deals and discounts. In the end, all that effort and self-discipline were well worth it; I got to enjoy a ten-day trip full of adventure and beautiful scenery, just as I had wished. It was an unforgettable and valuable experience of planning and perseverance.
text_tgt_raw: 我還記得去年為了暑假旅行而努力存錢時，內心的那股興奮與煎熬。當時計畫著要去西班牙的加利西亞，好好探索那裡美麗的海岸線和城鎮，所以得想辦法存到足夠的錢，並且安排好休假時間。為了省錢，我開始減少那些不必要的開銷，例如少買些奢侈品、少去外面玩，改為在家裡自己煮飯，而不是上餐館或去電影院。每個省下來的銅板和歐元，都直接進到我的撲滿裡，一點一滴累積著。我也重新檢視了所有訂閱的服務和軟體，把那些幾乎沒在用的都取消掉，並且努力尋找各種優惠和折扣。最終，這些努力和自律都非常值得；我如願以償地享受了十天充滿冒險和美景的旅程。這是一次難忘的規劃與堅持的寶貴經驗。
base_en: I remember the excitement and frustration I felt last year trying to save for my summer vacation. My plan was to travel to Galicia, explore its coasts and towns, so I needed to get the money and time necessary to make it happen. I started to cut down on expenses for whims and outings, choosing to cook at home instead of going to restaurants and movie theaters. Every cent and euro I didn't spend went directly into a piggy bank, where I accumulated bills and coins. I also reviewed my subscriptions and services, canceling those I barely used and looking for offers and discounts on everything. In the end, the effort and discipline were worth it; I was able to enjoy 10 wonderful days, full of adventures and landscapes. It was a lesson in planning and perseverance that I won't easily forget.

text_es: To achieve your vacation dreams, discipline and planning are indispensable. You need to first carefully create a budget, clearly listing your income and expenses, and look for areas where you can reduce unnecessary spending and entertainment. Think about your travel priorities and goals, and set a realistic and achievable savings target. You might consider opening a separate savings account specifically for travel, which can effectively prevent you from spending this money on other uses or unexpected expenses. Small changes in daily life, or occasionally making some sacrifices, can bring unexpected benefits; for example, preparing meals at home instead of eating out can save a significant amount of money. Remember, consistent effort and patience are the keys to ultimately indulging in adventure and relaxation.
text_tgt_raw: 為了實現您的度假夢想，紀律與規劃是不可或缺的。您需要先仔細編列一份預算，將收入與支出清楚條列出來，並尋找可以減少非必要開銷與娛樂的空間。想想您的旅行優先順序與目標，並設定一個實際且可達成的儲蓄額度。可以考慮為旅行單獨開設一個儲蓄帳戶，這樣能有效避免您將這筆錢花費在其他用途或意料之外的支出上。日常生活裡的小改變，或是偶爾做出一些犧牲，都能帶來意想不到的助益；例如，在家裡自行準備餐點而非在外用餐，就能省下可觀的費用。請記住，持之以恆的努力和耐心，是讓您最終能徜徉在冒險與放鬆裡的關鍵。
base_en: To start saving for vacation, it's essential to have discipline and organization. Create a detailed budget that includes your income and expenses, and look for areas where you can reduce superfluous costs and unnecessary leisure. Think about your travel priorities and goals and set a realistic and achievable savings goal. Consider opening a separate savings account, exclusively for travel, so you'll avoid the temptation to spend that money on other things and unforeseen expenses. Small changes in your daily habits and big sacrifices can make a big difference; for example, preparing your food at home instead of eating out will save you a good amount of money. Remember that consistency and patience are key to achieving your dreams of adventure and relaxation.

text_es: Learning a new language opens doors to different cultures and professional opportunities, truly making it a life-enriching journey. Although it requires dedication and time, the benefits it brings are both broad and profound. We must continuously practice grammar and vocabulary, and also immerse ourselves in daily speaking and listening. Many students use online resources and in-person classes to enhance their abilities and confidence. During this process, setting realistic goals and staying motivated is crucial, because while learning a new language is challenging, it also brings fruitful results. Patience and perseverance are key to the success of this educational journey; it not only improves communication and cognitive abilities but also cultivates our understanding and appreciation of global cultural diversity.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一門新的語言，為我們開啟了通往不同文化與專業機會的大門，這著實是一段豐富人生的旅程。雖然這需要投入心力與時間，但其帶來的好處既廣泛又深遠。我們必須持續不斷地練習文法與詞彙，更要讓自己沉浸在日常的口說與聽力裡。許多學生會利用網路上的資源，以及實體的課程來增強他們的能力與自信。在這段過程裡，設定實際的目標並保持動力至關重要，因為學習新語言雖然充滿挑戰，卻也為我們帶來豐碩的成果。耐心與毅力是這趟教育旅程成功的關鍵，它不僅提升了溝通與認知能力，更培養了我們對全球多元文化的理解與欣賞。
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to new cultures and professional opportunities. It involves dedication and effort, but the benefits are immense and long-lasting. It requires constant practice in grammar and vocabulary, as well as immersion in daily speaking and listening. Many students utilize online resources and in-person classes to improve their skills and confidence. It's crucial to set realistic goals and maintain motivation, as the process can be challenging but rewarding. Patience and perseverance are key to success in this educational journey. This process not only improves communicative and cognitive skills, but also fosters a greater understanding and appreciation for global diversity.

text_es: I clearly remember my experience starting to learn Japanese about two years ago. At first, it was truly chaotic, with sounds and symbols intertwined, and kanji and grammar were even bigger obstacles, like deep valleys in a mountain of knowledge. Although friends and family constantly encouraged me, frustration and fatigue followed me like a shadow. However, with time and effort, as I dedicated about two hours each day, those words and phrases gradually began to make sense. Now, I can enjoy Japanese movies and dramas without subtitles, and even have simple conversations and discussions with locals, which brings me great joy and satisfaction. This is a fascinating journey full of discovery and personal growth, and being able to learn new vocabulary and expressions here every day is truly very satisfying.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚記得大約兩年前開始學習日文的經歷。起初，那真是一片混沌，聲音與符號交織成一片，漢字和文法更是巨大的障礙，彷彿知識的深山幽谷。儘管親朋好友不斷鼓勵著我，但挫折感與疲憊卻如影隨形。然而，隨著時間與努力，我每天投入約兩小時，那些字詞和片語漸漸變得有意義了。現在，我已能不看字幕享受日文影片和戲劇，甚至可以和當地人進行簡單的對話和討論，這帶給我極大的喜悅與滿足。這是一趟充滿發現與個人成長的迷人旅程，每天都能在這裡學到新的詞彙和表達方式，著實令人感到非常滿足。
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese about 2 years ago. At 1st, it was a total chaos of sounds and symbols. The kanji and grammar seemed like an insurmountable barrier, a true mountain and valley of knowledge. My friends and family encouraged me, but frustration and exhaustion were constant. However, with time and effort—I dedicated about 2 hours daily—words and phrases started to make sense. Now I enjoy movies and series without subtitles, and I can even hold simple conversations and debates with natives, a great joy and satisfaction. It's a fascinating journey of discovery and personal growth, and every day I find new words and expressions, which is very gratifying.

text_es: When learning a new language, consistency and patience are key. From day one, you should immerse yourself through study and active practice. In the online world, you can find various resources like software applications, books, videos, and music that allow you to frequently engage with the language. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; it's a natural part of the learning process and helps improve your comprehension and expression. Find a language exchange partner or join a conversation group to practice communicating and build confidence together. There are no quick shortcuts, but you can also use fragmented time to study, like when you're riding the bus or in a taxi. Remember, immersive learning and enjoyment are crucial for maintaining long-term motivation; set realistic goals for yourself and celebrate every small achievement in your learning journey.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一種新語言，持之以恆和耐心是關鍵。從第一天起，您就應該透過學習和積極練習來沉浸其中。在網路世界裡，您可以找到各種軟體應用程式、書籍、影片和音樂等資源，讓您能經常接觸該語言。別害怕犯錯，這是學習過程中很自然的一部分，能幫助您提升理解和表達能力。找一位語言交換夥伴或加入會話團體，一起練習溝通並建立自信。這裡沒有快速的捷徑，但當您搭乘公車或計程車時，也可以利用零碎時間來學習。記住，沉浸式學習和樂趣對於維持長期動力至關重要，為自己設定切合實際的目標，並慶祝學習旅程中的每一個小成就。
base_en: To learn a new language, consistency, and patience are key. From day 1, immerse yourself in the language through study and active practice. Look for resources and tools such as apps, books, movies, and music that expose you to the language regularly. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; they're a natural part of the learning process and will help you improve your comprehension and expression. Find an exchange partner or join conversation groups to practice communication and gain confidence. Remember that immersion and fun are essential for maintaining long-term motivation. Set realistic goals and celebrate every small achievement and step forward on your journey.

text_es: Participating in a popular road race is like being in a nationwide sports festival, where runners of all ages, levels, and physical conditions can join in. This type of event offers an excellent opportunity for personal growth and social interaction, and can effectively promote health and the balance of mind, body, and spirit. Races usually feature diverse distances such as 5K, 10K, or half marathon, and the routes often pass through charming cityscapes or natural scenery, making the entire competition a carnival celebrating effort and community cohesion. To fully enjoy it and avoid injury, prior physical training, adequate hydration, and a good race strategy are all crucial. Many popular races also have a charitable aspect, donating a portion of the registration fees to charities or social organizations, which not only enhances the value of participation but also encourages people to give and contribute. Runners will be immersed in the joyful atmosphere, the camaraderie with each other, and the pride of crossing the finish line; regardless of their performance, that sense of accomplishment is priceless.
text_tgt_raw: 參與一場廣受歡迎的路跑活動，就像是置身於一場全民的運動盛會，不論跑者年齡、程度或體能狀況，都能共襄盛舉。這種活動為個人成長與社交互動提供了絕佳機會，並能有效促進健康與身心靈的平衡。賽事通常設有5公里、10公里或半程馬拉松等多元距離，路線往往會經過迷人的城市街景或自然風光，讓整場比賽成為一場慶祝努力與凝聚社群的嘉年華。為了盡情享受其中並避免受傷，事前的體能訓練、充分補水以及良好的參賽策略都至關重要。許多熱門賽事更蘊含著慈善意義，將部分報名費捐助給慈善機構或社會組織，這不僅提升了參與的價值，也鼓勵了人們付出與貢獻。跑者們會沉浸在歡樂的氣氛、彼此的友誼，以及衝過終點線的驕傲裡，無論成績如何，那份成就感都是無價的。
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a mass sporting event, open to runners of all levels, ages, and physical conditions. These events offer an excellent opportunity for personal improvement and social interaction, promoting health and well-being. Generally, they include varied distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or half marathons, and usually cover attractive urban or natural landscapes, becoming a celebration of effort and community. Physical preparation, hydration, and a good race strategy are essential to enjoy the experience and avoid injuries. Many popular races have a charitable component, allocating part of the registration fee to charitable causes and social organizations, which adds extra value to participation and encourages help and commitment. Participants enjoy the festive atmosphere, camaraderie, and the pride of crossing the finish line, whatever their time and position.

text_es: Three years ago, I decided to participate in my first-ever road race, feeling both nervous and excited at the time. During that period, whether it was sunny or rainy, the training process was quite tough, but I felt I was ready for the challenge. On the morning of the race, the air was cool, and hundreds of runners gathered, filling the scene with energy and enthusiasm. I clearly remember the crowds, the noisy sounds, the uplifting music, and the cheers from all directions. In the first few kilometers after the start, I experienced both the joy of running and the physical test, as my legs and breathing gradually adapted to the rhythm of the run. When I finally crossed the finish line, the feeling of victory and satisfaction instantly overcame all the fatigue and muscle soreness. Since then, participating in road races has become a great passion of mine, and a personal challenge I continuously enjoy.
text_tgt_raw: 三年前，我決定參加生平第一場路跑賽事，當時心裡既緊張又興奮。那段時間，不論是晴天還是雨天，訓練過程都相當艱辛，但我感覺自己已為這場挑戰做好了準備。比賽當天早晨，空氣涼爽，數百名跑者齊聚一堂，現場充滿了活力與熱情。我清楚記得那裡的人潮、喧囂的聲響、振奮人心的音樂，以及來自四面八方的加油打氣。起跑後的最初幾公里，我同時體驗著奔馳的愉悅與身體的考驗，雙腿與呼吸逐漸適應著跑步的節奏。最終衝過終點線時，那股勝利與滿足感瞬間超越了所有的疲憊與肌肉痠痛。從那時起，參與路跑賽事便成為我的一大熱情，也是我不斷享受的個人挑戰。
base_en: 3 years ago, I decided to run my 1st popular race, an experience that combined nerves and excitement in equal measure. The training, with its rainy and sunny days, had been tough, but I felt prepared for the challenge. On the morning of the event, the air was cool and filled with the energy and enthusiasm of hundreds of runners. I remember the crowd, the noise, the music, and the encouragement of the people. The 1st kilometers were a mix of euphoria and effort, with my legs and my breathing acclimating to the rhythm. Crossing the finish line was a feeling of victory and satisfaction that overcame the fatigue and muscle soreness. Since then, popular races have become a passion and a personal challenge that I greatly enjoy.

text_es: If this is your first time participating in a popular race, please focus on enjoying the process rather than your results and ranking. Start with gradual training, progressively increasing distance and intensity, and pay attention to how your body feels. Before and during the race, adequate hydration and a balanced intake of carbohydrates and protein are key to maintaining your energy. On race day, be sure to arrive at the venue early to familiarize yourself with the environment and route, and make sure to warm up and stretch properly. During the competition, maintain a comfortable pace for yourself, do not try to exceed your physical limits, and distribute your energy appropriately. Don't forget that a pair of suitable running shoes and breathable athletic apparel can provide you with the best comfort and performance. After finishing the race, celebrate this achievement and begin planning for recovery and future challenges. There is a lot of information and videos here that can help you, and online resources are also very abundant. It is convenient to take a bus or taxi to the race venue.
text_tgt_raw: 第一次參與熱門賽事，請專注於享受過程，而非成績與名次。從循序漸進的訓練開始，逐步增加距離與強度，並留意身體的感受。賽前與賽中，充足的水分補給及均衡的碳水化合物與蛋白質攝取，為保持體力的關鍵。比賽當天，務必提早抵達會場，熟悉環境與路線，並確實做好熱身與伸展。競賽時，請維持讓自己舒服的配速，切勿嘗試超越體能極限，並適時分配體力。別忘了，一雙合適的跑鞋與透氣的機能服飾，能為你帶來最佳的舒適度與表現。完賽後，好好慶祝這項成就，並著手規劃恢復與未來的挑戰。這裡有許多資料與影片能幫助你，網路上的資源也十分豐富。搭乘公車或計程車前往賽場都很方便。
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience and not so much on time and ranking. Start with gradual and consistent training, progressively increasing distance and intensity, and paying attention to your body and sensations. Hydration and adequate nutrition—with carbohydrates and proteins—are essential before and during the event. On race day, arrive early enough to familiarize yourself with the surroundings and the course, and do a good warm-up and stretches. Maintain a comfortable pace, without trying to go faster than you feel capable, and manage your strength and energy. Don't forget the importance of good footwear and technical clothing, which offer you comfort and performance. Afterward, celebrate your achievement and plan your recovery and future challenges.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is truly an art that combines skill and patience, transforming old objects into treasures that are both beautiful and functional. In this process, we first carefully assess the furniture's condition, identifying damage and flaws. Next, steps such as cleaning, removing old paint, and structural repairs are typically performed, which may involve gluing loose joints or even replacing damaged wooden parts if necessary. Then, the craftsman carefully sands the piece and applies varnish or wax to protect the surface, while highlighting the wood's natural grain and color, restoring its former splendor and value. This is a job that requires a great deal of effort and the use of specific tools and materials to ensure the result is both durable and beautiful. Furthermore, furniture restoration also contributes to sustainability and allows us to re-appreciate traditional craftsmanship and historical heritage.
text_tgt_raw: 修復一件古董傢俱，著實是一門結合了技藝與耐心的藝術，它能將陳舊的物件轉化為兼具美觀與實用價值的珍品。這個過程裡，我們首先會仔細評估傢俱的狀況，找出破損與缺陷之處。接著，通常會進行清潔、去除舊漆和修復結構等步驟，這其中可能涉及膠合鬆脫的接合處，或甚至在必要時更換損壞的木製零件。然後，匠人會仔細打磨，並施以清漆或蠟，以保護表面，同時突顯木材天然的紋理與色澤，使其恢復往日的華麗與價值。這是一項需要投入大量心力，並使用特定工具與材料的工作，才能確保成果既耐用又美觀。此外，傢俱修復也為永續發展做出貢獻，並讓我們能重新珍視傳統工藝與歷史傳承。
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is an art that combines skill and patience, transforming worn pieces into objects of beauty and functionality. This process involves several stages, beginning with a detailed evaluation of the furniture's condition and the identification of damage and defects. Generally, one proceeds with cleaning, stripping, and repairing the structure, which may include gluing joints and replacing wooden parts if necessary. Next, sanding, and finishing are carried out, applying varnishes and waxes to protect the surface and highlight the natural grain and color of the wood, thus recovering its splendor and value. It's a job that requires dedication and the use of specific tools and materials to guarantee a durable and aesthetic result. Furthermore, restoration contributes to sustainability and the appreciation of artisanal and historical heritage.

text_es: Two years ago, I inherited an old oak desk from my grandmother, and it carried a rich history and unique charm. At the time, it was in poor condition, with cracked wood and peeling paint, but I saw an opportunity and a challenge in it. I decided to restore it myself, a job that truly required patience and skill, because I hoped to preserve its original essence and beauty during the process. I started by carefully sanding the surface and applying special software for the wood and hardware parts, which, though a lengthy process, was also satisfying. Of course, during the restoration process, I sometimes encountered setbacks and doubts, especially when dealing with the most complex and delicate details, but the sense of accomplishment from seeing it gradually regain its former glory always motivated me. Today, this desk looks magnificent in my living room, blending history and innovation. Every time I look at it, I recall the effort and emotion I put into it, and my heart fills with pride and joy, because I successfully saved this precious family heirloom.
text_tgt_raw: 兩年前，我從奶奶那裡繼承了一張舊橡木書桌，那裡頭承載著豐富的歷史與獨特魅力。當時它狀況不佳，木頭龜裂、漆面剝落，但我卻從中看到了機會與挑戰。我決定親手修復它，這份工作著實需要耐心與技巧，因為我希望在過程中能保留它最初的精髓與美感。我從仔細打磨表面開始，並為木材與五金零件塗上專用軟體，這雖然是個漫長的過程，卻也令人感到滿足。當然，修復的過程裡，有時也會遇到挫折與懷疑，尤其是在處理那些最為複雜精緻的細節時，但看到它逐漸恢復往昔光彩的成就感，一直激勵著我。如今，這張書桌在我的客廳裡顯得氣勢非凡，融合了歷史與創新。每當我望著它，便會回想起自己為它付出的心力與情感，心中充滿了驕傲與喜悅，因為我成功地挽救了這件珍貴的傳家之寶。
base_en: 2 years ago, I inherited an old oak desk from my grandmother, a piece with a lot of history and charm. It was quite deteriorated, with cracked wood and peeling varnish, but I saw in it an opportunity and a challenge. I decided to restore it myself, something that required patience and technique, because I wanted to respect its original essence and beauty. I started by carefully sanding the surfaces and applying special products for the wood and hardware, a long but rewarding process. There were moments of frustration and doubt, especially with the most intricate and delicate parts, but the satisfaction of seeing it regain its splendor motivated me. Now the desk looks magnificent in my living room, a mix of history and renovation, and every time I look at it, I remember the effort and affection I put into it, and I feel proud and happy to have saved it.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture primarily requires thorough preparation and cleaning. First, carefully assess the furniture's overall condition, including the wood and hardware, to determine the necessary steps, such as repairing structural damage or replacing broken parts. Next, gently sand the surface with medium and fine grit sandpaper to remove old varnish or paint, ensuring a smooth and even surface. Then, apply an appropriate primer coat, which not only enhances the adhesion and durability of the new paint but also provides good protection for the wood, extending its lifespan. Afterward, choose your preferred paint or varnish and apply multiple thin coats to achieve a professional and durable result. Finally, apply a protective topcoat or wax to the furniture, allowing it to maintain its beautiful luster for a long time and enhancing its moisture resistance and wear resistance.
