This traditional method allows for enjoying high-quality tomatoes year-round, avoiding waste and extra expenses, while also obtaining a homemade and healthy product.
text_tgt_raw: 製作罐裝番茄是保存這種水果新鮮風味的絕佳方式，以便日後在各種食譜與燉菜裡使用。這個過程通常會選擇成熟、結實且沒有瑕疵的番茄，最好是羅馬番茄或梨形番茄等品種，因為它們水分較少，果肉也比較多。洗淨後，將番茄稍微燙一下以方便去皮，接著依據醬料或湯品的所需質地，將它們壓碎或切塊。隨後，會與鹽一起燉煮，也可選擇加入羅勒、奧勒岡等香草和香料，以增強香氣和風味。準備好後，將番茄裝入經過消毒的玻璃罐裡，然後進行隔水加熱——這是一種巴氏殺菌和密封的方法——持續15到30分鐘，以確保其保存和食用安全。這種傳統方法讓一年四季都能享用到高品質的番茄，避免浪費與額外開銷，同時也能獲得一份自製又健康的產品。
base_en: Making canned tomatoes is an excellent way to preserve the freshness and flavor of this fruit for later use in various recipes and stews. The process generally involves selecting ripe, firm, and blemish-free tomatoes, preferably varieties like Roma or pear, due to their lower water content and more pulp. After washing and briefly blanching them to easily peel them, they're crushed or cut into pieces, depending on the desired texture for sauces and broths. Subsequently, they're simmered with salt and, optionally, with herbs and spices like basil and oregano, to intensify the aroma and taste. Once prepared, the tomatoes are packed into sterilized glass jars and subjected to a bain-marie—a pasteurization and sealing method—for 15 to 30 minutes, ensuring their preservation and safety. This traditional method allows one to enjoy quality tomatoes throughout the year, avoiding waste and expenses, and obtaining a homemade and healthy product.

text_es: I still clearly remember that every summer, my grandmother and I would always make canned tomatoes together. This was a ritual full of hard work and a sense of accomplishment, and we always started busy in the early morning to take advantage of the cool light. We would buy several kilograms of ripe tomatoes, those with just the right color and aroma, and carefully select them one by one. Then, in the kitchen, accompanied by laughter, we would quickly wash, blanch, and peel them with years of accumulated experience and skilled techniques. The hum of the food processor and the bubbling of the sauce were the background music of those days, while steam and the aroma of basil and oregano filled every corner of the house. Although the work was tiring, the joy and pride we felt when we saw the pantry filled with gleaming cans completely offset our hard work. To this day, I still cherish some of those cans here; they are not only precious ingredients but also beautiful mementos of those unforgettable summers.
text_tgt_raw: 我至今仍清楚記得，每到夏天，外婆與我總會一起動手製作番茄罐頭。這是一項充滿辛勞與成就感的儀式，我們總是清晨就開始忙碌，為的是把握住清涼的光線。我們購買好幾公斤成熟的番茄，那種色澤與香氣都恰到好處的，並仔細地一顆顆挑選。接著，在廚房裡，伴隨著歡聲笑語，我們以長年累積的經驗和熟練的技巧，快速地清洗、汆燙並剝皮。食物調理機的嗡鳴聲與醬汁的沸騰聲，是那些日子的背景音樂，而蒸氣與羅勒、奧勒岡的香氣則瀰漫在屋子裡的每個角落。這份工作雖然疲憊，但看到儲藏室裡擺滿閃閃發光的罐頭時，那份喜悅和驕傲完全抵銷了我們的辛勞。直到今天，我這裡還珍藏著一些當時的罐頭，它們不僅是寶貴的食材，更是那些難忘夏日的美好印記。
base_en: I fondly remember how every summer, my grandmother and I would embark on the delightful task of making canned tomatoes. It was a ritual that blended hard work and satisfaction, always starting early to take advantage of the morning light and coolness. We would buy pounds and pounds of ripe tomatoes, the kind that had the perfect color and aroma, selecting them one by one with care and dedication. Then, in the kitchen, amid laughter and songs, we would wash, blanch, and peel them with a speed and skill that only years of experience and constant practice give you. The hum of the food mill and the bubbling of the sauce were the soundtrack to those days, while the steam and the scent of basil and oregano invaded every corner of the house. It was exhausting, yes, but the joy and pride of seeing the pantries full of gleaming jars compensated us for the effort and fatigue. Even today I still have some jars of those preserves, a true treasure and a reminder of those unforgettable summers.

text_es: Maintaining your bicycle isn't just about aesthetics; it's also about riding safety and durability, which is truly important. Regular maintenance can prevent expensive breakdowns and ensure optimal performance, and should never be overlooked. This includes checking tire pressure before each ride, cleaning and frequently lubricating the chain, and adjusting the brakes to keep them responsive at all times. We also shouldn't forget to check the condition of the gear cables and gears; if they aren't working smoothly, the riding experience will certainly not be ideal. In fact, good maintenance can extend the life of your bicycle, making every journey more enjoyable. It's really not complicated; it just requires a little time and attention.
text_tgt_raw: 維護腳踏車不單是為了美觀，更是關乎騎乘安全與耐用度，這著實為重要的事。定期保養能預防昂貴的故障，並確保最佳性能，絕不可輕忽。這當中包含每次騎乘前檢查胎壓、清潔並經常潤滑鏈條，以及調整煞車讓它們隨時保持靈敏。我們也不該忘記檢查變速線與齒輪的狀況，如果那裡運作不順暢，騎乘體驗肯定不理想。事實上，良好的維護能延長腳踏車的壽命，讓每次旅程都更加愉快。這真的不複雜，只需要投入一點點時間和關注。
base_en: Maintaining a bicycle isn't just a matter of aesthetics, but of safety and durability. Regular maintenance can prevent costly breakdowns and ensure optimal performance; it's not something to underestimate. This includes checking tire pressure before each ride, cleaning, and frequently lubricating the chain, and adjusting the brakes so they're always ready. We also shouldn't forget to check the condition of the cables and gears; if they don't work well, the pedaling experience won't be ideal. The truth is that good care prolongs the bike's lifespan and makes every trip more pleasant. It's really not complicated and only requires a little time and attention.

text_es: I still clearly remember the first time I tried to fix a bicycle; it really wasn't easy! My parents always said it wasn't something a child should do, but I was determined to learn. At the time, the chain was loose and the gears weren't working properly, so I decided to fix it myself. Using a simple set of tools I bought from a second-hand store and following online tutorial videos, I started to work diligently. Although I wouldn't call myself an expert, after about three hours of effort, even though the result wasn't perfect, I felt incredibly proud of my attempt, and that's what matters most, isn't it? From then on, I learned the basics of bicycle maintenance because I found this skill to be very practical.
text_tgt_raw: 我還清楚記得第一次嘗試修理腳踏車的經驗，那真不是件容易的事！爸媽總說這不是小孩子該做的，但我卻一心想學。當時鍊條鬆脫，變速器也無法正常運作，我便決定自己動手修好它。我用著從二手店買來的一套簡易工具，並參照網路上的教學影片開始埋頭苦幹，雖然稱不上什麼專家，但經過約三個小時的努力，結果雖不完美，我卻對自己的嘗試感到無比自豪，這才是最重要的，不是嗎？從那裡以後，我學會了腳踏車的基礎保養，因為我覺得這項技能非常實用。
base_en: I remember the 1st time I dared to maintain my own bicycle, it wasn't an easy task! My parents always told me that wasn't for kids, but I wanted to learn. The chain wasn't properly adjusted and the gear shift wasn't working, so I decided I could fix it. I got to work with a basic toolkit—which I had bought at a 2nd-hand store—and the help of an internet tutorial; I'm no expert, of course. After about 3 hours, the result wasn't perfect, but I felt proud of having tried; that's what's important, don't you think? Since then, I try to do the maintenance myself, it's a very useful skill.

text_es: To keep your bicycle in top condition, don't forget regular cleaning, which is crucial for its maintenance. You don't need to be a professional mechanic, but spending about 15 minutes every two weeks on basic maintenance can keep your bike looking new. Be sure to check tire pressure to avoid the embarrassment of a sudden flat tire while riding; also, don't forget chain lubrication, which you can do every hundred kilometers or when you notice the chain is dry. If you hear unusual noises while riding, don't ignore them; sometimes it's just a simple adjustment that can fix it. Furthermore, checking if the brakes and gears are working properly is not complicated, and doing so can effectively prevent bigger problems later on. We emphasize here that there is really no reason for us to neglect our bike's maintenance; it will repay you with a longer lifespan and a safer riding experience, allowing you to enjoy riding it everywhere, both online and in real life.
text_tgt_raw: 想讓您的自行車保持最佳狀態，別忘了定期清潔，這對其維護至關重要。您無須成為專業機械師，但每兩週花約15分鐘進行基本保養，就能讓愛車常保如新。務必檢查胎壓，以避免騎乘時突然發生爆胎的窘境；同時，鍊條潤滑也別忘了，每騎行一百公里或當您發現鍊條乾澀時，就可以進行保養。若騎乘時聽見異音，可別置之不理，有時那只是個簡單的調整就能解決。此外，檢查煞車和變速器是否運作正常也不複雜，如此能有效預防日後出現更大的問題。這裡強調，我們實在沒有理由忽略愛車的保養，它將會以更長的使用壽命和更安全的騎乘體驗來回報您，讓您能暢快地在網路或是現實裡，騎著它到處遊玩。
base_en: To start with your bicycle, don't forget regular cleaning; that's fundamental for good preservation. You don't need to be an expert mechanic, but you do have to dedicate about 15 minutes every 2 weeks for basic maintenance. Check the tire pressure—you don't want an unexpected flat—and lubricate the chain—it's not a bad idea every 100 km or if you notice it's dry. If you hear strange noises, don't ignore it: sometimes it's just a simple adjustment. It's also not complicated to check the brakes and gears to ensure they're working correctly; that will help you prevent bigger problems. There are no excuses to neglect your bike; it will thank you with a much longer lifespan and safer rides.

text_es: Organizing a farmers market is by no means an easy task, involving a great deal of planning and coordination. It's not just about finding a suitable location; that's merely the first step. You also have to identify and invite local farmers who are willing to participate—not everyone will happen to have availability—then apply for municipal permits and schedule a detailed timeline. Furthermore, promotional work absolutely cannot be neglected; the community must be informed that the market is open through various channels. We also cannot underestimate the logistical considerations of stall setup and waste management; these are crucial aspects that must be thoroughly thought out in advance. Although it's not always possible to be perfect and meet everyone's needs, the main goal remains to provide fresh agricultural products to everyone and support local producers. There is a lot of information and videos available for reference, and we believe that with a comprehensive plan, success can be brought to the market, allowing everyone to enjoy fresh produce within reach of a bus or taxi, without needing to order through online software.
text_tgt_raw: 籌辦農夫市集絕非易事，其中牽涉著大量規劃與協調工作。這不單單是找到一個合適的地點，那僅僅是第一步。您還得辨識並邀請願意參與的在地小農——並非所有人都剛好有空檔——接著還要申請市政許可，並排定詳細的時程。此外，宣傳工作絕對不能馬虎；必須透過各種管道讓社群知道市集開張了。我們也不能低估攤位設置與廢棄物管理的後勤考量，這些都是必須事前周全思考的關鍵環節。儘管無法總是盡善盡美，滿足所有人的需求，但主要目標仍是為大家提供新鮮的農產品，並支持在地生產者。這裡有許多的資料與影片可供參考，相信只要有完善的計畫，就能為市集帶來成功，讓大家在公車或計程車可達之處享受新鮮，而不需要透過網路軟體訂購。
base_en: Organizing a farmers market isn't an easy task, as it involves a lot of planning and coordination. It's not just about finding a location, that's only the 1st step. You have to identify local farmers who want to participate—not all of them have availability—secure municipal permits, and establish a schedule. Furthermore, we can't forget promotion; it's essential to communicate to the community that the market is open. We also shouldn't underestimate the logistics of the stalls and waste management, these are crucial aspects that must be considered in advance. It's not always possible to please everyone, but the main goal is to offer fresh products and support producers. I'm sure that a good plan can lead to success.

text_es: To organize a farmers market, the first step is actually not as complicated as one might imagine, as long as there is thorough planning. First, you need to find a suitable location that is easily accessible and doesn't have too many regulatory restrictions; this point is the most crucial. Next, actively contacting local small farmers is necessary; offering them a stall with reasonable rent and low initial investment will help attract them to join. Market promotion is also extremely important; you can't just open for business, you also need to actively publicize it. You can use social media, post posters, and even cooperate with surrounding businesses to let more people know there's a market here. Finally, maintain a consistent operating model and humbly accept suggestions from all sides, because a successful market cannot be built in a day, and you will gradually realize this during the process.
text_tgt_raw: 要籌辦一個農夫市集，第一步其實不若想像中複雜，只要有周全的規劃。首先，你需要找到一個合適的地點，那裡必須交通便利，而且法規限制不宜過多，這點最為關鍵。接著，主動聯繫當地小農是必要的，提供他們一個租金合理、初期投資不高的攤位，將有助於吸引他們加入。市場的推廣也極為重要，不能只是開張營業，還要積極宣傳。可以利用社群網路、張貼海報，甚至與周邊商家合作，讓更多人知道這裡有個市集。最後，保持一貫的營運模式並虛心接受各方建議，因為一個成功的市集不是一天就能建立的，這點你將在過程中慢慢體會著。
base_en: To organize a farmers market, the 1st step is clear: it isn't as complicated as it seems if you plan well. Start by identifying a suitable location, one that's accessible and where there aren't too many permits to manage—that's fundamental. Next, you need to contact local farmers; the key is to offer them a good space at a reasonable cost, because they don't have to invest much at the beginning. Promotion is also crucial; it's not enough to open, you have to advertise the market. Use social media, posters, and collaborate with neighborhood businesses, so people will know you're there. Finally, be consistent and listen to suggestions; a good market isn't built in 1 day, and this is something you'll learn over time.

text_es: I still remember that day when I decided to learn how to knit a scarf. To be honest, it wasn't my idea. My grandma, an expert knitter, told me, "It's not as hard as you think, you'll see." I was eighteen then and didn't really believe her, because my crafting skills had never been great. She taught me the basic knit and purl stitches. At first, I couldn't even knit a single stitch properly and didn't understand why the yarn kept getting tangled. But she patiently kept repeating, "Don't get discouraged, practice makes perfect." After three days and many frustrations, the stitches were no longer a mystery to me. Seeing the first row finally knit somewhat evenly, I felt a touch of pride; that moment was truly satisfying. Nowadays, every winter I wear that scarf—even though it's not perfect and some parts are loose—and I always warmly remember that experience.
text_tgt_raw: 我還記得那天，我決定學織圍巾。說實話，這並非我本意。我的奶奶，一位編織高手，對我說：「這沒你想的那麼難，妳會看到。」那時我十八歲，其實不太相信，因為我的手作能力向來不怎麼樣。她教我基本的平針和反針，剛開始我連一針都織不好，不明白為什麼線會纏成一團。但她仍舊耐心地重複著：「別灰心，熟能生巧。」經過三天與許多挫折後，針法對我來說不再是個謎團，看著第一排總算織得還算平整，心裡感到一絲驕傲；那個時刻真是令人滿足。如今，每個冬天我都會戴著那條圍巾——儘管它不完美，有些地方還鬆鬆的——心中總會溫馨地想起那段經驗。
base_en: I remember the day I decided to learn to knit a scarf; it wasn't my idea, to be honest. My grandmother, an expert with yarn, told me, "this isn't as hard as it seems, you'll see." At 18 years old, I wasn't very convinced, because my manual skills aren't my strong suit. She taught me the basic stitches, knit, and purl, and at 1st I couldn't even get one right; I didn't understand why the threads got so tangled. But she, patiently, repeated, "don't despair, practice makes perfect." After 3 days and a lot of frustration, the pattern was no longer a mystery and I felt a little proud to see the 1st row more or less straight; that moment was gratifying. Now, every winter, I wear that scarf—even though it's not perfect, it has some loose stitches—and I fondly remember the experience.

text_es: When it comes to starting to knit a scarf, first remember that it's not as hard as you might think; all you need is patience. You don't need to invest too much at the beginning; a pair of 5 or 6 mm knitting needles and one ball of medium-weight yarn are enough, as these are the most basic materials. Start by learning simple stitches, like the knit stitch or the garter stitch, and you'll find it's not that complicated. Once you master this basic technique, you'll see that you're not far from knitting other projects. Don't forget to count your stitches at the beginning and end of each row so your scarf doesn't mysteriously get narrower or wider. You'll find this to be a very relaxing and rewarding activity.
text_tgt_raw: 說到開始織圍巾，首先要記得這並不如想像中困難，只要有耐心就行了。一開始不必投入太多，準備一對5或6毫米的棒針和一球中等粗細的毛線就足夠了，這些都是最基本的材料。從簡單的織法開始學起，例如平針或上下針，你會發現其實沒那麼複雜。一旦你掌握了這種基礎技巧，你會看到自己離織出其他作品也不遠了。別忘了在每一行的開頭與結尾都要數好針數，這樣才不會讓圍巾莫名其妙地變窄或變寬。你會發現這是一項非常放鬆且有成就感的活動。
base_en: To start knitting a scarf, the 1st thing you can't forget is that it isn't as difficult as it seems, it just requires patience. There's no need to invest a lot at the beginning; 5 mm or 6 mm needles and a ball of medium-weight yarn are enough. This is the basic stuff. Start with a simple stitch, like the garter stitch or knit stitch, you'll see that it isn't very complicated. Once you master that technique, you'll see that you aren't so far from knitting other things. Don't forget to count your stitches at the beginning and end of each row so that the scarf doesn't unintentionally narrow or widen. You'll see that it's a very relaxing and rewarding activity.

text_es: Preparing for a move is never easy and requires careful planning to ensure everything goes smoothly, which is crucial for avoiding unnecessary stress. Never underestimate the time needed for packing, as people usually have more belongings than they realize. Don't forget to clearly label the contents and destination room on the outside of each box; this will be very helpful on moving day. Furthermore, booking a moving company or renting a truck should not be left until the last minute. It is definitely wise to get quotes from several companies and compare their services. Finally, be sure to remember to change the address information for all documents and online services to avoid any future trouble. Whether taking a bus, a taxi, or using various software to handle affairs, ensuring your address is updated will prevent subsequent problems.
text_tgt_raw: 準備搬家絕非易事，需要周密的規劃才能讓一切順利進行，這對避免不必要的壓力至關重要。千萬別低估打包所需的時間，因為人們通常擁有的物品總比自己想像的還多。別忘了在每個箱子外清楚標示內容物與目的地房間，這在搬家當天會非常有用。此外，預訂搬家公司或租用貨車也不能拖到最後一刻。多詢問幾家公司估價並比較他們的服務，絕對是明智之舉。最後，務必記得更改所有文件與網路服務的地址資料，以免日後產生任何困擾。無論是搭乘公車、計程車，還是使用各種軟體處理事務，確保地址更新才能避免後續的麻煩。
base_en: Preparing for a move isn't an easy task and requires meticulous planning for everything to go well. This is crucial to avoid unnecessary stress. Don't underestimate the time needed for packing, because one always has more things than they think. Don't forget to label all boxes with their contents and the destination room; that's very useful on moving day. You also can't leave hiring the moving company or renting the van until the last minute. It doesn't hurt to ask several companies for quotes and compare services. Finally, remember to change your address on all your documents and services so you don't have any surprises later.

text_es: If you're about to start a vegetable garden in the city, don't despair! It's much easier than you think. First, find a spot that gets at least six hours of sunlight every day; this is very important for almost all plants. Next, don't underestimate the importance of good soil; not just any dirt will do, well-drained and nutrient-rich soil is key. To start, don't plant too many varieties at once; begin with three to four crops you like and that are easy to grow, such as lettuce, spinach, or radishes, which will help you build confidence. Additionally, don't forget to water regularly, but avoid overwatering; too much water is actually bad. If you find pests, don't immediately use strong chemical agents; there are usually natural solutions available. Remember, you don't need to be a gardening expert; the key is to observe and learn from your plants.
text_tgt_raw: 如果您正要開始照料都市裡的菜園，請別感到絕望！這比您想像的要容易得多。首先，找一個每天至少有六小時日照的地方；這對幾乎所有植物來說都非常重要。接著，別輕忽優質土壤的重要性；不是隨便的土都行，排水良好且富含養分才為關鍵。一開始，別一下子種植太多種類；先從三到四種您喜歡且容易栽種的作物著手，例如萵苣、菠菜或蘿蔔，這將幫助您建立信心。此外，別忘了定期澆水，但要避免過度灌溉；過多的水反而不好。如果發現蟲害，別馬上使用強效化學藥劑；通常那裡都有天然的解決方案。請記住，您不需為一位園藝專家；關鍵在於觀察並從您的植物中學習。
base_en: If you're starting to take care of an urban garden, don't despair! It's easier than it seems. 1st, look for a place with at least 6 hours of direct sun; that's essential for almost all plants. Then, don't underestimate the importance of good substrate; not just any soil will do, it's vital that it has good drainage and nutrients. At 1st, don't plant too many things at once; start with 3 or 4 crops that you like and are easy, such as lettuce, spinach, or radishes—that will help you gain confidence. Also, don't forget to water regularly, but without overwatering; too much water isn't good. If you see pests, don't use strong chemical products immediately; often there are organic solutions. And remember, you don't have to be an expert; the key is to observe and learn from your plants.

text_es: Planning a train trip is actually not as complicated as one might imagine; instead, it can bring a completely different experience. First, deciding on the destination and dates is crucial so you can look for tickets early, which usually also ensures better prices. We must not underestimate the importance of itinerary flexibility, as some connections are limited. Additionally, be sure to confirm the seat type and services on the train, as not all trains offer the same facilities. Don't forget to book seats in advance, especially on popular routes, as this detail is very critical. On many journeys, passengers can also freely bring food and drinks on board, which not only saves you a lot of money but also makes the trip more relaxed. Through the internet, you can easily kick off this railway adventure, which is full of endless possibilities and magnificent scenery awaiting you.
text_tgt_raw: 規劃一趟火車旅行，其實並不如想像中複雜，反而能帶來截然不同的體驗。首先，決定目的地和日期至關重要，這樣才能提早尋找車票，通常也能確保較優惠的價格。我們切莫輕忽行程彈性的重要性，因為有些班次連結有限。此外，務必確認火車上的座位類型與服務項目，並非所有列車都提供相同的設施。別忘了預先訂位，尤其在熱門路線上，這項細節非常關鍵。許多旅程中，乘客也能自由攜帶食物與飲品上車，這不僅為您省下不少錢，也讓旅行更加輕鬆。透過網路，您就能輕鬆地為這趟鐵道冒險拉開序幕，這裡充滿著無限可能，那裡有著壯麗風光等待著您。
base_en: Planning a train trip isn't as complex as it seems and offers a different experience. It's essential to 1st decide on the destination and dates to be able to look for tickets in advance, as this usually guarantees better prices. One shouldn't underestimate the importance of schedule flexibility, as some connections are limited. It's always a good idea to check the different types of seats and services on board; not all trains have the same amenities. Don't forget to verify if you need to reserve a seat in advance—that's crucial on popular routes. Furthermore, you're free to bring your own food and drink on many journeys, which saves you some money. Finally, you're a click away from an adventure on rails.

text_es: Planning a train trip isn't actually difficult, as long as you master a few key steps. First, you need to decide on your destination and travel dates; don't wait until the last minute to make arrangements, because by then ticket prices might have already skyrocketed. Next, please go to the websites of various railway companies to check routes and timetables; there are many train services in Europe, and no single website can cover all the information, so it will take some time to search. If you plan to take multiple train journeys, you might consider buying a rail pass; this is not only convenient but can also save you a lot of money. Additionally, don't forget to reserve a seat, especially when taking high-speed trains or during peak travel season, to avoid arriving at the station and finding there are no empty seats in the carriage. I always arrive at the station early, because you never know if something unexpected might suddenly happen there!
text_tgt_raw: 規劃一趟火車旅行其實不難，只要掌握幾個關鍵步驟。首先，您得決定目的地和旅行日期，別等到最後一刻才安排，因為那時票價可能早已飆漲。接著，請到各鐵路公司的網站上查詢路線和時刻表；歐洲火車班次眾多，並沒有一個網站能涵蓋所有資訊，所以得花點時間搜尋。如果您計畫搭乘多趟火車，不妨考慮購買火車通行證，這不只方便，也能為您省下不少費用。此外，也別忘了預訂座位，特別是搭乘高速列車或在旅遊旺季期間，以免到站時發現車廂裡已沒有空位。我總是提早抵達車站，因為誰也說不準那裡會不會突然發生什麼狀況！
base_en: To plan a train trip, it isn't difficult if you follow a few key steps. The 1st thing you have to do is decide your destination and dates; it isn't good to leave it until the last minute, as prices can rise considerably. Look for routes and schedules on the railway companies' websites; there isn't a single website for all European trains, so it's better to do a little research. Consider buying a train pass if you're going to make several trips, that's very useful and saves you money. Don't forget to reserve seats either, especially on high-speed trains or if you're traveling in high season, because the train doesn't have to have free seats at the last minute. I'm one of those who always arrive at the station early—you never know what unforeseen event might arise!

text_es: Making your own bread at home is not only a very rewarding activity, but it's also not just for expert bakers. You don't need to stick to a single recipe; from classic white bread to more complex sourdough, there are all sorts of options online waiting for you to try. Getting started isn't actually difficult; you only need flour, water, yeast, and salt, though you can certainly get creative and add other ingredients. The whole process involves mixing ingredients, kneading the dough (which doesn't require too much effort), letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough expand and grow, and smelling the bread fill the room as it bakes, is truly a delightful experience. Furthermore, homemade bread contains no preservatives, and its flavor is simply incomparable to store-bought varieties; you surely won't regret trying it.
text_tgt_raw: 在家裡自己做麵包，不僅是種很有成就感的活動，也並非烘焙高手的專利。您不需拘泥於單一食譜，從經典的白麵包到較為複雜的酸種麵包，網路裡有著各式各樣的選擇等著您去嘗試。其實入門並不困難，只需要麵粉、水、酵母和鹽，當然您也可以發揮創意添加其他材料。整個過程包含混合食材、揉捏麵團（這不需太費力）、讓它發酵，然後烘烤。看著麵團膨脹長大，以及烘烤時滿室的麵包香，那真是令人愉悅的體驗。此外，自製麵包不含防腐劑，風味更是市售品所無法比擬的，相信您嘗試過後絕不會後悔。
base_en: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that isn't just for experts. You aren't limited to a single recipe; there's a wide variety of breads you can try, from classic white bread to more complex sourdough options. It isn't difficult to start; you just need flour, water, yeast, and salt, although that isn't all you can add. The process involves mixing the ingredients, kneading the dough—which doesn't have to be exhausting—letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough grow and the aroma that fills the kitchen while it bakes, that's a wonderful experience. Furthermore, homemade bread doesn't have preservatives and its flavor is incomparable to store-bought; you won't regret trying it.

text_es: If you want to take your first step into the world of home bread baking, don't feel too much pressure at first; it's actually not as complicated as you might think. First, you can start by looking for a basic white bread or whole wheat bread recipe; if you don't have enough confidence yet, it doesn't have to be European sourdough bread. The key here is patience and practice, these two are your best helpers, there are no shortcuts to making good bread. Please make sure you have the basic ingredients ready—flour, water, yeast, salt, and a reliable kitchen scale, because accuracy is very important. Don't forget, room temperature has a significant impact on dough fermentation. I dare say that after just two or three attempts, you will gradually master the knack, and the sense of accomplishment from baking your own bread will definitely surprise you again and again.
text_tgt_raw: 想要在自家烘焙麵包的世界裡踏出第一步，一開始可別感到壓力太大，它其實沒有想像中那麼複雜。首先，可以從尋找一份基本款的白麵包或全麥麵包食譜著手，如果您還沒有足夠信心，不一定非得是歐式酸種麵包。這裡的關鍵在於耐心和實踐，這兩者是您最好的幫手，製作好麵包並沒有捷徑。請確認您已備妥基本材料——麵粉、水、酵母、鹽，以及一個可靠的磅秤，因為精確度非常重要。別忘了，室內溫度對麵團的發酵影響甚鉅。我敢說，只要試個兩三次，您就會漸漸掌握訣竅，而且親手烘焙出屬於自己的麵包，那份成就感絕對會讓您感到驚喜連連。
base_en: If you want to get started in the world of making bread at home, don't stress at 1st; it isn't as complicated as it seems. The 1st thing is to look for a basic recipe for white or whole wheat bread, it doesn't have to be sourdough if you don't feel confident yet. This is key: patience and practice are your best allies, there are no shortcuts to good bread. Make sure you've the essential ingredients—flour, water, yeast, salt—and a reliable scale; precision is important. Don't forget that room temperature greatly influences the rising. I'm sure that with 2 or 3 tries, you'll start to get the hang of it and you'll be surprised how rewarding it's to bake your own bread.

text_es: Adopting a dog is not just about bringing an animal home; it's a serious commitment that will completely change your life and theirs. Before making this decision, be sure to carefully consider many factors: Do you have enough time to walk them and take good care of them? Is your home suitable for a dog? Don't rush; you should carefully consider which breed and size best fits your lifestyle, as large dogs and small dogs have different needs. Many shelters have animals desperately in need of a home; they ask for nothing in return, only love and care, which is truly the most important thing. You are preparing to give a life a second chance, and the unconditional love you receive from them is priceless. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life but also free up shelter space for other animals in need.
text_tgt_raw: 領養一隻狗不單是把一個動物帶回家裡，這更是一個嚴肅的承諾，會徹底改變你和牠們的生活。在做出這個決定之前，務必仔細考慮許多因素：你是否有足夠的時間帶牠散步並好好照料牠？你的家裡是否適合養狗？千萬別著急，應當好好思量哪種犬種和體型最符合你的生活方式，畢竟大型犬與小型犬的需求為不同。許多收容所裡有著急需一個家的動物，牠們不求回報，只要愛與關懷，這確實是最重要的事情。你正準備給一個生命第二次機會，而從牠那裡收穫的無條件的愛更是無價的。此外，透過領養，你不僅拯救了一個生命，也能為其他有需要的動物騰出收容空間。
base_en: Adopting a dog isn't just bringing an animal home; it's a serious commitment and a decision that will change your life and theirs. Before taking the step, it's essential to consider several factors: do you've time to walk and care for it? Is your home suitable for a dog? There's no rush, think carefully about the breed and size that best suits your lifestyle, because a large dog isn't the same as a small one. Many shelters have animals that need a home and ask for nothing in return, only love and care. That's the most important thing, really. You're about to give a 2nd chance to a living being, and the unconditional love you receive in return is priceless. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life, but you also free up space for another animal in need.

text_es: Before deciding to adopt a dog, you must think carefully, as this is not a decision to be made lightly. First, please carefully consider how much time you can commit, because dogs are not just companions; they also need walks, playtime, and daily affection. Are you willing to provide these for them? Second, considering your financial situation is also extremely important; never underestimate the expenses for food, vet bills, and various accessories, as these are not cheap. If you live in an apartment, don't forget that some dog breeds need more space than others, which is by no means a minor factor. Finally, we suggest you can look for your new family member at a shelter or foster home. There, you can not only find the most suitable companion for you but also help an animal in desperate need of love. In this way, you are not just adopting a pet, but saving a life, which is truly meaningful.
text_tgt_raw: 在決定認養狗狗之前，務必深思熟慮，這並非一件能輕率做出的決定。首先，請仔細衡量自己能投入多少時間，因為狗狗不只是陪伴，牠們還需要散步、玩耍，以及每天的關愛。您是否願意為牠們付出這些呢？其次，考量經濟狀況也極為重要，千萬別小看飼料、獸醫費用和各種配件的開銷，這些都不低廉。如果您居住在公寓裡，請別忘了有些犬種需要比其他狗狗更多的活動空間，這絕非次要的因素。最後，建議您可以到收容所或中途之家尋找您的新家人。在那裡，您不僅能找到最適合您的夥伴，更能幫助一隻亟需關愛的動物。如此一來，您不只是認養了一隻寵物，更是拯救了一個生命，這才是真正有意義的。
base_en: Before adopting a dog, it's essential to be well-informed; it's not a decision that should be taken lightly. Think about the time you're going to dedicate to it, because a dog isn't just companionship, it needs walks, games, and daily attention. Are you willing to do that? Also consider your economic situation; you shouldn't underestimate the costs of food, vet, and accessories, they aren't exactly low. If you live in an apartment, don't forget that certain breeds need more space than others; it's not a minor factor. Look for a shelter or rescue; not only will you find the perfect companion, but you'll also help an animal in need. That way, you don't just adopt a pet, but you save a life, and that's what really matters.

text_es: Yesterday, I started assembling the new shelf I bought, and it was quite a challenge. The box stated it could be completed in an hour, but for someone like me with no experience, that was probably just a joke. I'm really not skilled with tools like screwdrivers, and that became evident during the process. To make matters worse, the instructions were like a foreign language; the diagrams inside were absolutely no help. I think it took about three hours before the shelf even started to look somewhat assembled, no exaggeration! Honestly, the final product is decent, and although a few shelves aren't perfectly level, I definitely don't want to go through that assembly experience again anytime soon.
text_tgt_raw: 昨天我著手組裝新買的置物架，這真是一項不小的挑戰。盒子外標示著一小時即可完成，但對於我這種毫無經驗的人來說，那裡可能只會是個笑話。我對螺絲起子這類工具實在不怎麼熟練，過程中也顯露無遺。更糟的是，說明書簡直像天書一般，裡頭的圖示完全幫不上忙。我想大概過了三小時，這架子才開始有那麼一點樣子，一點都不誇張！老實說，最終成品還算可以，雖然有幾層板子沒有完全水平，但我短期內絕對不想再經歷一次這種組裝體驗。
base_en: Yesterday I embarked on the adventure of assembling a shelf I bought, and it wasn't easy at all. The box indicated 1 hour for assembly, but of course, that's not possible for someone without experience. I don't have much skill with screwdrivers, and that was noticeable. The instructions, moreover, weren't very clear, a real hieroglyph that wasn't very helpful. I think about 3 hours passed before the structure started to take shape, no joke! The final result, to be honest, isn't bad at all, although a couple of shelves aren't perfectly level. I definitely don't want to repeat the experience soon.

text_es: Assembling shelves might seem simple, but in practice, it's not as easy as you'd think—and that's no joke! Before you start, make sure all the parts and tools listed in the instructions are ready. There's nothing more frustrating than realizing you're missing a screw halfway through assembly. I recommend cleaning your work area first so you don't trip over things or kick them around. Before tightening the first screw, be sure to read the instructions carefully twice. This is crucial for avoiding mistakes, as the assembly order isn't always obvious. If the shelves are large, don't hesitate to ask for help; this isn't a competition, and you don't have to do it alone. Once everything is done, remember to check for stability. You definitely don't want everything to tumble down due to an oversight the first time you place items on it.
text_tgt_raw: 組裝層架看似簡單，但實際操作起來可沒想像中那樣輕鬆，這可不是開玩笑的！在動手前，務必確認說明書裡列出的所有零件與工具都已備齊，沒有什麼比組裝到一半才發現缺了一顆螺絲更令人沮喪的了。我會建議先將工作區域清理乾淨，這樣才不會這裡絆到、那裡踢到。在鎖上第一顆螺絲前，請務必將說明書仔細閱讀兩遍，這對於避免錯誤至關重要，因為有時候組裝順序並不明顯。如果層架體積較大，別猶豫尋求協助；這不是一場比賽，您不必獨自完成。當一切都完成後，記得檢查一下穩定性，您肯定不希望在第一次放置物品時，所有東西都因為一個不經意的疏忽而傾倒下來。
base_en: Assembling a shelf, although it seems simple, isn't as easy as many people think—no joke! Before starting, make sure you've all the parts and tools indicated in the manual; there's nothing more frustrating than realizing you're missing a screw halfway through the process. I recommend clearing the work area well, so you aren't tripping over other things. Read the instructions 2 full times before tightening the 1st screw; this is crucial to avoid mistakes. Sometimes the assembly order isn't obvious. If the shelf is large, don't hesitate to ask for help; you don't have to do it alone, and this isn't a competition. When finished, check the stability; you don't want all the contents to fall at the 1st oversight.

text_es: To have a carefree vacation, saving beforehand is crucial, and it's not just about money. Thorough planning is key, like itemizing budgets for transportation, accommodation, dining, and activities, to avoid unexpected situations. Additionally, it's very necessary to prepare an emergency fund for unforeseen circumstances. A good strategy is to regularly deposit a fixed amount of money into a dedicated savings account each month; this habit is very effective. Furthermore, search online early for deals and discounts, because those often don't appear at the last minute. Reducing unnecessary daily expenses, such as daily coffee or eating out, can also accumulate considerable savings, which doesn't mean you have to completely give up all enjoyment. Imagine yourself working hard for an unforgettable future trip, where there are charming sights and delicious food, and you can easily get there whether by bus or taxi.
text_tgt_raw: 為了一趟無憂無慮的假期，事先儲蓄可說是至關重要，這不僅僅是錢的問題。周全的規劃是關鍵，像是詳列交通、住宿、餐飲和活動的預算，才能避免突發狀況。另外，為不可預見的緊急情況準備一筆備用金也很有必要。一個好策略是每月固定提撥一筆錢到專用儲蓄帳戶裡，這個習慣非常有效。此外，提早搜尋網路上的優惠和折扣，因為那些往往不會在最後一刻才出現。減少不必要的日常開銷，例如每天的咖啡或外食，也能累積可觀的儲蓄，這並不表示你得完全放棄所有享受。想像著自己正為一段難忘的未來旅程努力著，那裡有著迷人的風景和美食，無論是搭公車還是計程車，都能輕鬆抵達。
base_en: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries; it isn't just a matter of money. Planning ahead is key; that's, establishing a detailed budget for transportation, accommodation, meals, and activities, so there are no surprises. It doesn't hurt to consider an emergency fund for unforeseen events. A good strategy is to allocate a fixed amount each month to a specific savings account; that's a habit that works very well. In addition, you can look for offers and discounts in advance, as they often aren't available at the last minute. Reducing superfluous daily expenses—like coffees or meals out—can generate considerable savings, and this doesn't mean giving up everything. You're building an unforgettable future trip.

text_es: For my next trip, I've been diligently saving money for six months, and honestly, it hasn't been easy. Every month I set a fixed savings goal, but unexpected expenses always pop up, preventing me from sticking to my original plan. The problem is that I love to travel, but my budget isn't unlimited. This is truly an ongoing challenge, and I'm not even sure if I'll be able to save enough money this time! For example, my car broke down this month, and that expense wasn't in my plan, so a portion of my savings went to car repairs. Despite these setbacks, the thought of those ten days relaxing by the sea is the greatest motivation for me.
text_tgt_raw: 為了下次旅行，我已經努力存了六個月的錢，老實說，這真的不容易。每個月我都會設定一個固定金額的儲蓄目標，但總是會有意料之外的開銷跑出來，導致我無法照著原先的計畫執行。問題就在於我熱愛旅行，但預算卻不是無限的。這真是一個持續的挑戰，我甚至不確定這次能不能順利存夠錢！舉例來說，這個月我的車壞了，這筆開銷並沒有在我的規劃裡，所以一部分的積蓄就為修車花掉了。儘管遇到這些挫折，但一想到那十天在海邊放鬆的時光，就沒有什麼比這更能激勵我了。
base_en: I've been saving for 6 months for my next vacation and, honestly, it's not easy at all. Every month I set out to save a fixed amount, but some unexpected expense always comes up and I can't stick to the plan. The problem is that I love to travel and my budget isn't unlimited. This is a constant challenge—I'm not sure if I'll make it this time! For example, this month the car broke down and that wasn't planned, so part of my savings went to the repair. Despite the setbacks, there's nothing that motivates me more than thinking about those 10 days of relaxation on the beach.

text_es: Learning a new language is a rich experience that can open doors to different cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just about memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's about immersing yourself in the core spirit of a community. Although it can be challenging at first, the sense of accomplishment that comes from understanding and communicating fluently is incomparable. Without a doubt, this is an invaluable skill in today's globalized world. You don't need to be a genius to learn it, just dedicate time and practice consistently, after all, you're not learning to fly a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task; there are many tools and resources available online, ranging from various language learning apps on your phone to in-person classes with local teachers. It's a journey that, while sometimes not easy, is definitely worth it.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一門新語言是個豐富的經歷，能為我們開啟通往不同文化與全新思維方式的大門。這不單單是記憶詞彙和文法而已；更是讓自己沉浸在一個社群的核心精神裡。儘管一開始會充滿挑戰，但能流利地理解並溝通所帶來的成就感是無可比擬的。毫無疑問，這在今日全球化的世界裡是一項無價的技能。你不需要是個天才才能學會，只要投入時間並持續練習即可，畢竟你不是在學習駕駛太空船。此外，這也不必是個孤單的任務；網路上有許多工具和資源可供利用，從手機裡的各種語言學習軟體，到和當地老師面對面交流的課程都應有盡有。這是一趟旅程，雖然有時不輕鬆，但絕對值得。
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's immersing oneself in the essence of a community. Although it can be challenging at 1st, there's no greater reward than understanding and communicating fluently in another language. This is, without a doubt, an invaluable skill in today's globalized world. You don't have to be a genius to achieve it, it just requires dedication and constant practice—you're not learning to pilot a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task; there are many tools and resources available, from mobile apps to classes with native teachers. It's a journey that, although sometimes not easy, is always worth it.

text_es: Learning a new language, in my case Chinese, is definitely not easy. At first, pronunciation seemed difficult to grasp; there are almost no sounds in Chinese similar to Spanish, which was truly frustrating. I still remember during the first week of class, I tried hard to imitate the tones, but the teacher always said, "No, not like that." At that time, I really felt like I couldn't learn it no matter what, despite putting in a lot of effort. It took three months before I started to distinguish between tones and vocabulary, but even then, I still couldn't really understand videos without subtitles. This isn't to say I wasn't learning anything, but the speed of speech and context were huge challenges for me. But I will persevere because I know that with continuous practice, I will master this language someday.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一門新語言，以我來說是中文，絕非易事。起初，發音似乎難以掌握；中文裡幾乎沒有和西班牙語相似的音，這著實令人沮喪。我還記得第一週上課時，我努力模仿聲調，老師卻總是說：「不對，不是那樣。」那時候我真的覺得自己怎麼學都學不好，儘管付出了很多努力。過了三個月，我才開始能區分聲調和詞彙，但即便如此，沒有字幕的影片我還是聽不太懂。這並不是說我沒有學到東西，而是語速和上下文對我來說都是巨大的挑戰。但我會堅持下去，因為我知道只要持續練習，總有一天我會熟練掌握這門語言的。
base_en: Starting to learn a new language, Mandarin Chinese in my case, isn't an easy task, I assure you. At 1st, the pronunciation seemed impossible to master; there are no sounds similar to Spanish and that's frustrating. I remember the 1st week with the teacher, when I was trying to imitate the tones and he would tell me: "No, it's not like that." I felt like I wasn't doing it well, despite my effort. After 3 months, I finally started to distinguish the tones and words, but even so, when I watch a movie without subtitles, I don't understand almost anything. It's not that I haven't learned, but that speed and context are challenges. I'm determined to continue, because I know that mastery will come with constant practice.

text_es: Learning a new language is definitely very rewarding, but it's not something that happens overnight. During the process, you need continuous dedication and patience, and even if it feels difficult at first, please don't get discouraged easily. Immersive learning is crucial: you can listen to music or watch original videos with subtitles, and more importantly, try to speak from day one, even if it's just a few words. Don't underestimate the power of making mistakes; learning inherently involves errors, so please don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't one perfect software or online method that works for everyone; the most important thing is to try and find what works best for you. With this persistence, you will find that your progress has no limits, and you will soon be able to communicate fluently.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一門新語言絕對是件令人獲益良多的事，但這並非一蹴可幾。過程中，您需要持續的投入與耐心，即使一開始感到困難，也請別輕易氣餒。沉浸式的學習至關重要：您可以聽音樂，或觀看帶有字幕的原文影片，更重要的是，從第一天起就試著開口說，即便只是幾個字也沒關係。別低估犯錯的力量，學習本就包含著錯誤，所以請別害怕犯錯。再者，沒有一套軟體或網路上的完美方法能適用於所有人，最重要的是去嘗試並找出最適合您的方式。有了這份堅持，您會發現您的進步沒有極限，很快就能流暢地溝通了。
base_en: Learning a new language is a very rewarding experience, but it's not something that happens overnight. You need consistency and patience; don't despair if it seems difficult at 1st. Immersion is key: listen to music, watch series or movies in their original version with subtitles, and try to speak from the 1st day, even if it's just a few words—that's essential. Don't underestimate the power of mistakes; you're learning and making mistakes is part of the process, so don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't one single perfect methodology for everyone, experiment, and discover what works best for you. You'll see that with dedication, your progress has no limits and soon you'll be communicating fluently.

text_es: Participating in a community fun run usually doesn't focus on professional competition, but rather is open to everyone interested in sports, allowing people of all fitness levels to join in. These non-elite events typically set fixed distances like five or ten kilometers, with runners speeding along city streets or dedicated paths, and without strict age limits. Their main purpose is often to enjoy the process of exercise and promote a healthy lifestyle, and many times it's for charity fundraising, rather than just pursuing personal best times. Registration fees are usually reasonable and include a bib, a commemorative T-shirt, and post-race refreshments. This is an excellent opportunity to connect with friends who share similar interests and enjoy the lively atmosphere there. I particularly like these types of events because the cheers from spectators along the way and the festive atmosphere make the entire experience especially satisfying; you definitely won't regret participating.
text_tgt_raw: 參加一場全民路跑活動，通常並非著重於專業競技，而是開放給所有對運動有興趣的民眾，不論體能高低都能共襄盛舉。這種非精英性質的活動，多半設定五公里或十公里等固定距離，跑者在城市街道或專用路徑上奔馳，且沒有嚴格的年齡限制。其主要目的往往是享受運動過程、提倡健康生活，許多時候更是為了慈善募款，而非僅僅追求個人最佳成績。報名費用通常合理，並會提供號碼布、紀念T恤與完賽補給等。這不失為一個極佳的機會，能與有著相同愛好的朋友交流，享受那裡熱絡的氛圍。我特別喜歡這類活動，因為沿途觀眾的加油聲與熱鬧的氣氛，讓整個體驗格外令人滿足，你絕對不會後悔參加。
base_en: Running a popular race is participating in a non-professional sporting event, open to everyone regardless of their physical level; it isn't an elite competition. Normally, predefined distances like 5 km or 10 km are covered through urban streets or paths, and there's no age limit to participate. The main objective is usually to enjoy the experience, promote healthy habits, and, in many cases, support a charitable cause; it isn't just for a personal best. Registration isn't excessively expensive and usually includes a bib, a commemorative t-shirt, and refreshments. It's an excellent opportunity to socialize and meet people with similar interests—this is something I really like. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere and the encouragement of the people make it a very rewarding experience; you won't regret it.

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is a truly satisfying process; it not only allows old objects to regain their former glory but also extends their lifespan. This is by no means an easy task, involving a series of meticulous steps, from thorough cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and refinishing. We must carefully identify the type of wood and original finish so that we can select appropriate restoration software and products, as not all materials are compatible. Typically, this work tests patience and skill, and if you encounter uncertainties, don't be afraid to seek help from others. Furthermore, don't forget that traditional techniques often yield the best results, even if they aren't always the fastest. The ultimate goal is to restore the furniture to its original splendor, rather than making it look like it just came out of a factory, while also preserving the unique marks left by time.
text_tgt_raw: 修復古董家具實為一項令人滿足的過程，它不僅能讓老物件重現昔日風華，更能延續其使用壽命。這絕非簡易任務，裡頭牽涉一系列細緻步驟，從徹底清潔、修復結構損壞，到打磨、重新上漆等。我們必須仔細辨識木材種類與原始塗料，這樣才能選用合適的修復軟體與產品，因為不是所有材料都能兼容並用。通常，這項工作考驗著耐心與技巧，若遇到不確定的地方，也別害怕向他人尋求協助。此外，也別忘了傳統技術往往能帶來最佳效果，儘管它們不一定是最快速的。最終目標是讓家具恢復其原有光彩，而非將其變得像是剛從工廠裡出來的新品，同時也保留著歲月在上面留下的獨特痕跡。
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that not only recovers its original beauty, but also extends its useful life. It isn't a simple task, as it involves a series of meticulous steps, from deep cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and applying new finishes. It's important to identify the type of wood and the original finish to choose the right products, since not all of them are compatible with every material. Often, this is a job that requires patience and skill, and one shouldn't be afraid to ask for help if one isn't sure. Nor should one forget that traditional techniques are usually the ones that offer the best results, although they aren't always the fastest. The final goal is to return the furniture to its splendor without erasing the traces of time that give it character; it isn't about making it look factory new.

text_es: I remember the first time I tried to repair an old piece of furniture; it was an unforgettable learning experience. It was a small cabinet passed down from my grandmother, and honestly, its condition wasn't very good. The drawers wouldn't close properly, the wood color was uneven, and it felt like a thousand stories were hidden inside. At first, I didn't know where to start, but that didn't deter me; I looked up many tutorial videos online and consulted a knowledgeable friend. Although the finished product wasn't perfect, it holds immense sentimental value for me, and I'm proud that I was able to restore it. This cabinet is no longer in the attic; it sits in the living room, looking very beautiful, and I look at it with loving eyes almost every day.
text_tgt_raw: 我記得第一次嘗試修復一件老舊家具時，那真是一次難忘的學習經驗。那是我祖母傳下來的一個小櫃子，老實說，它的狀況並不是很好。抽屜關不緊，木頭顏色也不均勻，感覺裡頭藏著千百個故事。起初，我不知道該從哪裡開始著手，但這並沒有讓我卻步；我上網路找了很多教學影片，也向一位懂行的朋友請教。雖然成品不盡完美，但我對它充滿情感價值，也為自己能修復它感到驕傲。這個櫃子現在已不在閣樓裡了，它就擺在客廳裡，看起來非常漂亮，我幾乎每天都會用充滿愛意的眼神看著它。
base_en: I remember the 1st time I tried to restore an old piece of furniture, it was a learning experience. It was a small dresser from my grandmother, and it wasn't in very good condition, to be honest. The drawers didn't close well and the wood wasn't a uniform color, it seemed to have a thousand stories to tell. At 1st, I didn't know where to start, but this didn't discourage me; I looked for tutorials online and asked a friend who does know about these things. I'm proud of the result, although it's not perfect, it has a lot of sentimental value for me. The dresser is no longer in the attic, now it looks beautiful in the living room and there isn't a day that I don't look at it with affection.

text_es: To restore an antique piece of furniture, I would advise you to first fully understand the relevant knowledge, as this is by no means a task to be taken lightly. First, be sure to research its style and wood type, which is crucial for choosing appropriate products and avoiding damage to the furniture. Never rush; thorough planning is the key to success. If there isn't enough space here, or if you lack basic tools, please wait patiently. A large workshop is not necessary, but a well-ventilated and clean area is absolutely required. Before applying any product to the main surface, be sure to test it in an inconspicuous area, as you cannot predict how the wood will react. If there are woodworms in the furniture, never attempt to restore it before thoroughly treating them, otherwise the infestation may spread. Remember, this is not just about repainting, but about restoring its original essence.
text_tgt_raw: 要修復一件古董傢俱，我會建議您先充分瞭解相關知識，這絕非一件可以輕忽的任務。首先，務必研究其風格與木材種類，這對於選擇合適的產品並避免損壞傢俱至關重要。切勿操之過急，完善的規劃是成功的關鍵；如果這裡空間不足，或缺乏基本工具，請耐心等待。一個大型工作室並非必要，但通風且乾淨的區域是絕對需要的。在任何產品塗抹到主要表面之前，請務必先在隱蔽處進行測試，因為您無法預知木材會有何種反應。如果傢俱裡有蛀蟲，切勿在未徹底處理前嘗試修復，否則蟲害可能會擴散。請記著，這不只是重新上漆，而是要恢復其原有的精髓。
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, my 1st recommendation is to inform yourself well; it's not a task that should be taken lightly. Start by researching the style and the wood, as this is fundamental for choosing the right products and not damaging the piece. Don't rush; good planning is key; if there isn't adequate space or you don't have the basic tools, wait. A large workshop isn't essential, but a ventilated and clean area is. Always do tests on a hidden part before applying any product to the main surface, because you don't know how the wood will react. If the furniture has woodworm, don't try to restore it without 1st treating it thoroughly—you don't want it to spread. Remember that it's not just about painting, but about restoring its essence.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party can be an exciting endeavor, but making everything perfect is actually not as simple as it seems. First, you need to decide on the party theme, budget, and guest list; if you want a cozy atmosphere, keep the list short. Next, the choice of venue is crucial, as celebrating at home is a completely different experience from renting a venue, and this part requires thorough planning. You also need to consider the catering, not forgetting allergen issues, and how to decorate to create the desired atmosphere. To ensure attendees have a good time, consider planning some games or activities, especially if there are children present, and playing music to enhance the mood is essential. I believe good organization and planning will ultimately allow the host to fully enjoy the celebration as well.
text_tgt_raw: 籌辦一場生日派對可說是件令人興奮的事，然而要讓一切盡善盡美，著實不像表面上看起來那麼簡單。首先，您得決定派對主題、預算，以及賓客名單，如果想辦得溫馨，名單可別太長。再來，場地的選擇極為關鍵，畢竟在家裡慶祝與租借場地為之，體驗上截然不同，這部分需要周詳的規劃。您還得考慮餐飲，別忘了過敏原問題，以及如何佈置才能營造出想要的氣氛。為了讓與會者盡興，不妨規劃一些遊戲或活動，特別是當這裡有孩子的時候，放些音樂來增添氣氛更是不可或缺。我相信良好的組織與規劃，最終能讓主人也能盡情享受這場慶祝活動。
base_en: Organizing a birthday party is an exciting task, although it isn't as simple as it seems if you want everything to turn out perfectly. 1st, you must decide on the theme, the budget, and the guest list, which shouldn't be excessively long if you're looking for something intimate. The choice of venue is key, as celebrating at home isn't the same as renting a space; this is something that requires planning. You also have to think about the food and drinks—don't forget allergies—as well as the decoration to create the desired atmosphere. To entertain the attendees, it's a good idea to plan games or activities, especially if there are children, and it doesn't hurt to consider some music to set the mood. Finally, I'm sure that good organization guarantees that the host can also enjoy the celebration.

text_es: Preparing for my 30th birthday party has been a long journey, and not easy at all! First, there was the guest list. How easy is it to invite thirty people without breaking a sweat? Then there was the venue. I don't have a spacious garden here, so I searched everywhere for a place that could accommodate everyone, and honestly, that was definitely the most complicated part. A place that can hold ten people is completely different from one that can hold thirty, and I didn't want any guest to be without a comfortable seat. The food wasn't simple either; pizza or paella, I couldn't decide. Finally, to make sure everyone had a good time, I chose both, although I'm not sure if that was the best idea. However, the most important thing is for everyone to have fun, right? That's the real "software" that brings meaning to the party!
text_tgt_raw: 籌備我三十歲的生日派對真是一段漫長的旅程，一點都不輕鬆！首先是賓客名單，要邀請三十個人而不費吹灰之力，這談何容易？接著是場地，我這裡沒有寬敞的花園，所以我到處尋找能容納所有人的地方，老實說，這絕對是最複雜的部分。一個能容納十個人的地方跟三十個人的可是完全不一樣，我可不希望任何一位賓客沒有舒適的座位。餐點方面也不簡單，披薩或西班牙海鮮燉飯，我遲遲無法決定。最後，為了讓大家盡興，我選擇了兩者兼具，儘管我也不確定這是不是最好的主意。然而，最重要的是大家都能玩得開心，不是嗎？這才是真正為派對帶來意義的軟體！
base_en: Planning my 30th birthday party was an odyssey—it wasn't easy at all! 1st, the guest list, who invites 30 people without breaking a sweat? Then, the venue: I don't have a huge garden, so I looked for a place with capacity for everyone; this is the most complicated part, honestly. A place for 10 isn't the same as one for 30. I didn't want anyone to be without a good seat. The catering wasn't simple either: I couldn't decide between pizza or paella. In the end, I opted for a mix to please everyone, although I'm not sure if it was the best idea. The important thing is that everyone has fun, right? That's what really matters!

text_es: Caring for indoor plants is not as complicated as one might imagine, but it does require time and basic knowledge. First, light is key; not all plants need the same intensity of sunlight, so you must research each plant's specific needs to prevent them from burning or growing poorly. Watering is also extremely important: there are no fixed rules here, as it depends on the plant type, pot size, and season, but generally speaking, it's better to underwater than overwater. Furthermore, environmental humidity and temperature are factors that cannot be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget to fertilize in spring and summer at the appropriate time to provide them with nutrients that are lacking in the potting soil.
text_tgt_raw: 照顧室內植物並不若想像中複雜，但確實需要投入時間與具備基礎知識。首先，光照是關鍵；並非所有植物都需要相同強度的陽光，因此必須研究每種植物的特定需求，以免它們灼傷或生長不良。澆水也極為重要：這裡沒有固定的準則，因為這取決於植物種類、盆栽大小和季節，但總體來說，寧可少澆也不要過量。此外，環境濕度與溫度也是不可忽略的因素，尤其對於熱帶植物為甚。別忘了在春天與夏天適時施肥，為它們提供盆栽土壤裡所缺乏的養分。
base_en: Caring for houseplants isn't as complicated as it seems, but it does require attention and basic knowledge. The 1st thing to consider is light; not all plants need the same intensity, so it's essential to research the specific needs of each species so they don't burn or fail to grow. Watering is also crucial: there isn't a fixed rule, as this depends on the type of plant, the size of the pot, and the season, but in general, it's better to water less than excessively. Furthermore—this is important—ambient humidity and temperature are factors that can't be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget occasional fertilization, especially in spring and summer, to provide them with the nutrients they don't find in the potting soil.

text_es: For me, taking care of the plants at home is more than just a hobby; it’s almost a life philosophy. I remember when I first started, it wasn’t easy; my first two plants, the poor little things, didn't survive three weeks because I knew nothing about their needs back then. However, about five years later, my home has become a jungle, with nearly twenty plants, each with its own unique personality and temperament, and I swear this is no exaggeration. If one of them isn't happy, it immediately "tells" me with its leaves, and of course, I always pay attention to those small details to prevent bigger problems from occurring. It's actually not as complicated as it seems at first glance; you just need to observe them and give them a little love, and that's enough.
text_tgt_raw: 對我來說，照顧家裡的植物不只是一個嗜好，它幾乎是一種生活哲學。我記得剛開始時，這並不容易；我那前兩盆植物，可憐的小東西們，都沒活過三個禮拜，因為那時我對它們的需求一無所知。然而，大約五年後的今天，我的家裡儼然成了一座叢林，裡頭有將近二十盆植物，每一盆都著有其獨特的個性和脾氣，我發誓這絕無誇張。如果其中一盆不開心，它會立刻用葉子「告訴」我，而我當然總是留意著那些小細節，以避免更大的問題發生。這其實不像乍看之下那麼複雜，你只需要觀察它們，並給予它們一點愛，就為足夠。
base_en: Taking care of houseplants, for me, isn't just a hobby, it's almost a philosophy of life. I remember that at 1st, this wasn't easy; my 1st 2 plants, poor things, didn't survive more than 3 weeks because I didn't know anything about their needs. Now, after about 5 years, my house is a jungle; I've about 20 plants and each one has its own personality and its quirks, I swear, this isn't an exaggeration. If one isn't happy, it immediately "tells" me with its leaves, and I, of course, am always attentive to those small details so that there aren't bigger problems. It isn't as complicated as it seems at 1st, you just have to observe them and give them a little love.

text_es: To successfully care for indoor plants, don't overcomplicate things at first. Fundamentally, they aren't accustomed to nature like outdoor plants, so you must provide them with a stable growing environment. This is very crucial: please be sure to research two or three basic needs for each new plant you acquire, such as light, watering, and temperature, because not all plants are the same. Remember not to overwater, as this is the primary cause of plant death, and it's not easy to revive them afterward. I recommend touching the soil with your finger before watering to confirm if it's dry. Additionally, don't forget about humidity; some plants don't like high humidity, but others need it. I believe that as long as you master this basic knowledge, your plants will thrive here, and you won't encounter too many problems.
text_tgt_raw: 想要成功照顧好室內植物，一開始別把事情想得太複雜。最根本的是，它們不像室外植物那樣習慣大自然，所以您必須為它們提供一個穩定的生長環境。這一點非常關鍵：請您務必研究每種新購入植物的兩、三項基本需求，例如光照、澆水和溫度，因為並非所有植物都一樣。切記不要過度澆水，這是導致植物死亡的首要原因，之後要救回來可不容易。我建議您在澆水前，先用手指觸摸土壤，確認那裡是否乾燥。此外，也別忘了環境濕度；有些植物不喜歡過高的濕度，但有些卻需要它。我相信只要掌握這些基本的軟體知識，您的植物就能在這裡茁壯成長，您也就不會遇到太多問題了。
base_en: To successfully care for indoor plants, don't overcomplicate things at 1st. The fundamental thing is that they aren't used to the outdoors, so you have to give them a stable environment. This is crucial: research 2 or 3 basic needs of each plant you acquire—light, watering, temperature—because not all of them are the same. Don't overwater; it's the 1st cause of death, and it's not easy to revive them afterward. I advise you to touch the soil to check if it's dry before adding water. Don't forget about ambient humidity; some plants don't tolerate it well, but others need it. I'm sure that with these basic tips, your plants will thrive, and you won't have problems.

text_es: Choosing a mattress is indeed an important decision because it directly affects our sleep quality, which in turn relates to our overall health. Among many considerations, mattress firmness is paramount because everyone's preferences and physical needs are different; some people prefer firmer support, while others find a softer one more comfortable. Furthermore, the choice of material cannot be overlooked; common options on the market include springs, memory foam, latex, or combinations of these materials, each offering a unique sense of support and breathability. In addition, individual sleeping posture is also a major key, as the type of mattress needed for back sleepers and side sleepers differs significantly; if there are two people in the bed, meeting each other's needs simultaneously is another challenge. Finally, we should not underestimate the importance of personally trying out a mattress in the store for a few minutes; only through firsthand experience can one truly know if the mattress is suitable for them.
text_tgt_raw: 挑選床墊著實為一項重要決定，因為它直接影響著我們的睡眠品質，進而關乎整體健康。在眾多考量裡，床墊的軟硬度是首要之務，因為每個人的喜好和身體需求都不同，有些人偏好較硬的支撐，而另一些人則覺得軟一點的更舒適。再者，材質的選擇也不容忽視，市面上常見的彈簧、記憶棉、乳膠，或是這些材質的組合，每一種都提供著獨特的支撐感和透氣性。此外，個人的睡姿也為一大關鍵，仰睡和側睡所需的床墊類型有著顯著差異；如果床上有兩個人，要同時滿足彼此的需求更是另一項挑戰。最後，我們不應低估在店裡親身試躺幾分鐘的重要性，唯有親身體驗，才能真正知道這張床墊是否適合自己。
base_en: Choosing a mattress isn't a decision that should be taken lightly, as it directly affects the quality of our rest and, therefore, our health. It's essential to consider several factors, such as the type of firmness, which isn't the same for everyone; some will prefer a firmer one, while others will feel better on a softer one. Also, we can't forget the material: there are options with springs, memory foam, latex, or a combination of them, and each has its own support and breathability characteristics. Furthermore, it's important to consider our sleeping position—sleeping on your back isn't the same as sleeping on your side—and if we share the bed, since it's not always easy to please 2 people. Finally, we shouldn't underestimate the importance of trying the mattress for a few minutes in the store; you don't know how you'll feel until you try it.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, don't rush your decision; it's not just a casual purchase. Many factors need to be considered for your sleep, as not all mattresses are the same, and this is crucial for your rest. You don't have to buy the most expensive one; the important thing is to find the style that best suits your needs. Think about your sleeping position—whether you sleep on your side, back, or stomach—because this provides key information about the support your body needs. Don't forget to lie on it in the store for about 10 to 15 minutes; there's really no better way to confirm if you'll feel comfortable. Also, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, as the softest or firmest styles are not always the ideal choice.
text_tgt_raw: 挑選床墊時，請不要匆忙決定，這可不是隨便買買就好。這裡有許多因素需要為您的睡眠考量，畢竟並非所有床墊都一樣，而這對您的休息至關重要。您不一定要買最貴的，重要的是找到最適合自己需求的款式。想想您的睡姿——是側臥、仰臥還是俯臥——因為這為身體所需的支撐提供了關鍵資訊。別忘了在店裡試躺大約10到15分鐘，那裡真的沒有比這更好的方法來確認您是否會感到舒適。此外，也別低估了軟硬度的重要性，因為最軟或最硬的款式，並不總是理想的選擇。
base_en: When you go to choose a mattress, don't rush; it's not just any purchase. Several factors must be considered, since not all mattresses are the same, and this is fundamental for your rest. You don't have to buy the most expensive one, look for the one that best suits your specific needs. Think about your sleeping position—if you're on your side, back, or stomach—because that's key for the support you need. Don't forget to try it for about 10 to 15 minutes in the store; truly, there's no better way to know if you'll feel comfortable. Also, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, since the softest or hardest isn't always ideal.

text_es: Reducing food waste is crucial for sustainable development, benefiting not only the environment but also positively impacting the economy. This is no small issue; one-third of the food produced globally each year is lost or wasted, a truly concerning figure, especially when considering that many people around the world still lack access to sufficient food. We cannot ignore the large amounts of water and energy consumed during the food production process, and its waste signifies inefficiency throughout the entire supply chain. The solution is not singular, but we can start by planning purchases more carefully, storing food properly, and utilizing leftovers; it's not as complicated as it seems. Raising public awareness about this global challenge is very important; we can no longer continue to consume resources at such an unsustainable rate.
text_tgt_raw: 減少食物浪費對於永續發展至關重要，這不僅對環境有益，也對經濟產生正向影響。這並非小問題，全球每年生產的三分之一食物被損耗或浪費掉，這裡的數字著實令人擔憂，尤其是想到世界上仍有許多人無法獲得足夠的食物。我們不能忽視食物生產過程為此耗費大量水資源和能源，而其浪費則意味著整個供應鏈裡充斥著低效率。解決之道並非單一，但我們可以從更妥善地規劃採購、正確儲存食物以及利用剩菜著手；這並不像想像中那麼複雜。提高社會對這項全球挑戰的意識非常重要，我們不能再繼續以這種不可持續的速度消耗資源了。
base_en: Reducing food waste is crucial for sustainability; it not only benefits the environment but also has a positive economic impact. It isn't a minor problem, as 1/3 of all food produced globally is lost or wasted annually. This is alarming if we consider that many people don't have access to adequate food. We can't ignore that food production consumes large quantities of resources like water and energy, and its waste implies inefficiency throughout the entire chain. There isn't a single solution, but we can start by better planning purchases, properly storing food, and utilizing leftovers; it isn't as complicated as it seems. It's important to raise awareness in society about this global challenge; we can't afford to continue with this unsustainable consumption rate.

text_es: It was only that day, while preparing dinner for four, that I suddenly realized how much food we would waste if I didn't change my habits. It wasn't until that moment that I truly understood what reducing waste actually meant. Before, I didn't pay much attention to leftovers, always thinking it was no big deal and not a serious problem. However, I no longer think that way. I decided I couldn't maintain that attitude anymore, so I started planning meals more carefully and using leftover ingredients more creatively; this is something we should all learn. For example, instead of throwing away the leftover roasted chicken from the previous day, I made delicious croquettes with it the next day; I was very proud of this "invention"! In fact, reducing food waste is not as difficult as one might imagine, and the Earth will thank us for it.
text_tgt_raw: 那天在為四人準備晚餐時，我才赫然意識到，如果我不改變習慣，我們將浪費掉多少食物。直到那一刻，我才真正體會到減少浪費究竟意味著什麼。以前我對剩菜不怎麼在意，總覺得那沒什麼大不了，也不是什麼嚴重的問題。然而，現在我不再那麼想了。我決定不能再抱持那樣的態度，於是我開始更妥善地規劃餐點，也更具創意地利用剩餘食材；這點我們都應該學習。舉例來說，前一天的烤雞，我沒有把剩下的丟掉，反而在隔天做成了美味可樂餅；對於這項「發明」，我感到非常驕傲！其實，減少廚餘並沒有想像中那麼困難，而且地球也會因此感謝我們。
base_en: The other day, preparing dinner for 4 people, I realized how much food we were going to throw away if I didn't change my habits. I didn't realize until that moment what reducing waste really means. Before, I didn't care too much if there was something left over; I thought that wasn't a problem, that it isn't something so serious. However, now I don't see it that way. I decided I couldn't continue with that attitude, so I started to plan meals better and to be more creative with leftovers; that's something we should all do. For example, with the roasted chicken from one day, I didn't throw away what was left, but instead I made some delicious croquettes the next day; I'm very proud of that invention! Really, reducing food waste isn't as difficult as it seems, and the planet is going to thank us for it.

text_es: To reduce food waste, thorough planning is truly essential. It's not as difficult as it seems, but it can bring great benefits. Before going shopping, be sure to thoroughly check what ingredients you still have in the refrigerator and pantry. This will help you avoid duplicate purchases and create a list of items you truly need, which is crucial for budget control. When you're at the supermarket or hypermarket, don't be swayed by seemingly good deals that you won't be able to finish, and remember that buying more isn't necessarily better, especially if you won't eat it all later. Once you're home, organize your food properly, placing older or soon-to-expire items in a visible, easily accessible spot to prevent them from spoiling. Finally, never throw away leftovers directly; with a little creativity, yesterday's food can be transformed into a delicious and novel meal.
text_tgt_raw: 為減少食物浪費，周全的規劃著實不可或缺，這其實沒想像中那麼困難，卻能帶來極大的好處。在出門採買前，務必徹底檢查冰箱裡和儲藏櫃裡還有哪些食材，這樣就能避免重複購買，同時列出真正需要的品項清單；這對於控制預算至關重要。到了超市或大賣場時，別被那些看來划算卻用不完的特價商品給沖昏頭，而且要記住，買得多不一定就比較好，特別是當你之後不會全部吃完的時候。回到家裡，將食物妥善整理，把較舊的或即將過期的放在顯眼處，方便取用，以免放到壞掉。最後，千萬別將剩飯剩菜直接丟棄；只要發揮一點創意，昨天的食物也能搖身一變，成為美味又新穎的一餐。
base_en: To reduce food waste, good planning is essential: it isn't as difficult as it seems, and the benefit is enormous. Before going shopping, thoroughly check the refrigerator and pantry—that way you'll avoid duplicate purchases—and make a list of what you really need; this is key to not overspending. When you're at the supermarket, don't get carried away by offers that you won't fully use, and remember that bigger isn't always better if you don't consume it later. At home, organize food so that older products or those with closer expiration dates are more accessible—you don't want them to spoil. Finally, don't throw away leftovers; yesterday's food doesn't have to be boring if you give it new life with a little imagination.

text_es: Learning to swim is truly a very beneficial experience for adults, and it's not as complicated as many people imagine. Although some might be deterred, thinking they can't do it, there's actually no age limit to learning this important skill. Many sports centers offer classes specifically for adults, focusing on overcoming fear of water and teaching basic techniques, so the learning process doesn't have to be a solo endeavor. The most important thing is to start calmly and without pressure, which lays the foundation for building confidence. You are definitely not alone on this journey; many adults share the same goal, and the progress is usually very gratifying. This skill not only improves physical condition but also brings a great sense of safety and freedom in the water.
text_tgt_raw: 學習游泳對於成年人來說，著實是一項非常有益的體驗，而且並不如許多人想像中那般複雜。雖然有人會因此感到卻步，認為自己辦不到，但學習這項重要技能其實並沒有年齡限制。這裡有許多運動中心專為成年人開設課程，著重在克服對水的恐懼並傳授基本技巧，所以學習過程並非得獨自一人摸索。最重要的是要從容不迫、沒有壓力地開始，這為建立自信心奠定了基礎。您在這條路上絕不孤單，許多成年人也抱持著相同的目標，而且進步的過程通常都令人感到欣慰。這項技能不僅能改善身體狀況，更能在水裡帶來莫大的安全感與自由。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding experience that, truly, isn't as complicated as some people think. Many people feel intimidated, believing they can't do it, but there's no age limit to acquiring this vital skill. There are many sports centers that offer specific classes for adults, focused on overcoming the fear of water and teaching basic techniques; it doesn't have to be a solitary process. The important thing is to start calmly, without pressure; this is fundamental for building confidence. You're not alone in this, many adults share this goal, and progress is usually gratifying. It's a skill that not only improves physical condition but also offers a great sense of security and freedom in the water.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is truly a unique experience, definitely different from how it felt learning as a child! I used to always think I couldn't learn and that it was too late. But in the summer of my 35th year, I still decided to sign up for lessons, and honestly, the process was really not easy at all. Initially, I was very afraid of deep water and simply couldn't relax in the water. However, my coach was very patient and always encouraged me, saying, "Take your time, no rush." Now I can swim with ease and comfort, and I don't regret my decision at all; that feeling of freedom is priceless. So, if you're also considering learning to swim here or there, don't hesitate any longer, it's absolutely worth it!
text_tgt_raw: 身為成人學習游泳，確實是個很特別的經驗，跟小時候學的感覺絕對不一樣！我以前總覺得自己學不會，也太遲了。但在35歲那年夏天，我還是決定報名課程，老實說，過程真的一點也不輕鬆。起初，我非常害怕水深，整個人在水裡根本放鬆不下來。不過，我的教練很有耐心，總是鼓勵著我說：「慢慢來，不急。」現在我已經能輕鬆自在地游泳了，一點也不後悔當初的決定，那種自由的感覺是無價的。所以，如果你也考慮在這裡或那裡學游泳，別再猶豫了，這絕對是值得的！
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a peculiar experience; it's not the same as when you're a child, I assure you of that! I always thought it wouldn't be for me, that it was already too late. But one summer, at 35 years old, I decided to sign up for a course, and it wasn't easy, I won't lie. At 1st, I was terrified of the depth, and I couldn't relax in the water. My instructor, however, was very patient, and always told me, "There's no rush, little by little." Now I can say that I swim with a certain ease, and I don't regret having done it; it's a priceless feeling of freedom. So, if you're thinking of learning, don't hesitate, this is something that's worth it!

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rich and liberating experience, and it's never too late to start! First, it's very important to find a good instructor with experience teaching adults, as adults and children learn differently. Please don't put too much pressure on yourself; you don't need to become an Olympic athlete overnight. Slowly getting used to moving in the water is the main point. There's no shame in using aids like kickboards or swim noodles at first; they can boost your confidence, which is very practical. The key to success is persistence and overcoming your fear of water: this is by no means an impossible task! As long as you are patient with yourself, I believe you will definitely succeed in learning to swim.
text_tgt_raw: 成人學游泳是個既豐富又自由的體驗，任何時候開始都不嫌晚！首先，找一位有教成人經驗的好教練非常重要，畢竟成人和孩童的學習方式有所不同。請不要給自己太大的壓力，您不需一夕之間就成為奧運選手；慢慢習慣在水裡活動，這才是重點。一開始使用浮板或浮條等輔助工具也沒什麼好羞恥的，它們能為您增加信心，這點非常實用。成功的關鍵在於持之以恆，並克服對水的恐懼：這絕非不可能的任務！只要您對自己有耐心，我相信您一定能成功學會游泳。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is an enriching and liberating experience; it's not too late to start! The 1st thing is to find a good instructor with experience teaching adults, as it's not the same as with children. Don't pressure yourself; you don't have to be an Olympic swimmer overnight; take your time to get used to the water. There's no need to be ashamed of using aids like kickboards or pool noodles at 1st—this is very useful—they'll give you confidence. The key is consistency and overcoming fear: it's not impossible! I'm sure you'll achieve it if you're patient with yourself!

text_es: Painting a room isn't difficult; with proper planning, it can be done easily. First, be sure to thoroughly prepare the walls, and while this process can sometimes be tedious, it's an indispensable step: clean the walls, fill cracks or holes, and sand smooth if necessary. At the same time, don't forget to properly protect the floors and furniture with plastic sheeting or canvas to prevent paint splatters, which will save a lot of trouble with cleanup later. Next, choose the right paint and tools, as using a roller is quite different from using a brush for edges. Usually, two to three coats of paint are needed, and you must patiently wait for each coat to dry between applications, which is crucial for ensuring a smooth and even final result. Afterward, seeing the entire space transformed, the sense of satisfaction is absolutely delightful.
text_tgt_raw: 粉刷房間並非難事，只要妥善規劃便能輕鬆完成。首先，務必仔細整理牆面，儘管這過程有時較為繁瑣，卻是不可或缺的一步：清潔牆壁、填補裂縫或孔洞，必要時還要打磨平滑。同時，別忘了用塑膠布或帆布妥善保護地板與家具，這是為了避免油漆沾染，為之後的清潔省下不少麻煩。接著，選擇合適的油漆和工具，因為使用滾筒和用刷子處理邊角是截然不同的。通常需要上兩到三層漆，每層之間都得耐心等待其乾燥，這對確保最終成果平整光滑至關重要。完成後，看著整個空間煥然一新，那種滿足感絕對是令人愉悅的。
base_en: Painting a room isn't a complicated task if one organizes well. 1st, you have to prepare the surface, which isn't always fun, but it's essential: clean the walls, patch holes or cracks, and sand if necessary. You mustn't forget to protect the floor and furniture with tarps or plastic; this is crucial to avoid stains. Then, we select the appropriate paint and tools; using a roller isn't the same as using a brush for the edges. Normally, 2, or 3 coats of paint are applied, allowing drying time between each one—that's fundamental for a good finish. I'm sure the final result is gratifying, as it gives the space a completely new feel.

text_es: Last week, I was forced to repaint the guest room, which is by no means my favorite pastime. I didn't like the previous color at all—that terrible pistachio green, so I decided to paint it light blue. To be honest, painting itself wasn't difficult, but moving the furniture in the room was torture; it's simply impossible to do it here without help! I bought 15 liters of paint and 3 rollers, thinking at the time that it should be enough. I'm very satisfied with the final result; the room looks completely different now, even though I'm not an expert in this area! However, my back is not so happy.
text_tgt_raw: 上週，我被迫為客房重新粉刷，這絕不是我喜歡的消遣。我一點也不喜歡之前的顏色——那可怕的開心果綠，所以決定將它漆成淺藍色。說實話，刷漆本身並不難，但搬動房間裡的家具可就折磨死我了；這裡根本不可能在沒有人幫忙的情況下完成！我買了15公升的油漆和3個滾筒，當時想著這些應該足夠了。我很滿意最後的成果，現在的房間看起來完全不一樣了，即便我不是這方面的專家！然而，我的背可就沒那麼開心了。
base_en: It's not my favorite pastime, but last week I had to paint the guest room. I didn't like the previous color at all—it was a horrible pistachio green—so I decided to change it to a light blue. That wasn't hard, honestly, but moving the furniture was a torment for me; there's no way to do it without help! I bought 15 liters of paint and 3 rollers, thinking I wouldn't need more. I'm very proud of the final result, it doesn't look like the same room, and I'm not even an expert! My back, on the other hand, isn't so happy.

text_es: When preparing to paint a room, the first priority is proper planning; it's not as simple as just picking a color. First, it's very important to prepare all necessary materials, such as paint, brushes, rollers, painter's tape, and protective plastic sheeting, all of which are to ensure a professional and clean result. Next, don't forget to carefully prepare the walls by cleaning them, repairing imperfections, and lightly sanding them, so the paint can adhere more firmly. During the painting process, never underestimate the importance of protecting furniture and floors, because no one wants to see unnecessary paint stains. The ideal order is to start with the ceiling, then paint the walls, and finally the baseboards, which prevents paint from dripping onto already finished surfaces. Usually, a second coat of paint is necessary, but this also depends on the color and quality of the paint, so there might be exceptions. All in all, you'll find that painting a room isn't as complicated as you might think!
text_tgt_raw: 當準備粉刷一個房間時，首要之務在於妥善的規劃，這可不是隨意挑選顏色那麼簡單。首先，備妥所有必要的材料非常重要，例如油漆、刷子、滾筒、遮蔽膠帶以及保護用的塑膠布，這些都是為了確保最終能有專業且乾淨的成果。接著，別忘了仔細處理牆面，將其清潔乾淨、修補瑕疵並輕輕打磨，這樣油漆才能更牢固地附著。在粉刷的過程裡，切勿低估保護傢俱和地板的重要性，因為沒有人會希望看到不必要的油漆污漬。理想的順序是從天花板開始，接著粉刷牆壁，最後才是踢腳板，如此一來便能避免油漆滴落到已經完成的表面上。通常情況下，第二層油漆是必需的，但這也取決於油漆的顏色和品質，或許會有例外。總之，你會發現粉刷房間其實沒有想像中那麼複雜！
base_en: When starting to paint a room, the 1st thing is good planning; it isn't just a matter of choosing the color.
