base_en: When starting the habit of writing a journal, focus on consistency, simplicity, and authenticity, as these are fundamental pillars for maintaining it long-term. Don't pressure yourself to write a lot every day; 5 minutes can be enough to capture your ideas, feelings, or key events. You can start by recording 3 things you're grateful for, 3 goals for the day, or 3 reflections on your mood. Don't worry about grammar, spelling, or style; this space is just for you, a safe place to explore your thoughts, doubts, and aspirations. Allow yourself to be vulnerable, honest, and spontaneous; write about what occupies you, excites you, or worries you. Try to do it at the same time, in a quiet and comfortable place, without distractions, interruptions, or judgments, to consolidate the routine and turn it into a personal and gratifying ritual.

text_es: Starting to learn guitar is an exciting journey that requires patience, dedication, and choosing a good instrument. First, it's crucial to pick a guitar that suits your musical taste, budget, and personal style, whether it's an acoustic, classical, or electric guitar. Next, learn basic chords, simple rhythms, and correct finger posture to avoid injury. You can choose to hire a teacher, watch online tutorial videos, or read self-study books, but in any case, look for high-quality, clear, and educational software or materials. Practicing regularly for at least 15 to 30 minutes every day is the foundation for developing skills, muscle memory, and confidence. Don't be discouraged by mistakes, calluses on your fingertips, or slow progress along the way, as these are all part of learning and continuous improvement. As long as you persevere and enjoy the process, in time you'll be able to play your favorite songs, create your own melodies, and share your music with others.
text_tgt_raw: 開始學習吉他是一趟令人興奮的旅程，這需要耐心、投入以及選擇一把好的樂器。首先，挑選一把適合自己音樂品味、預算和個人風格的吉他至關重要，無論是民謠、古典或電吉他。接著，學習基本和弦、簡單節奏，以及正確的手指姿勢以避免受傷。你可以選擇請老師教學、觀看網路上的教學影片，或是閱讀自學書籍，但無論如何都要尋找優質、清晰且具教育性的軟體或資料。每天至少花15到30分鐘規律練習是培養技巧、肌肉記憶和自信的基礎。過程中別被錯誤、指尖長繭或進度緩慢而氣餒，這些都是學習與持續進步的一部份。只要持之以恆，享受其中，假以時日你就能彈奏自己喜歡的歌曲、創作屬於自己的旋律，並與他人分享你的音樂。
base_en: Starting to play the guitar is an exciting adventure that requires patience, dedication, and choosing a good instrument. Initially, it's crucial to select the right guitar—acoustic, classical, or electric—the one that best suits your musical tastes, budget, and personal style. It's advisable to learn the basic chords, simple rhythms, and how to position your fingers correctly to avoid injuries. You can opt for lessons with a teacher, online tutorials, or self-teaching books, always looking for quality, clear, and educational resources. Regular practice is fundamental for developing skill, muscle memory, and self-confidence, dedicating at least 15 or 30 minutes a day. Don't get discouraged by mistakes, calluses, or slowness; they're part of the learning process and constant improvement. With time, perseverance, and enjoyment, you'll be able to play your favorite songs, compose your own melodies, and share your music with others.

text_es: I clearly remember one afternoon when I decided to start learning guitar; it was a pivotal, liberating, and exciting moment. I was about fourteen at the time, idle at home, when I suddenly saw a guitar leaning in the corner—it was old, dusty, and slightly worn—it was my father's nylon-string guitar. Its shape, color, and silence deeply attracted me. I picked it up and tuned it using a phone app, which was quite difficult. Then, I started searching online for chords, rhythms, and simple melodies, specifically looking for easy-to-follow, short, or clear instructional videos. My fingertips immediately felt pain, a sharp, annoying, and persistent ache, but I wasn't discouraged by it. I repeatedly practiced G, C, and D chords for several hours, feeling my muscles gradually adapt to the new postures, tension, and movements. That night, even though I only knew a few notes and a basic rhythm, I felt like the happiest, most content, and most hopeful musician in the world.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚地記得，某個午後我決定開始學吉他，那是一個關鍵、自由且令人興奮的時刻。當時我大約十四歲，閒來無事待在家裡，突然看到一把吉他斜靠在牆角—它老舊、佈滿灰塵，略顯斑駁—那是父親的尼龍弦吉他。它的形狀、顏色以及那份靜默深深吸引著我。我拿起它，用手機軟體調音，過程著實有些困難。接著，我開始在網路上搜尋和弦、節奏和簡單的旋律，專門找尋容易上手、簡短或清晰的教學影片。我的指尖立刻感到疼痛，那是一種尖銳、惱人且持續不斷的痛楚，但我並沒有因此感到沮喪。我反覆練習著G、C、D和弦好幾個小時，感受著肌肉逐漸適應新的姿勢、張力和動作。那天晚上，儘管我只會幾個音符和一個基本的節奏，卻感覺自己是全世界最快樂、最滿足、也最有希望的音樂家。
base_en: I perfectly remember the afternoon I decided to start playing the guitar; it was a key, liberating, and exciting moment. I was about 14 years old, I was home, bored, and I saw it leaning in a corner—old, dusty, and a bit battered—; it was my father's, with nylon strings, and its shape, color, and silence caught my attention. I picked it up, tuned it with a phone app—not without difficulty, to be honest—and started researching chords, rhythms, and simple melodies online, looking for easy, short, or clear tutorials. My fingertips immediately started to hurt; it was a sharp, annoying, and constant pain, but frustration didn't win me over. I practiced the G, C, and D chords for hours, feeling my muscles get used to the new postures, tensions, and movements. That night, even though I only knew a couple of notes and a basic rhythm, I felt like the happiest, most satisfied, and most hopeful musician in the world.

text_es: If you want to start learning guitar, I would recommend that you have patience, discipline, and perseverance. First, it's very important to choose a suitable guitar for your musical preferences, whether it's an acoustic, electric, or classical guitar. Next, dedicate time to learning basic chords, fingerings, and techniques like strumming, picking, or arpeggios. Even if you only have fifteen or twenty minutes each day, practice consistently to strengthen your fingers, wrists, and forearms. You will definitely make mistakes along the way, but don't get discouraged, because mistakes are part of learning and progress. You can find instructional videos online, enroll in classes, or read books to aid your learning, and progress at your own pace. Enjoy this journey of exploring new sounds, new melodies, and new rhythms!
text_tgt_raw: 想要開始學習吉他，我會推薦您具備耐心、紀律及毅力。首先，為您的音樂喜好選擇一把合適的吉他非常重要，無論是民謠、電吉他或古典吉他。接著，專心投入時間學習基本和弦、指法，以及刷弦、撥弦或琶音等技巧。即使每天只有短短十五或二十分鐘，仍要持之以恆地練習，藉此強化您的手指、手腕和前臂。過程中一定會犯錯，但千萬別因此氣餒，因為錯誤正是學習與進步的一部份。您可以在網路裡尋找教學影片、報名課程或閱讀書籍來輔助學習，以自己的步調前進。好好享受這段探索新聲音、新旋律與新節奏的旅程吧！
base_en: To start playing the guitar, I recommend patience, discipline, and perseverance. It's essential that you choose an appropriate guitar—acoustic, electric, or classical—for your musical preferences. Dedicate time to learning the basic chords, finger positions, and strumming, picking, or arpeggio techniques. Practice regularly, even if it's only 15 or 20 minutes a day, to strengthen your fingers, wrists, and forearms. Don't get discouraged by mistakes; they're part of the learning and improvement process. Look for online tutorials, classes, or books to supplement your study and advance at your own pace. Enjoy the process of discovering new sounds, melodies, and rhythms.

text_es: To ensure your bicycle operates properly and has a long lifespan, while also providing a safe riding experience, regular maintenance is essential. This task involves several routine checks, such as confirming tire pressure before each ride and visually inspecting tires for cuts or wear. To ensure smooth gear changes, it's crucial to lubricate the chain every two to three hundred kilometers or when it sounds dry. Additionally, the bicycle should be cleaned regularly to remove accumulated dirt and grime from its components, which helps prevent rust and deterioration. Inspecting and adjusting the brakes is also an important step, along with checking brake cables and pads to avoid sudden issues. Among these maintenance practices, an annual professional inspection is recommended to detect and adjust major problems and address any concerns.
text_tgt_raw: 為了確保自行車能正常運作並延長其使用壽命，同時享有安全的騎乘體驗，定期的維護是不可或缺的。這項任務涉及多項例行檢查，例如每次騎乘前確認胎壓，同時目視檢查輪胎是否有割傷或磨損。為了確保變速順暢，每兩百到三百公里或當鏈條聽起來乾燥時，務必為其上油。此外，自行車應定期清潔，清除零件裡累積的泥土和髒污，這有助於預防生鏽和劣化。檢查煞車及其調整也是重要的動作，同時要檢查煞車線和煞車皮，以避免突發狀況。在這些維護實踐中，這裡建議每年進行一次專業檢修，以檢測和調整重大問題，並解決任何疑問。
base_en: Maintaining a bicycle is essential to ensure its proper functioning and prolong its useful life, while enjoying a safe cycling experience. This task involves several regular checks, such as verifying tire pressure before each ride, while visually inspecting them for cuts or wear. It's crucial to lubricate the chain every 200 to 300 km or when it sounds dry, to ensure smooth gear changes. In addition, the bicycle should be cleaned periodically, removing dirt and mud that accumulate among the components, which helps prevent rust and deterioration. Checking the brakes and their adjustment is another important action, while checking the cables and pads to avoid unpleasant surprises. Among these maintenance practices, an annual professional review is also recommended to detect major problems and adjust them, while resolving any doubts.

text_es: I remember the day I decided to maintain my bicycle myself; at that time, I was really tired of having to take it to the bike shop almost every day. I started by cleaning the chain, carefully scrubbing it while listening to music, a job that was much dirtier than I expected. Next, I adjusted the brakes, a process that required a lot of patience to ensure both pads rubbed the disc evenly, preventing strange friction noises between the parts. I was surprised to find how much I learned about mechanical principles while using the tools I had bought for this purpose. When I finished, looking at the sparkling bicycle, ready to cruise through the city, I felt an immense sense of satisfaction. The truth is, amidst the grease and grime, I discovered a new hobby and saved myself some money at the same time.
text_tgt_raw: 我記得那天我決定自己保養腳踏車，那時候我真的厭倦了幾乎每天都得牽去車行。我從清洗鏈條開始，一邊聽著音樂，一邊仔細地刷洗，這工作比我想像中髒多了。接著我調整煞車，這個過程需要很大的耐心，才能讓兩邊的來令片均勻地磨擦碟盤，不讓零件間產生奇怪的摩擦聲。我驚訝地發現，使用那些我為此購買的工具時，我學到了好多機械原理。當我完成，看著那裡閃閃發亮的腳踏車，準備好在城市裡奔馳時，心裡感到無比的滿足。事實是，在油汙和髒污之中，我發現了一個新的愛好，同時也為自己省下了一些錢。
base_en: I remember the day I decided to maintain my bicycle myself; I was tired of taking it to the shop every other day. I started with the chain, cleaning it thoroughly while listening to music, it was a dirtier job than I thought. Then I adjusted the brakes, a process that required patience while I tried to get both pads to rub the disc equally, without strange rubbing between the parts. I was surprised how much I learned about mechanics while working with the tools I had bought. I felt great satisfaction when I finished, while observing my gleaming bicycle, ready to roll through the city streets. The truth is that, amid all the oil and grease, I discovered a new hobby, while saving myself a few euros.

text_es: Successfully hosting a farmers market requires careful planning, and the details are numerous. First, it is crucial to choose a location with convenient transportation, while also considering parking and facilities. Next, obtaining relevant government permits is a necessary step, which usually takes several weeks, and during this time, various schedules and logistics need to be coordinated. Promotion is also extremely important; through social media and local media, information about the market's opening can be widely disseminated to the community, and active collaboration with local producers should be sought. Establishing clear rules for participants, detailing the types of products allowed for sale and quality standards, while also encouraging product diversity, is essential to ensure the smooth operation of the market. Throughout all preparation processes, maintaining smooth communication between the organizers and farmers plays a key role in resolving any unexpected situations. Finally, the daily operation of the market relies on the dedication of volunteers and staff, who are responsible for coordinating various activities, ensuring everyone has a wonderful experience, and bringing more vitality to the community.
text_tgt_raw: 成功舉辦一個農夫市集需要仔細規劃，箇中細節繁瑣。首先，必須選擇一個交通便利、同時考量到停車與設施的場所，這點至關重要。接著，取得相關的政府許可證是必要環節，這通常需要數週時間，期間還需協調各項時程與物流。宣傳工作也極為重要，可透過社群網路與當地媒體，將市集開幕資訊廣為告知社區民眾，並積極尋求在地生產者的合作。為參與者建立明確的規範，詳述允許販售的產品種類與品質標準，同時鼓勵商品多樣性，才能確保市集順利運作。在所有籌備過程裡，主辦方與農民之間保持流暢的溝通，對於解決任何突發狀況都扮演著關鍵角色。最後，市集的日常營運則有賴於志工與工作人員的投入，他們負責協調各項活動，確保每個人都能擁有美好的體驗，為社區帶來更多活力。
base_en: Organizing a farmers market involves detailed planning to ensure its success. 1st, it's essential to select a location that's accessible for farmers and consumers, while considering aspects like parking and facilities. It's crucial to obtain the necessary municipal permits, a process that often requires several weeks, while coordinating schedules and logistics. Promotion is vital, and social media and local outlets should be used to inform the community about the opening, while seeking collaboration among local producers. It's important to establish clear regulations for participants, detailing the types of products allowed and the quality standards, while fostering diversity in the offerings. Amid all the organization, maintaining fluid communication between organizers and farmers is key to resolving any unforeseen issues, while preparing the spaces for the stalls. Finally, day-to-day management requires volunteers and staff dedicated to coordinating activities, while ensuring a positive experience for everyone.

text_es: I remember the first time we organized a farmers market in our town; it was a long but unforgettable experience. At the time, we spent weeks communicating with local farmers, my partner was responsible for designing posters, and I was busy coordinating various permits with the city council. Our philosophy was to create a platform for producers and community residents to interact, thereby promoting local and sustainable consumption patterns. There were many setbacks during the process, especially when we tried to coordinate the different schedules and needs of fifteen farmers, which was particularly challenging. However, amidst the chaos, the excitement of watching the project gradually take shape supported us in overcoming every difficulty. On opening day, seeing so many people enjoying the fun of selecting fresh fruits and vegetables among the stalls, and hearing bursts of laughter, all the effort seemed incredibly worthwhile at that moment, and we were already planning for the next market.
text_tgt_raw: 我記得第一次在我們鎮裡籌辦農夫市集的情景，那真是一段漫長卻也令人難忘的經歷。當時我們花了數週時間與當地農民溝通，我的夥伴負責設計海報，而我則忙著與市議會協調各項許可。我們的理念是為生產者與社區居民打造一個交流平台，藉此推廣在地且永續的消費模式。過程中不乏挫折，尤其當我們試著協調十五位農民各自不同的時間表與需求時，更是備感艱辛。然而，在混亂之中，看著這個計畫逐漸成形所帶來的興奮感，支持著我們克服每個難關。開幕那天，看到那麼多人享受著在攤位間選購新鮮蔬果的樂趣，耳邊傳來陣陣歡聲笑語，那一刻所有的努力都顯得非常值得，我們心裡也已經開始盤算著下一屆的規劃了。
base_en: I remember the 1st time we tried to organize a farmers' market in our town; it was an odyssey, but also an incredible experience. We spent weeks talking with local farmers, while my partner designed the posters and I coordinated the permits with the city council. The idea was to create a meeting place, among producers and neighbors, to promote local and sustainable consumption. There were moments of frustration, especially while we tried to coordinate the schedules of 15 different farmers, each with their own demands. But, amid all the chaos, the excitement of seeing the project materialize kept us afloat, as we overcame each obstacle. On opening day, seeing so many people enjoying themselves, among stalls full of fresh fruits and vegetables, and amid laughter and lively conversations, made all the effort worthwhile, while we were already thinking about the next edition.

text_es: To successfully host a farmers market, first, you need to assess local demand and the availability of producers, and establish a clear and distinctive identity for the market. Obtaining the necessary permits from municipal authorities and ensuring compliance with all food safety and hygiene regulations is a crucial step in this process. Next, you should promote the event early to neighbors and surrounding communities through online platforms, social media, and physical posters to attract more visitors. During the preparation phase, it's important to establish open communication channels between farmers and organizers, focusing on promptly resolving any questions or logistical issues that may arise. To attract a wide range of customers, a diverse selection of agricultural products should be offered, and the freshness and quality of each item must be guaranteed amidst numerous competitors. Additionally, consider incorporating extra activities such as live music performances or workshops to create a lively and appealing atmosphere for the market. We hope to encourage active participation from community residents, working together to create an inclusive and sustainable shared space for everyone.
text_tgt_raw: 若要成功舉辦一場農夫市集，首先得評估當地需求與生產者的供應狀況，並為市集確立明確的特色定位。這裡面，向市政機關申請必要的許可證，同時確保一切皆符合食品安全與衛生法規，是極為關鍵的一步。接著，應提早透過網路平台、社交媒體及實體海報向鄰里與周邊社區宣傳活動，以吸引更多人潮。在籌備過程中，建立農民與主辦單位之間暢通無阻的溝通管道，著重於即時解決可能產生的任何疑問或物流問題。為了吸引廣大客群，應提供多元化的農產品，並在眾多競爭者裡，依然能保證每項商品的鮮度與品質。此外，也可考慮加入現場音樂表演或工作坊等額外活動，為市集營造出熱鬧且吸引人的氛圍。我們期盼能鼓勵社區居民積極參與，為大家共同打造一個具包容性且永續發展的共享空間。
base_en: To organize a successful farmers market, 1st, start by assessing local demand and producer availability, while defining a clear niche for your market. It's crucial to obtain the necessary permits from municipal authorities, while ensuring compliance with all health and safety regulations. Promote the event among neighbors and nearby communities in advance, while utilizing digital platforms and physical posters to maximize attendance. Establish fluid communication between farmers and organizers, while resolving any questions or logistical problems that may arise. Offer a variety of products to attract a wide audience, while guaranteeing the freshness and quality of each item amid the competition. Also consider additional activities, such as live music or workshops, to create an attractive atmosphere amid the vibrant market atmosphere. Encourage community participation, while creating an inclusive and sustainable space for everyone.

text_es: Learning to knit a scarf is a very rewarding skill that allows people to create their own unique clothing, which truly attracts many. We usually start by learning basic knit and purl stitches, while also getting familiar with knitting needles and yarn. For beginners, it's very important to choose yarn that isn't slippery and has a moderate thickness, so you can gradually master the tension of your knitting. Consistent practice is the key to success; it's inevitable to encounter dropped stitches or uneven tension, and making mistakes is completely normal. However, despite these challenges, the satisfaction of watching your work take shape stitch by stitch is immense, and we improve one stitch at a time. By dedicating just one or two hours each day, a simple scarf can be completed in a few weeks, and the excitement of finishing a project, along with the anticipation of planning the next one, adds color to life. In this busy daily life, the process of knitting provides us with moments of tranquility.
text_tgt_raw: 學習編織圍巾是項極富成就感的技能，能讓人親手創造專屬衣物，這著實吸引了許多人。通常我們會從基本的平針和反針學起，同時熟悉棒針和毛線。對初學者而言，選擇不易滑脫、厚度適中的毛線非常重要，這樣才能慢慢掌握編織的鬆緊度。持續練習是成功的關鍵，這裡頭難免會遇到掉針或織目不均的狀況，犯錯是很正常的。然而，儘管有這些挑戰，看著織物一點一滴成形所帶來的滿足感卻是巨大的，我們就這樣一針一線地進步著。只要每天投入一、兩個小時，一條簡單的圍巾在幾週內就能完成，那種完成作品的興奮感，以及規劃下一個計畫的期待，都為生活增添色彩。在這繁忙的日常裡，編織的過程為我們提供了一片寧靜的時刻。
base_en: Learning to knit a scarf is a rewarding skill that many enjoy, while it allows them to create personalized garments. One generally starts with basic stitches, such as the knit stitch and the purl stitch, while becoming familiar with the needles and yarn. It's important to choose a suitable yarn for beginners, one that isn't too slippery or too thin, while learning the correct tension. Consistent practice is key, and it's common to make mistakes at 1st, among dropped stitches and irregular tensions. However, amid these challenges, the satisfaction of seeing the fabric take shape is immense, while progressing stitch by stitch. With 1 or 2 hours of daily dedication, a simple scarf can be completed in a few weeks, among the excitement of a finished project and the planning of a new one. The process offers a moment of calm, amid the daily hustle and bustle.

text_es: I clearly remember the first time I tried to knit a scarf, as if it happened just yesterday. My grandmother was visiting at the time, and I thought her patience might be contagious, so I decided to learn to knit. I bought two balls of thick yarn and a few knitting needles; at the time, these tools seemed so mysterious to me. Casting on was the first hurdle; my fingers and the yarn became a tangled mess, while she patiently explained things to me. Amidst my frustration and her laughter, the scarf grew little by little, and although the stitches were uneven and there were even holes in some places, I still made very slow progress. Despite these mistakes, knitting still made me feel very relaxed amidst my busy studies. I finally finished it: although it wasn't perfect, I proudly wore it throughout that cold, windy winter.
text_tgt_raw: 我清晰地記得第一次嘗試編織圍巾的情景，彷彿昨日才發生。當時祖母正來訪，我心想著她的耐心也許會傳染給我，於是決定學習編織。我買了兩團粗毛線和幾根棒針，那時在我眼裡，這些工具顯得如此神祕。起針是第一個難關，我的手指和毛線糾纏成一團混亂，而她則在一旁耐心地為我解說著。在我的挫敗感和她的笑聲裡，圍巾一點一點地成長著，雖然針腳不規則，甚至有些地方還出現了洞，但我仍進展得十分緩慢。儘管有這些錯誤，在忙碌的學習之餘，編織還是讓我感到非常放鬆。最後我終於完成了它：雖然它並不完美，但在那個寒風凜冽的冬天裡，我卻自豪地戴著它度過了整個季節。
base_en: I remember my 1st attempt to knit a scarf as if it were yesterday. I decided to learn to knit while my grandmother was visiting me, hoping her patience would be contagious. I bought 2 balls of thick yarn and some needles that, at the time, seemed like mysterious tools to me. The 1st difficulty was casting on the stitches; it was a chaos of fingers and yarn, while she calmly explained it to me. Between my frustrations and her laughter, I advanced very slowly, while the scarf grew with irregular stitches and some holes. Despite the mistakes, knitting relaxed me amid my university studies. In the end, I managed to finish it: it wasn't perfect, but I wore it proudly all winter while the icy wind blew.

text_es: When you first start knitting a scarf, the first step is to choose a skein of thick yarn and knitting needles of an appropriate size; the yarn label usually indicates the recommended needle size. At this point, simple knit or purl stitches will be your best helper. It's inevitable to feel some frustration when you first practice basic stitches, but the most important thing is to relax and enjoy the knitting process. Don't be discouraged even if the first stitch isn't perfect; this is common for beginners, and learning to control tension requires patience. As long as you focus on the regularity of the stitches, you will watch the scarf gradually take shape in your hands. You can listen to music or watch videos while searching for tutorials online, which will help you understand various techniques more clearly. Soon, you'll be knitting comfortably, creating beautiful and practical pieces.
text_tgt_raw: 初學編織圍巾時，首先要挑選一綑粗毛線和尺寸適中的棒針，通常毛線標籤上都會註明建議的針號。這時候，簡單的平針或下針織法會是您最好的幫手。一開始練習基本針法時，難免會有些挫折，但最重要的是要放鬆心情，享受編織的過程。即便第一針織得不完美也別氣餒，這是初學者常有的情況，學習控制鬆緊度需要耐心。只要專注於針目的規律性，您就會看著圍巾在手裡逐漸成形。您可以邊聽音樂或看影片，邊在網路上搜尋教學，會更清楚理解各種技巧。很快地，您就能自在地編織著，創造出既美麗又實用的作品了。
base_en: To start knitting your 1st scarf, choose a ball of thick yarn and appropriately sized needles—the number is usually indicated on the yarn label—while a simple garter or knit stitch pattern will be your best ally. Practice the basic stitches, while you relax and enjoy the process, which is the most important thing amid the initial frustration. Don't despair if the stitches don't come out perfect at 1st; it's normal among beginners and patience is key while you learn to control the tension. Concentrate on the regularity of your stitches while you progress, and you'll see how your scarf takes shape in your hands. Look for online tutorials, while you listen to music or watch a series, to better understand the techniques. Soon you'll be knitting comfortably while you create something beautiful and useful.

text_es: Moving is a task that requires careful planning to ensure a smooth and efficient process. It is usually recommended to start preparing two to three months before the planned moving date, for example, by taking inventory of all belongings, deciding what to keep, sell, or donate, and starting to get quotes from moving companies. When packing items, be sure to clearly label boxes with their contents and the room where they are intended to go, and store important documents and valuables separately. During this process, don't forget to notify various service companies and banks to change your address, and coordinate the relevant registrations for your new residence. Additionally, while arranging transportation, you also need to consider cleaning your old home and furnishing your new home, as well as all the logistical details for moving day. Through such systematic preparation, from anticipation to organization, the stress often associated with moving can be minimized. In your old home, you might call a taxi to transport some packages, while at your new home, you will need to set up internet and various software. If you don't have a private car, a bus can also be a good option for short distances.
text_tgt_raw: 搬家是一項需要縝密規劃的任務，以確保過程順利且有效率。通常建議在預計搬家日的兩到三個月前開始準備，例如清點所有家當，決定哪些要留下、出售或捐贈，並開始尋找搬家公司的報價。打包物品時，務必在箱子上清楚標註內容物和預計放置的房間，並將重要文件和貴重物品分開存放。在這個過程中，別忘了通知各種服務公司及銀行更改地址，並協調新住處的相關登記。此外，在安排交通的同時，也得考慮舊家的清潔和新家的佈置，以及搬家當天的所有物流細節。透過這樣有條不紊的準備，從預期到組織，才能最大程度地減輕搬家常伴隨的壓力。在舊家裡，也許會叫計程車載送一些包裹，而新家那裡，則需要網路和各種軟體的設定。若沒有私家車，公車也會是短程的好選擇。
base_en: Preparing for a move involves meticulous planning to ensure a smooth and efficient transition, while numerous details are managed. It's crucial to start in advance, between 2 and 3 months before the planned date, making an inventory of all belongings and deciding what will be kept, sold, or donated, while seeking quotes from moving companies. While packing items, it's advisable to clearly label boxes with their contents and destination room, while separating important documents and valuables. Amid this process, one mustn't forget to notify service companies and banking institutions of the change of address, while coordinating new registrations. Additionally, while organizing transportation, one must think about cleaning the old home and preparing the new one, while managing the logistical aspects of D-day. This methodical approach, between anticipation and organization, minimizes the stress that often accompanies a relocation.

text_es: Every time I prepare to move, I'm always filled with mixed emotions. As I look around at the stacks of boxes and belongings, bittersweet memories flood my mind. I remember about two years ago, when I moved to this city, it was truly chaotic. At that time, I was trying to decide what to keep and what to donate, and among the disassembled furniture and bags full of clothes, I felt a bit overwhelmed, while my partner tried their best to stay calm. We spent three days packing non-stop, with the cat running between empty boxes, oblivious to all the commotion. To be honest, among all the preparations, what was hardest for me to let go of were those items with special sentimental value; in that whirlwind of making many decisions, I had to say goodbye to them. Finally, when the movers loaded the last box onto the truck, my heart was filled with a complex mix of relief and melancholy.
text_tgt_raw: 每次準備搬家，總是讓我百感交集。當我環顧四周，看著堆積如山的箱子與物品，那些苦樂參半的回憶就湧上心頭。我記得大約兩年前，我搬到這座城市時，這裡真是混亂不堪。那時我試著決定什麼該留下，什麼該捐贈，在那些拆散的傢俱和裝滿衣物的袋子裡，我感到有些不知所措，而我的伴侶則盡力保持冷靜。我們花了三天不間斷地打包，貓咪則在空箱子之間跑來跑去，對一切騷動毫無知覺。說實話，在所有準備工作中，最讓我難以割捨的，就是那些有著特殊情感價值的物品，在那個做出許多決定的旋風裡，我必須和它們道別。最終，當搬家工人將最後的箱子裝上車時，我心中充滿了釋然與惆悵的複雜感受。
base_en: Preparing for a move always brings me bittersweet memories, amid boxes and objects that take up everything. I remember the last time, about 2 years ago, when I moved to this city: the chaos was total, while I tried to decide what to keep and what to donate. Among the disassembled furniture and bags full of clothes, I felt a little overwhelmed, while my partner tried to stay calm. We spent 3 days packing non-stop, while the cat ran around among the empty boxes, oblivious to all the commotion. The truth is that, among all the preparations, what cost me the most was saying goodbye to some objects with sentimental value, amid the whirlwind of decisions. In the end, while the movers loaded the last boxes, I felt a mix of relief and sadness.

text_es: Building a garden in the city requires dedication and expertise to enjoy urban nature and also have a good harvest. First, suitable plants must be carefully selected based on the local climate conditions and available space, and the sunlight requirements of each plant must be considered. Soil preparation is the foundation for success; organic fertilizers must be added early on to enrich the soil and provide the nutrients plants need to grow. Watering must be consistent and appropriate, especially during dry periods, when soil moisture needs extra attention. Furthermore, controlling pests and diseases in an eco-friendly way during plant growth is a crucial part of protecting the yield. For urban gardeners, patience is an indispensable virtue, as one must wait for seeds to sprout and fruits to ripen. This process not only produces fresh ingredients but also allows us to establish a connection with the land in urban life, bringing physical and mental satisfaction and joy.
text_tgt_raw: 在都市裡打造一座花園，需要投入心力與專業知識，才能在享受城市自然風光的同時，也能豐收。首先，必須依照這裡的氣候條件和可用空間，審慎選擇適合的植物，並考量每種植物對陽光的需求。土壤的準備是成功的基礎，初期便要加入有機肥料來豐富土壤，提供植物生長所需的養分。澆水要持續且適量，尤其在乾燥時期，更要留意土壤的濕度。此外，在植物成長的過程中，以生態友善的方式防治病蟲害，是保護產量的重要環節。對於都市園丁來說，耐心是不可或缺的美德，因為需要等待種子發芽、果實成熟。這個過程不僅能產出新鮮的食材，也讓我們在都市生活中，建立起與土地的連結，帶來身心的滿足與喜悅。
base_en: Caring for an urban garden implies dedication and knowledge to achieve a successful harvest, while enjoying nature in the city. It's essential to choose the right plants according to the climate and available space, while considering the sunlight needs of each species. Soil preparation is fundamental, enriching it with organic fertilizer among the initial steps, to provide the necessary nutrients. Watering must be constant, but without excess, paying attention to humidity amid dry periods. In addition, preventing pests and diseases is key, applying ecological methods while plants grow, to protect production. Patience is an indispensable virtue among urban gardeners, while waiting for seeds to germinate and fruits to ripen. This process not only generates fresh food, but also fosters a connection with the earth amid urban life, providing well-being and personal satisfaction.

text_es: I clearly remember the first time I decided to tend to an urban garden. The space in my apartment was becoming increasingly suffocating, and on an impulse, I decided to give it a try. Initially, I only placed a few potted plants on the balcony, growing tomatoes and basil. To be honest, I had no idea what I was doing back then. However, the plants slowly grew at their own pace, and I learned a lot by observing their needs in the early morning sun. In my busy daily life, watering these small plants became a moment of tranquility for me, almost a form of meditation. What was even more delightful was that I shared the first harvest with three neighbors, which built a good friendship between us, and we also exchanged gardening tips and seeds. Now, my garden has expanded to ten potted plants, and I've even opened up a small space on the rooftop, alongside other community gardens, making me feel closer to nature every day.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚記得第一次決定打理都市花園的情景，那時公寓裡空間越來越讓人窒息，一時衝動之下，便決定開始嘗試。起初，我只在陽台上擺了幾個盆栽，種著番茄與羅勒，老實說，那時我根本不知所措。然而，植物們以自己的步調緩緩成長，我在每天清晨的陽光下觀察它們的需求，從中學到了許多。在日常繁忙的生活裡，為這些小小的植物澆水，成了我片刻的寧靜，幾乎是種冥想。更令人開心的是，我還與三位鄰居分享了第一批收成，這讓我們之間建立了良好的情誼，大家也相互交流著園藝小撇步與種子。現在，我的花園已經擴展到十個盆栽，甚至在頂樓也開闢了一小塊空間，與其他社區花園並排著，每天都讓我感覺與大自然更為貼近。
base_en: I perfectly remember the 1st time I decided to take care of an urban garden. It was an impulsive decision, while my apartment felt more and more suffocating. I started with a few pots on the balcony, among cherry tomatoes and basil, and the truth is I didn't know what I was doing. I learned a lot, while the plants grew at their own pace, observing their needs under the morning sun. Amid the daily routine, watering my small plantings became a moment of peace, almost meditative. In addition, I was able to share the 1st fruits with 3 neighbors, which generated a nice camaraderie, while we shared tips and seeds. Now I've 10 pots and a small space on the rooftop, amid other community gardens, and every day I feel more connected with nature.

text_es: To create a garden in the city, the first task is to carefully choose a location, ensuring at least six hours of ample sunlight daily, while good ventilation is also crucial, as it can effectively prevent pests and diseases. Initially, it's a good idea to start with easy-to-care-for crops like lettuce, radishes, or herbs, allowing yourself to gradually become familiar with the garden's growth rhythm. Establishing a regular watering schedule is important, but you still need to adjust the frequency flexibly based on factors such as climate and plant type. As plants grow, be sure to carefully watch for potential pests, diseases, or nutrient deficiencies, and take prompt action. Furthermore, sharing knowledge and resources with neighbors or friends can not only greatly simplify the care process but also provide valuable experience. In this bustling city, a small garden can not only provide fresh produce but also create a green space for us to relax and connect with nature, truly allowing one to enjoy it all.
text_tgt_raw: 在都市裡打造一座花園，首要任務是慎選地點，確保每日至少有六小時的充足日照，同時良好的通風也極為關鍵，能有效預防病蟲害。起初，不妨從萵苣、蘿蔔或香草等易於照料的作物著手，讓自己逐步熟悉花園的生長節奏。建立規律的澆水計畫固然重要，但仍需依氣候與植物種類等因素彈性調整頻率。在植物成長的過程中，務必細心留意是否有潛在的病蟲害或營養缺乏問題，並迅速採取應對措施。此外，與鄰居或朋友分享知識與資源，不僅能大幅簡化照護過程，更能從中獲得寶貴經驗。在這喧囂的都市裡，一座小小的花園不僅能提供新鮮的食材，更為我們創造了一個放鬆身心、親近自然的綠意空間，讓人著實享受這一切。
base_en: When starting to care for an urban garden, it's essential to choose a good location, making sure it receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight, while good ventilation is also crucial to prevent diseases. To do this, it's convenient to start with easy-to-maintain crops, such as lettuces, radishes, or aromatic herbs, while you familiarize yourself with the rhythm of your garden. Establish a regular watering schedule, but adjust the frequency according to the climate and type of plant, among the factors to consider. While the plants grow, be attentive to possible pests or nutritional deficiencies, acting quickly to correct them. Consider partnering with neighbors or friends, sharing knowledge and resources among everyone, which will greatly facilitate the process. Amid the city, a garden not only provides fresh food, but also creates a space for relaxation and connection with nature, while enjoying the process.

text_es: When planning a train trip in Spain or Europe, there are many aspects to consider to ensure a smooth journey. First, it's crucial to decide on your destination and dates early, and to compare ticket prices and schedules from different train companies, especially when traveling during peak season. Among the many options, there are everything from high-speed trains to slow, scenic routes where you can fully enjoy the views outside the window. Remember to book your tickets in advance, as prices usually increase and seats become scarcer as the departure date approaches. Additionally, we also need to consider baggage restrictions and whether any special services are needed, such as assistance for passengers with reduced mobility; these are all on the pre-trip checklist. Checking transfer information between cities and estimating transfer times is even more critical to ensure everything is properly arranged. Finally, it's recommended to carry necessary documents—ID card or passport—and have your physical or electronic ticket ready to avoid any inconvenience during your journey.
text_tgt_raw: 在規劃西班牙或歐洲的火車之旅時，為了確保旅途順暢，有許多層面需要考量。首先，提早決定目的地和日期至關重要，並且比較各家火車公司的票價和班次，特別是在旺季旅行時。在眾多選項裡，從高速列車到緩慢欣賞風景的觀光路線皆有，沿途能盡情享受窗外景色。切記要提前預訂車票，因為隨著出發日期的接近，票價通常會上漲，座位也會越來越少。此外，我們也需要考量行李的限制，以及是否需要任何特殊服務，例如行動不便旅客的協助，這些都在旅行前的準備清單裡。查詢城市間的轉乘資訊並預估轉車時間更是關鍵，以確保一切安排妥當。最後，建議隨身攜帶必要的證件——身份證或護照，並準備好實體或電子車票，以避免旅途中的任何不便。
base_en: Planning a train trip in Spain or Europe requires considering several aspects for a smooth experience. 1st, it's essential to choose the destination and dates in advance, while comparing train fares and schedules, especially if we're traveling during peak season. Among the available options, we can find everything from high-speed trains to slower scenic routes, while enjoying the landscape. It's important to book tickets in advance, as prices usually go up as the travel date approaches, while availability decreases. Furthermore, we need to think about the permitted luggage and if any special service is needed, such as assistance for people with reduced mobility, amid the preparation. Checking connections between cities and anticipating transfer times is crucial, while making sure everything fits. Finally, it's advisable to carry the necessary documentation—ID or passport—and have tickets, whether physical or digital, on hand, to avoid setbacks amid the journey.

text_es: I remember the first time I planned a European train trip with my friends; it was truly chaotic. At that time, we were busy coordinating our schedules and preferences, but time was slipping away little by little. Initially, we wanted to spend 15 days crossing four countries, including Spain and Italy, which sounded very exciting. However, during the enthusiastic discussions about these possible routes, the first problem emerged: where would we spend each night? How many train rides would there be during the trip? Although some stops were still undecided, we decided to book train tickets two months in advance to avoid not having seats later. Finally, amidst so much uncertainty and debate, we eventually came up with an itinerary that satisfied everyone. It was an interesting experience, and we also learned how to reconcile our different ideas.
text_tgt_raw: 我記得第一次和朋友們規劃歐洲火車之旅時，真的是手忙腳亂。那時候，我們忙著協調彼此的時間與偏好，時間卻一點一滴地流逝。最初，我們想花15天橫跨四個國家，其中包含西班牙和義大利，聽起來非常令人興奮。然而，在對這些可能路線的熱切討論中，第一個難題就浮現了：每天晚上要在哪裡過夜？旅程中會搭乘多少班火車？儘管有些停靠點仍未確定，我們還是決定提早兩個月預訂火車票，以免到時候沒位置。最後，在這麼多的不確定與爭論裡，我們終於制定出了一個讓大家都滿意的行程。這是一次有趣的經歷，我們也從中學會了如何調和彼此不同的想法。
base_en: I remember my 1st attempt to plan a train trip through Europe with my friends. It was a mess, while we were trying to coordinate our schedules and preferences, time was running out. The initial idea was to spend 15 days traveling through 4 countries, among them Spain and Italy, which seemed exciting. However, amid the euphoria for the possible routes, the 1st complications arose: where would we sleep each night? How many trains would we take? We decided to book the train tickets 2 months in advance, while we were still unsure about some stops, so we wouldn't be left without a place. In the end, among so much uncertainty and debate, we achieved an itinerary that satisfied us all. It was a fun experience, while we learned to reconcile our individual desires.

text_es: When planning a train trip, it's crucial to act early and compare fares and schedules. Especially when traveling during peak season, be sure to look for tickets weeks or even months in advance while deals are still available. Flexible dates are also worth considering here, as weekday fares are usually cheaper than weekend fares. Before departing, please check the company's baggage policy to avoid unexpected situations during your trip. Additionally, while waiting for the train, it's a good idea to learn more about transfer information, especially when your journey covers multiple stages. Bring some books or software for entertainment, enjoy the scenery along the way, and prepare some snacks to go with items sold on the train. Don't forget to confirm that all necessary documents are ready while packing your luggage, ensuring a smooth and successful journey, allowing you to easily experience Taiwan's beautiful scenery, and feel the convenience of online services whether you're taking a bus, taxi, or train.
text_tgt_raw: 規劃火車旅行時，及早行動並比較票價與時刻表至關重要。特別是在旺季旅行，務必提前數週甚至數月尋找車票，趁著優惠還在。這裡的彈性日期也值得考慮，通常平日票價會比週末便宜。出發前，請先查閱公司的行李政策，以避免行程中發生意料之外的狀況。此外，在等待列車的期間，不妨多了解轉乘資訊，尤其當旅程涵蓋多個階段時。帶上一些書本或軟體影音娛樂，一邊欣賞沿途風光，一邊享受旅程，也能準備些點心，搭配車上販售的商品。別忘了在打包行李的同時，確認所有必備證件都已備妥，確保這趟旅程圓滿順暢，讓您能輕鬆地體驗台灣美麗的風景，無論是搭乘公車、計程車或火車，都能感受到便利的網路服務。
base_en: When planning a train trip, it's crucial to start early, while comparing prices and schedules. Look for tickets several weeks or even months in advance, especially if you're traveling during high season, while offers are still available. Consider the flexibility of your dates; prices are usually lower during the week than on weekends. Check the company's baggage policies, to avoid surprises in the middle of your journey. In addition, while you wait for departure, find out about connections and transfers, especially if your trip includes several stages. It's a good idea to bring something to read or for entertainment, while you enjoy the scenery, and some provisions, among the products they sell on board. Don't forget to check the necessary documentation, while you pack your suitcase, to ensure a smooth trip.

text_es: In recent years, baking bread at home has become a deeply rewarding activity, with more and more people getting involved in pursuit of healthier, more personalized options. The baking process begins with carefully selected ingredients, most commonly flour, water, yeast, and salt, though creativity knows no bounds. Kneading the dough is a crucial step; this is when the gluten network in the dough gradually forms, providing structure to the bread, and it's often seen as a relaxing moment. Next, the dough needs time to ferment, doubling in volume in a warm environment, as the carbon dioxide produced by the yeast forms bubbles inside. Baking it at the right temperature is to achieve a crispy crust and a soft interior; watching the bread transform in the kitchen is truly fascinating. As the bread bakes, the aroma fills the entire home, a feeling that is incomparable, and finally, enjoying a slice of freshly baked bread, perhaps sharing it with friends, is the sweetest reward of this artisanal process.
text_tgt_raw: 近年來，在家自製麵包已成為一項深具成就感的活動，越來越多人為了追求更健康、更個人化的選擇而投身其中。製作過程始於嚴選食材，最常見的莫過於麵粉、水、酵母和鹽，當然，創意無限。揉麵糰是關鍵一步，此時麵糰裡的麵筋網絡逐漸形成，為麵包提供結構，這也常被視為一個放鬆的時刻。接著，麵糰需要時間發酵，在溫暖的環境裡體積會膨脹一倍，酵母產生的二氧化碳則在內部形成氣泡。將其在適當溫度下烘烤，是為了獲得酥脆的外皮和柔軟的內部，看著麵包在廚房裡轉變著，實在令人著迷。當麵包烘烤時，香氣會瀰漫著整個家裡，那種感覺無可比擬，最後，品嚐一片剛出爐的新鮮麵包，也許與朋友分享，這就是這項手工藝過程最甜美的回報。
base_en: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that has gained popularity in recent years, while many people are looking for healthier and more personalized options. The process begins by selecting quality ingredients: flour, water, yeast, and salt, among the most common, although creativity has no limits. Kneading the dough is a fundamental step, while the gluten networks that will give structure to the bread develop, which often becomes a moment of relaxation. Then, the dough needs time to rise, doubling its size in a warm environment, while the CO2 produced by the yeast creates the internal bubbles. Baking it at the correct temperature is crucial to obtain a crispy crust and a tender interior, and it's fascinating to observe the transformation in the middle of the kitchen. The aroma that fills the home while the bread bakes is incomparable and, finally, enjoying a freshly made slice, perhaps sharing it among friends, is the reward for this artisanal process.

text_es: Three months ago, I decided to step into the fascinating world of home bread baking. Many people find this task complicated, but I've gained immense satisfaction from it. As the dough ferments in the kitchen, its aroma fills the entire house, creating a warm atmosphere. I remember the first time I baked bread, taking the golden, crispy finished product out of the oven, the sense of fulfillment was truly unparalleled, especially when sharing it with family. Among all the types of bread I've tried, sourdough is my favorite; although it requires more time, the wait is definitely worth it, and I always enjoy a good cup of coffee while waiting. Honestly, among all my hobbies, this is the one that allows me to relax and temporarily disconnect from the outside world the most in my daily life. In this fast-paced online world, this activity allows me to use my hands and creativity while enjoying the process.
text_tgt_raw: 三個月前，我決定踏入自家烘焙麵包的迷人世界。許多人覺得這項任務很複雜，但我卻從中獲得了極大的成就感。麵糰在廚房裡發酵著時，那股香氣便瀰漫了整個屋子，營造出溫馨的氛圍。我記得第一次烤好麵包時，從烤箱裡取出金黃酥脆的成品，那種滿足感真是無與倫比，尤其是和家人分享時更是如此。在所有嘗試過的麵包種類裡，酸種麵包是我的最愛；雖然它需要更多的時間，但等待絕對是值得的，而我在等待的過程中，總會享受一杯好咖啡。老實說，在我所有的嗜好中，這是在日常生活中最能讓我放鬆、暫時與外界斷線的一種。在這個快速運轉的網路世界裡，這項活動讓我在享受過程的同時，也能運用雙手和創意。
base_en: 3 months ago, I decided to venture into the fascinating world of making bread at home, a task that, while many see it as complex, I've found incredibly rewarding. While the dough was rising in the kitchen, the aroma that spread throughout the house was a delight, creating a cozy atmosphere. I remember the 1st time I baked it: the satisfaction of taking a golden, crusty loaf out of the oven was immense, and even more so while sharing the result with my family. Among all the types of bread I've tried, sourdough is my favorite; although it takes more time, the wait is worth it; while I wait, I enjoy a good coffee. The truth is that, among all the hobbies I've had, this is one of the ones that relaxes and disconnects me the most, amid the daily routine. It's an activity that allows me to use my hands and my creativity while I enjoy the process, amid a world that goes so fast.

text_es: For friends who are trying to make handmade bread for the first time, I would suggest starting with simple recipes while familiarizing yourselves with various ingredients and basic techniques. Even if your first attempt isn't ideal, don't get discouraged, because practice makes perfect, and every experience can help you improve. Having the right tools ready is also very important, such as a good mixing bowl, a scraper, and a kitchen scale; these can make the whole process smoother. In this process, patience is indispensable, especially since dough fermentation takes time. There are so many professional terms and steps here, but the most important thing is to enjoy the fun, watching the bread slowly expand in the oven, and smelling the aroma filling the whole house—that is a kind of happiness. As your confidence grows, feel free to boldly try different flours and ingredients. You will find that in your busy daily life, baking bread can also become a delightful ritual.
text_tgt_raw: 對於初次嘗試製作手工麵包的朋友們，我會建議從簡單的食譜開始，同時熟悉各種食材與基本技巧。即使第一次的成品不盡理想，也千萬別氣餒，因為熟能生巧，每一次的經驗都能幫助你進步。準備好合適的工具也很重要，例如一個好用的攪拌碗、刮刀和磅秤，這些都能讓整個過程更順利。在這個過程裡，耐心是不可或缺的，特別是麵團發酵需要時間。這裡有這麼多專業術語和步驟，但最重要的是享受其中的樂趣，看著麵包在烤箱裡慢慢膨脹，聞著滿屋子瀰漫的香氣，那是一種幸福。隨著信心漸增，不妨大膽嘗試不同的麵粉和配料。你會發現，在繁忙的日常生活中，烘焙麵包也能成為一個令人愉悅的儀式。
base_en: For those venturing into the fascinating world of making homemade bread, a primary piece of advice is to start with simple recipes, while familiarizing yourselves with the ingredients and basic techniques. It's essential not to get discouraged if the 1st attempt isn't perfect, as practice leads to improvement, while one learns from each experience. Make sure you've the right utensils—a good bowl, a spatula, and a scale are essential—among other tools that will facilitate the process. It's crucial to understand that patience is key, while the dough ferments slowly. Amid all the terminology and steps, remember that the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the aroma that fills the house, while the bread bakes. Don't hesitate to experiment with different flours and additions, while you gain confidence. You'll see that, amid the daily routine, baking bread becomes a pleasant ritual.

text_es: Adopting a dog can be a significant commitment, but it also gives animals in need a chance at a new life. As we prepare to enter this new phase, we must carefully consider our lifestyle, the dog's needs, and whether there is enough space in our home. Many dogs are brought to shelters under difficult circumstances, and adoption provides them with a loving and stable home. We should understand that animals need time to adapt to a new environment; they are slowly getting used to everything here. Furthermore, for adopters, the loyal companionship and unconditional joy these furry friends bring are among the greatest benefits. Responsible adoption means investing time and resources to care for their well-being while enjoying this unique and enriching relationship.
text_tgt_raw: 領養狗狗可說是一項重大的承諾，但同時也給予需要幫助的動物一個重獲新生的機會。在準備進入這個新階段時，我們必須審慎考量自己的生活方式、狗狗的需求，以及家裡的空間是否足夠。許多狗狗在艱難的狀況下被送進收容所裡，而領養則為牠們提供了一個充滿愛且穩定的家。我們應當了解，動物適應新環境的過程需要時間，牠們正慢慢習慣著這裡的一切。此外，對於領養者而言，這些毛小孩所帶來的忠實陪伴與無條件的喜悅，正是其中最大的益處。負責任的領養意味著投入時間和資源來照顧牠們的福祉，同時享受這段獨特且豐富的關係。
base_en: Adopting a dog implies a significant commitment, while offering a 2nd chance to an animal in need. It's crucial to consider your lifestyle and the dog's needs, among other things like the available space at home, while preparing for this new stage. Many dogs arrive at shelters amid difficult circumstances, and adoption provides them with a loving and stable home. It should be taken into account that the adaptation process can take time, while the animal gets used to its new environment. Furthermore, among the benefits for the adopter are the loyal companionship and unconditional joy that these animals offer. Adopting responsibly means dedicating time and resources for their well-being, while enjoying a unique and enriching relationship.

text_es: I clearly remember the day we decided to adopt Luna, it was August 1, 2023. We had been looking for a dog for several months, visiting many shelters and constantly browsing information online. When we saw her among the many puppy photos on the shelter's website, we immediately knew she was the one. While my partner was busy filling out the forms, I thought to myself that she was truly beautiful. Although the shelter volunteers were busy with many things that day, they still treated us with enthusiasm. I remember feeling a complex mix of nervousness and excitement during the wait. Now that Luna is with us, seeing her asleep at my feet every day, I know this is the best decision we've ever made.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚記得我們決定領養Luna的那一天，那是2023年8月1日。我們為此找尋狗狗已數月之久，期間造訪了許多收容所，也一直在網路上瀏覽著各種資訊。當我們在收容所的網站裡，從眾多幼犬照片中看見她時，我們立刻就知道是她了。我的伴侶忙著填寫表格時，我心裡想著她實在太美了。那天收容所的志工們雖然忙著處理許多事，卻仍熱忱地對待我們。我記得在等待的過程裡，我心中充滿了既緊張又興奮的複雜情緒。如今，Luna已來到我們這裡，每天看著她在我的腳邊睡著，我便知道，這是我們這輩子做過最棒的決定。
base_en: I perfectly remember the day we decided to adopt Luna; it was August 1, 2023. We'd been looking for a dog for months, while visiting shelters and browsing the internet. We saw her on the shelter's website, among photos of other puppies, and we instantly knew it was her. While my partner filled out the form, I couldn't stop thinking about how beautiful she was. There was a lot of commotion among the volunteers that day, but they still treated us with incredible kindness. I remember that, while we waited, I felt a mix of nervousness and excitement. Now, Luna is here with us, and every day, as I watch her sleep at my feet, I know it was the best decision.

text_es: Before adopting a dog, it's essential to thoroughly research breeds to find the best companion for your lifestyle, and carefully assess how much time you can dedicate to walking and playing with it. Make sure your home is prepared, potential hazards are removed, and a dedicated space is created for your new friend, while also considering veterinary fees and food expenses. Early socialization for dogs is crucial, as it lays the foundation for their good behavior in the future, and basic training is, of course, indispensable. Most importantly, the entire family must reach a consensus, commit to this responsibility, and understand that the adaptation process requires patience. Amidst the excitement, don't forget the importance of continuous learning; both you and your dog will grow together from this experience. Additionally, be sure to find a trustworthy veterinarian near your home to provide initial and subsequent health check-ups for your dog, and you might also consider pet insurance to safeguard its health.
text_tgt_raw: 在領養狗狗之前，務必深入研究犬種，找出最適合您生活型態的夥伴，並仔細評估您能投入多少時間陪伴牠散步與玩耍。確保家裡準備妥當，清除潛在危險，為新朋友打造一個專屬空間，同時也要將獸醫費用及飼料開銷納入考量。狗狗的早期社會化至關重要，這為牠未來的良好行為奠定基礎，基本的訓練當然也不可少。最重要的是，全家人都必須達成共識，承諾承擔這份責任，並理解適應過程需要耐心。在興奮之餘，別忘了持續學習的重要性，您與狗狗都將從中互相成長。此外，務必在您住家附近找到一位值得信賴的獸醫，為狗狗提供初次及日後的健康檢查，也可考慮寵物保險，為牠的健康提供保障。
base_en: Before adopting a dog, thoroughly research breeds to find one that suits your lifestyle, while evaluating your available time for walks and games. Make sure your home is prepared, eliminating potential hazards and establishing a space of their own for your new friend, while considering veterinary and food costs. Think about early socialization, as it's crucial for good future behavior, among other important aspects like basic training. It's essential that the entire family agrees and commits to the responsibility, while everyone understands that adaptation requires patience. Amid the excitement, don't forget the importance of continuous education, both for you and for the dog, while you learn from each other. Find a trusted veterinarian among the professionals in your area for initial and future check-ups, and consider pet insurance.

text_es: Last Saturday, I finally mustered the courage to assemble the new bookshelf in the living room that I had been putting off. After opening the box, I found fifteen wooden panels and an instruction manual that looked like a foreign language, while my dog watched me curiously from the side. Faced with so many panels and screws, I momentarily felt despair, but after taking a deep breath, I decided to follow the pictures step by step. Just then, a friend called to check in on me, and I struggled to manage both the call and the assembly. Honestly, between the neighbor's noise and my lack of experience, the process was much slower than expected, and I carefully fitted each part together. After nearly three hours, the bookshelf finally stood up, perhaps a little crooked, but at least fully functional. Looking at this finished product, born out of my little chaos, a sense of accomplishment welled up within me.
text_tgt_raw: 上週六，我終於鼓起勇氣，著手組裝客廳裡那個我老是拖延的全新書架。打開箱子後，裡頭躺著十五塊木板和一本看似天書的說明書，而我的狗狗則在一旁好奇地看著我。面對這麼多板子和螺絲，我一度感到絕望，但深吸一口氣後，我決定照著圖片一步一步來。這時，朋友打電話來問我狀況，我邊講電話邊努力應付。說真的，在鄰居的噪音和我缺乏經驗的雙重夾擊下，這個過程比預期中慢了許多，我小心翼翼地將每塊零件嵌合。歷經將近三個小時，書架終於立了起來，或許有點歪斜，但至少功能俱全。看著這個在我的小混亂中誕生的成品，一股成就感油然而生。
base_en: Last Saturday, I embarked on the adventure of assembling a new bookshelf for the living room, a task I always postpone while I look for the perfect moment. Upon opening the box, I found 15 wooden pieces and an instruction manual that seemed written in hieroglyphics, while my dog watched me with curiosity. There was a moment of despair amid so many boards and screws, but I took a deep breath and decided to follow the pictures, while a friend called me on the phone to ask how I was doing. The truth is that, between the neighbors' noises and my own inexperience, the process was slower than expected, while I tried to fit each piece. Finally, after almost 3 hours, the bookshelf was standing, a little crooked perhaps, but functional, and a feeling of pride washed over me amid my small chaos.

text_es: To efficiently assemble the shelf, we must first carefully read the instructions and confirm all parts and hardware. Before you start, make sure you have the right tools on hand, such as a screwdriver, hammer, and level. When assembling, be sure to follow the manufacturer's recommended order. Here's a tip: sort screws and accessories into different compartments, which will make them easier to find when needed. If the shelf is large or heavy, stability may be difficult to maintain when handling long panels; in this case, it's a good idea to ask someone for assistance. After assembly, check that each joint is secure and use a level to confirm the structure is straight, so that items placed on the shelf will not wobble due to instability. Please don't rush; calmly complete each step, and you will enjoy a sturdy and practical new shelf.
text_tgt_raw: 為了有效率地組裝層架，我們首先要仔細閱讀說明書，並確認所有零件與五金配件。動手前，請確保手邊有合適的工具，像是螺絲起子、榔頭和水平儀。組裝時，務必按照製造商建議的順序進行。這裡有個小撇步，將螺絲和配件分門別類地放在不同隔層裡，這樣在需要時會更為方便。如果層架體積較大或重量不輕，處理長型面板時，穩定性可能較難掌握，這時不妨找人從旁協助。組裝完成後，檢查每個接合處是否牢固，並用水平儀確認結構是否筆直，如此一來，層架上擺放的物品才不會因不穩而搖晃。請別著急，從容地完成每個步驟，您將能享受到一個穩固又實用的新層架。
base_en: To efficiently assemble a shelf unit, it's crucial to start by carefully reading the instructions, while identifying all the parts and hardware. Make sure you've the right tools on hand—screwdrivers, hammer, and level—while following the assembly order suggested by the manufacturer. It's very useful to sort screws and fittings into the different compartments of a box, which will simplify the process as you need them. Ask someone for help if the shelf unit is large or heavy, as it can be difficult to maintain stability while handling long panels. Check that all joints are firm, while verifying with the level that the structure is perfectly straight, thus avoiding future instabilities among the objects you place. Don't rush, take your time with each step, and you'll enjoy your new, well-assembled shelf unit.

text_es: To enjoy a well-deserved vacation without worries and to meticulously plan every detail of the trip, early saving is indispensable. This involves many financial strategies, such as regularly allocating a portion of income into a dedicated fund. We should create a clear budget for daily expenses, considering costs like transportation, accommodation, dining, and activities, and strive to reduce unnecessary spending. Methods like the 50/30/20 rule can also be applied, dedicating 20% of income to savings while managing other expenses appropriately. Furthermore, comparing prices and deals among various options can effectively optimize fund utilization. For instance, using online price comparison software can help find the best flight tickets and hotels. From here to there, whether taking a bus or a taxi, transportation costs must be included in the budget. When faced with the temptation to spend, consistency and discipline are especially important, as they lay the foundation for achieving goals and fully enjoying the travel experience.
text_tgt_raw: 為了能無憂無慮地享受應得的假期，同時也將旅程的每個細節都規劃完善，提早儲蓄是不可或缺的。這涵蓋了許多財務策略，例如定期將一部分收入撥入專用基金裡。我們應在日常開銷中制定明確的預算，將交通、住宿、餐飲和活動等費用納入考量，並努力減少不必要的支出。像50/30/20法則這類方法也能應用上，將20%的收入專門用於儲蓄，同時妥善管理其他開支。此外，比較各種選擇裡的價格和優惠，也能有效優化資金運用。舉例來說，利用網路上的比價軟體，可以找到最優惠的機票和飯店。從這裡到那裡，無論是搭乘公車還是計程車，都要將交通費用納入預算。面對消費的誘惑，保持一致性與紀律尤為重要，這為達成目標並充分享受旅行體驗奠定了基礎。
base_en: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries, while every detail of the trip is planned. It consists of allocating a regular portion of income to a specific fund, among other financial strategies. It's advisable to establish a clear budget, amid daily expenses, that considers transportation, accommodation, food, and activities, while seeking to reduce unnecessary expenses. Methods such as the 50/30/20 rule can be applied, where 20% of income is dedicated to savings, while other commitments are managed. In addition, it's useful to compare prices and offers, among the various available options, to optimize money. It's important to be consistent and disciplined, amid the temptations to spend, to achieve the desired goal and fully enjoy the experience.

text_es: Last year, I decided to go to Japan, and although the idea sounded a bit crazy at first, I immediately started saving money. Every month when I got paid, I would transfer a fixed percentage of the money to another account, which very few of my colleagues did. In my busy daily work, it was easy for me to forget this goal, but as soon as I thought of the many temples and delicious food there, I remained full of motivation even when my friends were out having fun. This was indeed a challenge, but as I watched my savings grow, my excitement also increased. Through various sacrifices and trade-offs, I finally saved up this money. Now, I am writing these words here, with only three days left until my flight, and my heart is filled with anticipation for the future; I can truly say that all this effort was very worthwhile.
text_tgt_raw: 去年我決定要去日本，雖然這個想法一開始聽起來有點瘋狂，但我立刻就開始存錢了。每個月領到薪水時，我會將固定比例的錢轉到另一個帳戶裡，這在我的同事裡很少人會這麼做。在日常忙碌的工作中，我很容易忘記這個目標，但一想到那裡有許多寺廟和美食，即使朋友都出去玩樂了，我也還是充滿動力。這確實是個挑戰，但我看著存款數字漸漸增長，心裡的興奮感也隨之提升。在種種犧牲和取捨中，我總算是存到了這筆錢。現在，我正在這裡寫著這段文字，距離我的航班只剩下三天，心裡充滿著對未來的期待，我真的能說這一切的努力都非常值得。
base_en: Last year, I decided I wanted to go to Japan, and, while the idea seemed crazy at 1st, I started saving immediately. Every month, while I received my salary, I put a fixed percentage into a separate account, something that, among my colleagues, few did. Amid the daily work routine, it was easy to forget the goal, but the thought of the temples and the food, while my friends were out partying, kept me motivated. It was a challenge, but, while I watched the amount grow, my excitement increased, and, among sacrifices and small renunciations, I managed to gather the money. Now, while I'm writing this, I'm 3 days away from my flight, amid the excitement of what awaits me, and I can say that the effort was worth it.

text_es: To achieve your dream vacation, it's crucial to establish a clear budget and closely monitor your monthly expenses. Even if the amount is small, prioritize saving a fixed amount of money each month, as consistent saving between income and expenses is fundamental. You might consider opening a separate savings account for this purpose, which can help you avoid using that money for other things, while also looking for ways to reduce unnecessary spending in your daily life. For example, you can limit how often you eat out, or use the internet to find service deals, and plan flights and accommodations in advance to find better prices. Saving amidst daily responsibilities might seem complicated, but with discipline and timely adjustments, you'll watch your savings grow, and that much-anticipated time off will get closer and closer.
text_tgt_raw: 為了夢想中的假期，確立清晰的預算並密切監控每月開銷至關重要。即使金額不大，也要優先設定每個月固定存下一些錢，因為在收入與支出之間持續儲蓄是根本。可以考慮為此開設一個獨立的儲蓄帳戶，這能幫助您避免將那裡的錢挪作他用，同時在日常生活中尋找減少不必要開支的方法。例如，您可以限制外食次數，或利用網路尋找服務優惠，並提早規劃機票和住宿，以找到更好的價格。在每日的責任裡儲蓄可能看似複雜，但只要有紀律並適時調整，您會看著存款逐漸增長，而那值得期待的休息日也離您越來越近了。
base_en: To save for vacation, it's crucial to establish a clear budget, while monitoring your monthly expenses. Prioritize allocating a fixed amount each month, even if it's small, as consistent saving among your income and expenses is fundamental. Consider opening a separate savings account for that purpose, which will help you avoid the temptation to use that money for other things, while looking for ways to reduce unnecessary costs in your daily life. You can, for example, limit eating out or look for deals on services, while planning ahead to find better prices on flights and accommodation. Saving amid your daily responsibilities may seem complicated, but with discipline and adjustments, you'll see your savings grow, while your well-deserved rest approaches.

text_es: Learning a new language is truly a rich experience that opens doors to different cultures and allows us to communicate with more people. It is a process that requires dedication and patience, full of challenges, but with persistence, they can ultimately be overcome. As we develop new language skills, it also exercises our minds, enhancing cognitive acuity and problem-solving abilities, among many other benefits. There are various ways to achieve this goal, from intensive courses to self-study software, and many believe that full immersion in the language's place of origin is the most effective method. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially during the most difficult stages, where frustration and slow progress can be discouraging. The more one practices, the more natural it becomes, transforming the unfamiliar into the familiar.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一門新語言著實是一場豐富的經歷，它為我們開啟了通往不同文化的大門，讓我們得以與更多的人溝通交流。這是一項需要投入奉獻與耐心的過程，其中充滿了挑戰，但只要持之以恆，終能克服。在我們發展新的語言技能的同時，這裡也鍛鍊著我們的心智，除了提升認知敏銳度與解決問題的能力外，還有許多其他益處。達成這個目標的方法多樣，從密集的課程到自學軟體，而許多人認為，完全沉浸在該語言的發源地更是最有效的方式。保持學習的動力至關重要，尤其是在最艱難的階段，在那裡，挫折感與緩慢的進步可能會讓人氣餒。一個人練習得越多，就會變得越自然，將陌生轉化為熟悉。
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, while allowing us to communicate with more people. It's a process that demands dedication and patience, amid constant challenges that, with perseverance, are overcome. While we develop new linguistic skills, we also train our mind, improving cognitive agility and problem-solving ability, among other benefits. Many methods exist to achieve this—from intensive courses to self-taught learning—while total immersion in the language's country of origin is considered by many the most effective way. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially amid the most difficult phases, between frustration and slow progress. The more one practices, the more natural it becomes, transforming the unknown into the familiar.

text_es: I clearly remember my experience starting to learn Japanese five years ago; it was an experience that completely changed my perspective. At the time, I was working full-time and also enrolled in classes, which was truly a big challenge in terms of time management. Within the thick grammar books and dictionaries, I not only learned the language but also discovered fascinating Japanese culture; hiragana and katakana intertwined in my mind, and I felt like a child then. Initially, the gentle consonants and short vowels in Japanese made its pronunciation sound both unfamiliar and peculiar to me. For several days, when I struggled to form complex sentences, the frustration was so real and intense. However, even with all the difficulties, every time I understood a new vocabulary word or successfully formed a correct sentence, the satisfaction was unparalleled; while others might have been discouraged by this, I persevered because the sense of accomplishment from understanding new knowledge was my greatest motivation.
text_tgt_raw: 我清楚記得五年前開始學習日文的經歷，那是一次徹底改變我觀點的體驗。當時我一面全職工作，一面還報名上課，這在時間分配上著實為一大挑戰。在厚重的文法書和字典裡，我不僅學習語言，更發現了迷人的日本文化；平假名和片假名在我腦海裡交織著，那時的我感覺自己就像個孩子一樣。起初，日文裡溫和的子音和短促的母音，讓它的發音聽起來對我來說既陌生又奇特。有那麼幾天，當我努力想組成複雜的句子時，那種挫折感是如此真實而強烈。然而，即使困難重重，每當我理解一個新詞彙或成功造出一個正確的句子時，那份滿足感都無與倫比；當其他人都因此感到氣餒時，我卻堅持不懈，因為理解新知的成就感就是我最大的動力。
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese 5 years ago, and it was an experience that changed my perspective. I signed up for classes while working full-time, which was a significant logistical challenge. Amid grammar books and dictionaries, I discovered a fascinating culture; while hiragana and katakana characters mixed in my mind, I felt like a child. The pronunciation, among the soft consonants and short vowels, felt strange to me at 1st. There were days, while I was trying to form complex sentences, when the frustration was palpable. However, amid the difficulty, the satisfaction of understanding a new word or constructing a correct sentence was immense; while others became discouraged, I persisted, because the reward of understanding was my driving force.

text_es: When learning a new language, it's important to immerse yourself in the language environment, but also to maintain realistic expectations. A common mistake many people make is trying to master every detail at the beginning, instead of accepting the gradual process; we should celebrate every small improvement and expose ourselves to authentic language materials. When listening and reading, don't rush to translate every word, but instead focus on understanding the overall context, which is a very effective method. It's inevitable to encounter setbacks during the learning process, which can make you feel discouraged, but please remember your initial motivation for learning and maintain daily discipline; spend at least thirty minutes every day, and also look for opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the many available resources, such as some learning software, online videos, broadcasts, or reading materials, choose only two or three tools that truly suit you; don't let too many methods overwhelm you. Most importantly, keep it fun throughout this process, for example, you can use fragmented time to learn when taking the bus or a taxi.
text_tgt_raw: 學習一門新語言時，沉浸在語言環境裡固然重要，但同時也要抱持著切合實際的期望。許多人常犯的錯誤是想在剛開始時就掌握所有細節，而不是接受循序漸進的過程；我們應慶祝每個小小的進步，並讓自己接觸真實的語言資料。在聽與讀的時候，別急著翻譯每個字詞，而應專注於理解整體語境，這是一種極為有效的方法。在學習過程中難免會遇到挫折，那裡會讓你感到氣餒，但請務必記住最初的學習動機，並保持日常的紀律；每天至少花三十分鐘，同時尋找機會與母語人士練習。在眾多可用的資源裡，例如一些學習軟體、網路上的影片、廣播或閱讀資料，選擇兩到三個真正適合你的工具即可，別讓過多的方法讓自己不堪負荷，最重要的是，在這個過程裡保持樂趣，像是搭公車或計程車時都可以利用零碎時間來學習。
base_en: When beginning to learn a new language, it's crucial to immerse yourself completely, while maintaining realistic expectations. Among the most common mistakes is wanting to master everything at 1st, instead of accepting gradual progress; it's important to celebrate every small advance while exposing yourself to authentic material. While listening and reading, try not to translate every word, but rather to understand the general context, a very effective method. Amid the frustration that will inevitably arise, remember why you started and maintain daily discipline; dedicate at least 30 minutes a day, while looking for opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the available resources, choose 2 or 3 that really work for you and don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods, while having fun with the process.

text_es: Participating in a popular road race is not just a sporting competition, but also a grand event for everyone to enjoy together. Here, runners of all ages and skill levels gather, sweating it out on the track together, filled with a spirit of mutual encouragement and the pursuit of self-transcendence. These races usually offer distances such as 5K, 10K, or even half marathons, giving participants the opportunity to test their physical limits while also fully enjoying the carnival-like lively atmosphere. Along the route, enthusiastic spectators can often be seen cheering for the runners on the streets, creating an infectious energy, and the runners themselves are working hard to achieve their respective goals. For these types of races, athletes usually prepare two to three months in advance through progressive and consistent training, while also paying attention to diet and rest. Finally, the moment they cross the finish line, amidst the applause of the crowd and the satisfaction of completing the challenge, that sense of accomplishment itself is the best reward, and many people are already planning their next race there.
text_tgt_raw: 參與一場熱門的路跑賽事，不僅是體育競技，更是一場全民同樂的盛會。在這裡，來自各年齡層與不同實力水平的跑者齊聚一堂，共同在賽道上揮灑汗水，彼此間洋溢著互相鼓勵與追求自我超越的精神。這些賽事通常設有5公里、10公里，甚至是半程馬拉松等距離，讓參與者有機會測試自己的體能極限，同時也能盡情享受那份嘉年華般的熱鬧氛圍。沿途常可見到熱情的民眾在街邊為跑者加油，營造出充滿感染力的能量，而跑者們也為著達成各自的目標而努力著。為了這類賽事，選手們通常會提前二到三個月，透過循序漸進且持之以恆的訓練來準備，並同時注意飲食與休息。最終，當衝過終點線的那一刻，在群眾的掌聲與完成挑戰的滿足感裡，那份成就感本身就是最好的獎勵，許多人甚至在那裡已經在規劃下一場賽事了。
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a sporting event open to the general public, where runners of various ages and skill levels compete together, while fostering coexistence and a spirit of self-improvement. These races, which often include distances of 5 km, 10 km, or even half marathons, are an excellent opportunity to test physical endurance, while enjoying the festive atmosphere. It's common to see people cheering in the streets, creating an atmosphere of contagious energy, while participants strive to achieve their goals. Preparation for a popular race usually requires gradual and constant training, while taking care of diet and rest, between 2 and 3 months before the event. Finally, the moment of crossing the finish line is a reward in itself, amid the applause of the public and the satisfaction of having completed the challenge, while many are already thinking about the next race.

text_es: This Sunday, I decided to participate in my first community fun run, an experience I've always wanted to try. In the early morning, before the sun had fully appeared, I woke up early feeling both nervous and excited. Arriving at the starting line, the atmosphere was truly fantastic! Over five hundred people gathered there, including experienced runners and beginners like me, everyone with a smile on their face. While waiting for the starting gun, I chatted with the person next to me, and they gave me some encouragement. The first two kilometers were a bit tough, but the cheers from the crowd and the energy everyone exuded kept pushing me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the familiar street scenery along the way, and when I crossed the finish line, amidst everyone's applause, the sense of accomplishment was truly unparalleled. Without a doubt, as long as my legs allow it, I will definitely participate again.
text_tgt_raw: 這個星期天，我決定參加我人生中第一次的社區路跑，這是我一直很想嘗試的體驗。清晨，太陽還沒完全露臉，我帶著既緊張又興奮的心情起了個大早。來到起跑線，現場氣氛真是太棒了！超過五百人齊聚這裡，有經驗豐富的跑者，也有像我一樣的初學者，每個人臉上都帶著笑容。等著起跑槍響的時候，我還跟旁邊的人聊了幾句，他給了我一些鼓勵。前面兩公里跑起來有點吃力，但人群裡此起彼落的加油聲，以及大家散發出來的活力，不斷推動著我向前。我按照自己的步調跑著，沿途欣賞著熟悉的街景，而衝過終點線時，在眾人的掌聲中，那種成就感真是無與倫比。毫無疑問，只要我的雙腿還允許，我一定會再參加。
base_en: This Sunday I decided to run my 1st popular race in the neighborhood, an experience I'd been wanting to try for a while. I woke up early, while the sun wasn't fully out yet, with that mix of nerves and excitement. At the starting line, the atmosphere was incredible: there were more than 500 people, among experienced athletes and novices like me, all with a smile. While we waited for the starting gun, I chatted a bit with the person next to me, who gave me some encouragement. The 1st 2 km were tough, but the energy of the people, the shouts of encouragement amid the crowd, pushed me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the scenery as I passed through familiar streets, and the feeling of crossing the finish line, amid all the applause, was unbeatable. Without a doubt, I'll repeat soon, while my legs allow me to.

text_es: When participating in a popular road race for the first time, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and maintain a steady and comfortable pace. Don't try to run too fast with other runners at the start, as that will make you feel tired quickly; it's best to start slowly and let your body gradually adapt. Be sure to get plenty of rest and eat light food two to three hours before the race, while also hydrating sufficiently. During the race, please listen to your body; if you feel uncomfortable in the crowd, slow down or take a break. Remember, the goal is to finish, not to win, and a great sense of accomplishment will be waiting for you when you cross the finish line. Enjoy this unique atmosphere and feel the shared energy among all participants.
text_tgt_raw: 第一次參加熱門路跑時，最重要的是享受過程，保持穩定且舒適的配速。起跑時別想著跟著其他跑者衝太快，那會讓你很快就感到疲憊；最好是緩慢起步，讓身體慢慢適應。賽前兩到三小時務必充分休息並吃些清淡的食物，同時補充足夠水分。比賽中，請傾聽身體的聲音，如果在人群裡感到不適，就放慢腳步或暫停一下。記住，目標是完賽而非求勝，當你穿越終點線時，那裡將會有巨大的成就感等著你。好好享受這份獨特的氛圍吧，感受著所有參賽者間共享的能量。
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience, while maintaining a constant and comfortable pace. Don't try to go too fast at the beginning, among the other runners, as you'll get exhausted quickly; it's preferable to start slowly while your body adapts. Make sure you've rested well and eaten something light 2 or 3 hours before, while hydrating adequately. During the race, listen to your body and, if you feel bad amid the crowd, slow down or stop for a moment. Think that the goal is to finish it, not to win, and while you cross the finish line, you'll feel great satisfaction. Enjoy the atmosphere, among the rest of the participants, and the shared energy amid all the runners.

text_es: Restoring antique furniture is a deeply meaningful process; it not only allows historically significant furniture to regain its former splendor and utility, but more importantly, it preserves their precious cultural value. This work typically involves multiple stages, with deep cleaning and the removal of old paint or coatings as the primary steps, while also carefully assessing the structural integrity of the furniture. In this process, we will use traditional craftsmanship and materials consistent with the furniture's original era to repair damaged parts, such as broken table legs or detached veneers, and we will try to avoid using overly aggressive restoration methods. The choice of the final finish is also crucial; whether it's oil, wax, or varnish, it should aim to reproduce its original appearance or give the furniture new life. This is an art that requires patience and skill, and we must fully consider the furniture's history and style in every aspect. Although many challenges may arise, the final result will be a restored piece of furniture that can continue to bring beauty to the home, tell its own story, and extend its lifespan for decades or even longer.
text_tgt_raw: 修復古董家具是一項極具意義的過程，它不僅能讓蘊含歷史的家具重現昔日風采與實用性，更重要的是，為它們保留著珍貴的文化價值。這項工作通常包含多個階段，其中深度清潔與去除舊有的漆面或塗層為首要步驟，同時需仔細評估家具的結構完整性。在這過程裡，我們將運用傳統工藝及與家具原始年代相符的材料，修復破損的零件，例如斷裂的桌腳或脫落的飾面，並盡量避免使用過於激烈的修復方法。最終塗料的選擇亦是關鍵，無論是油、蠟或清漆，都應旨在重現其原始樣貌，抑或是賦予家具全新的生命。這是一門需要耐心與技巧的藝術，我們必須在每個環節裡，充分考量家具的歷史與風格。儘管這裡可能遇到不少挑戰，但最終的成果將是一件修復如初的家具，它得以繼續為家裡帶來美觀，並訴說著自己的故事，再延續數十年甚至更久的壽命。
base_en: Restoring antique furniture is a rewarding process that revives the beauty and functionality of pieces with history, while preserving their cultural value. Generally, it involves several stages, among them deep cleaning and the removal of old layers of varnish or paint, while the structural integrity of the piece is evaluated. Amid this work, damaged parts, such as broken legs or detached veneers, are repaired using traditional techniques and materials compatible with the furniture's original era, while drastic solutions are avoided. The choice of the final finish is crucial, among options like oils, waxes, or varnishes, while seeking to replicate the original look or give the furniture new life. It's an art that requires patience and skill, while considering the furniture's history and style. Amid the challenges that may arise, the final result is a restored piece that can last many more years, while decorating and telling its own story.

text_es: While strolling through the antique market, the idea of restoring an old piece of furniture suddenly came to mind. There, I saw an Elizabethan-style chest of drawers; it was not only faded but also covered with several layers of paint, obscuring its original charm. Among the many items, only it caught my eye. I started this project with a bit of trepidation, carefully sanding every corner, little by little revealing the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, accompanied by the smell of sawdust and varnish, requiring immense patience to push forward day after day. I learned various woodworking and finishing techniques through professional books and online tutorial videos, while also playing classical music to relax. Watching the furniture regain its former glory felt truly incredible; the reward for all the effort was immense, and I had already begun to imagine its new life in my living room.
text_tgt_raw: 漫步在古董市集裡時，修復一件老傢俱的念頭忽然浮現。我在那裡看見了一個伊莉莎白風格的五斗櫃，它不僅褪了色，還被好幾層油漆覆蓋著，掩蓋了原有的風采；在眾多物品中，唯有它吸引了我的目光。我帶著些許忐忑開始了這項計畫，小心翼翼地打磨著每個角落，一點一滴地揭露了數十年來被隱藏著的木紋。這是一個緩慢的過程，伴隨著木屑與清漆的味道，需要極大的耐心才能日復一日地推進。我透過專業書籍與網路上的教學影片，學習了各種木工與修飾技巧，同時也放著古典樂來放鬆心情。看著傢俱重拾往日的光彩，那感覺真是不可思議；在所有的努力裡，獲得的回報是巨大的，我已經開始想像它在我客廳裡的新生命了。
base_en: The decision to restore an antique piece of furniture came suddenly, while I was strolling through an antique market.
