I saw an Elizabethan chest of drawers, discolored, and with several layers of paint that hid its original beauty; among all the objects, this piece caught my attention. I started the project with some trepidation, while carefully sanding every corner, discovering the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, amid wood shavings and the smell of varnish, that required a lot of patience as I progressed day by day. I learned about different carpentry and finishing techniques, among specialized books and online tutorials, while listening to classical music to relax. Seeing the furniture regain its original splendor was incredible; amid all the effort, the reward was immense, while I imagined its new life in my living room.

text_es: When restoring antique furniture, patience is key throughout the entire process. First, perform a deep cleaning to thoroughly remove dust and grime that has accumulated over the years. Next, carefully inspect the furniture for damage and decide on the restoration approach; here you can consider whether to preserve the original antique patina or lean towards giving it a more modern finish. Be very careful when sanding, gradually moving from coarse to fine sandpaper to prepare for the next steps of staining or painting. When painting, be sure to apply thin, even coats and allow sufficient drying time between each coat. Enjoy the process, watching this antique furniture regain its luster in your hands, as its history and beauty are awakened little by little.
text_tgt_raw: 修復古董傢俱時，耐心是貫穿整個過程的關鍵。首先，進行深度清潔，將長年累月積累的灰塵與髒污徹底清除。接著，仔細檢視傢俱的損傷，並決定修復方向，這裡您可以考慮是保留原始的古樸包漿，還是傾向賦予它更為現代的表面處理。打磨時務必小心翼翼，從粗砂紙逐漸過渡到細砂紙，為接下來的上色或塗漆步驟做好準備。上漆時，請務必塗抹薄而均勻的層次，並在每一層之間等待足夠的乾燥時間。享受這個過程，看著這件古董傢俱在您手中重新綻放光彩，那裡的歷史與美麗正一點一滴地被喚醒。
base_en: When restoring an antique piece of furniture, patience is key while you work through each stage of the process. Start with a deep cleaning, while you remove accumulated dust and dirt from over the years. Identify the damage and define your approach, while you consider whether you want to maintain the original patina or if you prefer a more modern finish among the options. Sand carefully, while you gradually progress from a coarser grit to a finer one, and prepare the surface for the next step, which could be staining or painting. Apply thin, even coats of finish, while you wait the appropriate drying time between each one. Enjoy the process of watching the beauty of the antique furniture resurface in your hands.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party requires meticulous planning and coordination of various details. First, you need to confirm the number of family and friends to invite and set a budget; if you have a preferred theme, you can decide on it at this time as well. Next is choosing the venue; whether it's at home or a rented space, invitations should be sent out as early as possible so guests can make arrangements in advance. At the same time, you should start selecting food and drinks, and think about what activities or games to prepare to entertain everyone, especially the children at the party. Of course, the birthday cake is definitely the highlight of the party, and don't forget to decorate the venue to create a joyful atmosphere. Party software or videos online can also provide a lot of inspiration. In addition to these details, don't forget to consider transportation, such as whether to arrange bus or taxi pick-ups, so everyone can have a good time. Ultimately, among all the preparations, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the warm time spent with family and friends.
text_tgt_raw: 籌辦一場生日派對，需要縝密的規劃與協調各項細節。首先要確認邀請的親友賓客數量，並設定預算，若有喜歡的主題也能在此時一併決定。接著是選擇舉辦地點，無論是在家裡或租借場地，都需盡早發出邀請，好讓賓客們能提早安排。同時，也要開始著手挑選餐點與飲品，並思考準備哪些活動或遊戲來為大家助興，特別是派對裡的小朋友們。當然，生日蛋糕絕對是派對的焦點，別忘了還要佈置現場，營造出歡樂的氣氛。網路上的派對軟體或影片也能提供不少靈感。除了這些細節外，別忘了要預留交通考量，例如是否需安排公車或計程車接送，讓大家都能盡興。最終，在所有準備工作裡，最重要的是享受這個過程，以及與親友相聚的溫馨時光。
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires careful planning while coordinating various elements. It's essential to define the number of guests—among family and friends—and the available budget, while choosing a theme if desired. The selection of the venue is crucial, whether at home or renting a space, and it's important to send it in advance so that guests can organize themselves while the food and drinks are chosen. Activities or games should be considered to entertain attendees, especially the little ones, amid the celebration. Don't forget the cake, the central element of the party, while organizing the decoration to create a festive atmosphere. Finally, amid all the preparations, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the company.

text_es: The process of organizing my 40th birthday party was truly a fantastical journey full of surprises and chaos. Two months prior, I started planning, not only drafting the guest list but also racking my brain to think of a party theme. During the preparation period, I discovered that my home space was insufficient, so I had to actively search for a suitable venue, and expenses consequently rose steadily. To accommodate every guest, I carefully selected the menu, including vegetarian and gluten-free options, hoping that all fifty friends and family members who attended would be satisfied. On the afternoon of the party, as I was surrounded by decorating tasks and guests arriving one after another, a wave of anxiety washed over me; at this point, music was already playing cheerfully, and laughter and chatter began to echo in the air. However, when I finally danced and celebrated with my loved ones, all the previous stress vanished, and despite experiencing all the initial challenges, I felt incredibly happy and joyful.
text_tgt_raw: 籌辦我四十歲生日派對的過程，真是一場充滿驚喜與混亂的奇幻旅程。早在兩個月前，我就開始著手規劃，除了擬定賓客名單，也絞盡腦汁思索派對主題。準備期間，我發現家裡空間不足，不得不積極尋找合適的場地，開銷也因此節節高升。為了照顧到每位賓客，我在素食與無麩質選項裡仔細挑選菜單，希望能讓所有到場的五十位親友都滿意。派對當天下午，當我被布置工作和陸續抵達的賓客包圍時，感到一陣焦慮襲來，此時音樂已輕快地播放著，歡聲笑語也開始在空氣中迴盪。然而，當我最終與摯愛之人一同舞蹈、盡情慶祝時，所有先前的壓力都煙消雲散，儘管經歷了最初的種種挑戰，我卻感到無比的快樂與幸福。
base_en: Organizing my 40th birthday was a real odyssey, between the excitement and the chaos it entailed. I started planning it 2 months in advance, while making guest lists and thinking about the theme. Amid the preparation, I realized that the space in my house wasn't enough, so I had to look for a venue, while expenses soared. I chose a menu that everyone would like, among vegetarian and gluten-free options, while trying to please each of my 50 guests. On the afternoon of the party, amid the decorations and the arrival of the 1st attendees, I felt overwhelmed, while the music was already playing and laughter began to fill the air. In the end, while dancing and celebrating with my loved ones, all the tension dissipated and I felt truly happy, despite the initial challenges.

text_es: Organizing a successful birthday party requires thorough planning. First, make a guest list to know the number of attendees, and also set a realistic budget to avoid overspending. Decide on the date and venue early—if it's a large event, it's best to do so two to three months in advance—and find inspiration for themes and decorations online or from videos. For food and drinks, be sure to consider guests' allergens or dietary preferences. Additionally, you can delegate some tasks to trusted friends and family members so you don't get overwhelmed. Don't forget music and entertainment, and ensure everything is under control so you can fully enjoy the celebration. Perhaps you'll need to take a bus or taxi for shopping, or use an app on your phone to manage information. Most importantly, everyone here should have a good time.
text_tgt_raw: 籌辦一場成功的生日派對需要周詳的規劃。首先，列出賓客名單，以便掌握出席人數，同時也得訂出實際的預算，避免超支。提早決定日期和地點——如果是大型活動，最好提前兩到三個月——並從網路或影片裡尋找主題和佈置的靈感。飲食方面，務必考慮賓客的過敏原或飲食偏好。此外，可以將部分任務分派給值得信賴的親友，這樣才不會讓自己手忙腳亂。別忘了音樂和娛樂，確保一切都在掌握之中，你才能在慶祝活動中盡情享受。或許你會需要搭乘公車或計程車去採買，或是透過手機裡的軟體來管理資料。最重要的是，在這裡，大家都能玩得開心。
base_en: Organizing a successful birthday party requires planning. Start with the guest list to know how many people will attend, while defining a realistic budget so you don't overspend. Decide on the date and venue with enough anticipation—2 to 3 months if it's a large event—while looking for inspiration for the theme and decorations. Think about food and drinks, considering possible allergies or dietary preferences among your guests, and delegate tasks to trusted friends or family members so you don't get overwhelmed. Don't forget the music and entertainment, while making sure everything is under control so you can also enjoy yourself amid the celebration. And most importantly: have fun.

text_es: When caring for indoor plants at home, we need to pay attention to several key elements to ensure their healthy growth and harmonious coexistence with the home environment. First, choosing plant species suitable for the indoor environment is crucial; we must consider the light, temperature, and humidity here, and avoid overwatering or underwatering. Good lighting is key to plant growth; many plants thrive by a window, while others prefer corners with indirect light. Watering methods must be adjusted for individual plants; some need consistently moist soil, while others prefer the soil to dry out slightly between waterings. During these care processes, regular fertilization and dusting of leaves to aid photosynthesis are also important, as is closely monitoring for the appearance of pests and diseases. Common mistakes include overwatering and poor drainage, both of which can lead to plants becoming sick or even dying.
text_tgt_raw: 在家裡照顧室內植物，為了確保它們的健康成長並與居家環境和諧共存，我們需要注意幾個關鍵要素。首先，選擇適合室內環境的植物種類至關重要，必須考量這裡的光照、溫度和濕度，並避免澆水過多或不足。良好的光照是植物生長的關鍵；許多植物在窗邊茁壯成長，而有些則偏好那裡間接光照的角落。澆水方式必須針對個別植物調整，有些需要土壤持續保持濕潤，另一些則偏好在兩次澆水之間讓土壤稍微乾燥。在這些照護過程中，定期施肥和清除葉面灰塵以利光合作用也很重要，同時還要密切監測是否有病蟲害的出現。常見的錯誤包括過度澆水和排水不良，這兩者都可能導致植物生病甚至死亡。
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires attention to several key factors to ensure their health and optimal growth, while integrating them harmoniously into our home. It's essential to choose suitable species for the indoor environment, considering available light, temperature, and humidity, while avoiding over or under watering. Good lighting is crucial; many plants thrive near windows, while others prefer corners with indirect light. Watering must be adapted to each plant, as some need constantly moist soil, while others prefer it to dry slightly between waterings. Amid this care, it's also important to fertilize periodically and clean dust from the leaves to facilitate photosynthesis, while monitoring for the appearance of pests. Among common mistakes are overwatering and lack of adequate drainage, which can cause diseases and the death of the plant.

text_es: Caring for my indoor plants has become a unique personal therapy for me, allowing me to find inner peace no matter how hectic the outside world gets. Every morning while making coffee, I always spend a few minutes quietly observing them, watching how the sunlight from the attic penetrates the clouds and gently illuminates their leaves. I still remember the immense joy I felt the first time I saw my orchid bloom; it's hard to describe even now, and it made me realize how satisfying this hobby is amidst daily stress. I maintain a strict watering schedule, especially for the more delicate varieties, and I also figure out the nutrients they need. Sometimes, even during important work meetings or when facing heavy projects, my thoughts unconsciously drift to my fig tree or pothos, looking forward to getting home quickly to check on them. They are a constant reminder of life and growth, and they also fill my home with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, I've long been known as "the plant lady," and I'm incredibly proud of it.
text_tgt_raw: 照顧家裡的室內植物，對我來說已經成為一種獨特的個人療癒，讓我在外界步調再怎麼急促，也能找到內心的平靜。每天早上準備咖啡時，我總會花上幾分鐘靜靜地觀察它們，看著閣樓上的陽光，如何穿透雲層，溫柔地照耀著葉片。還記得第一次看到我的蘭花綻放，那份巨大的喜悅至今難以言喻，也讓我意識到在日常壓力裡，這項嗜好是多麼令人滿足。我維持著嚴格的澆水計畫，尤其是那些較為嬌貴的品種，同時也摸索著它們所需的養分。有時候，即使在重要的工作會議中，或是面對著繁重的專案，我的思緒卻會不自覺地飄到我的榕樹或黃金葛那裡，期待著趕快回家看看它們的狀況。它們是生命與成長的持續提醒，也讓我的家裡充滿了更清新、純淨的空氣。在朋友之間，我早已被稱為「植物女士」，而我為此感到無比驕傲。
base_en: Caring for my indoor plants has become a personal therapy, a way to find calm while the outside world continues its frantic pace. Every morning, while I prepare coffee, I dedicate a few minutes to observing them, seeing how the attic sun—between the clouds—illuminates their leaves. I remember the 1st time one of my orchids bloomed; it was an immense joy, comparable to few things, and it made me realize how rewarding this hobby is, among the daily stress. I maintain a strict watering schedule, especially for the most delicate ones, while I try to figure out what nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I find myself thinking about my ficuses or my pothos, wanting to get home to see how they're. It's a constant reminder of life and growth, while my home fills with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, they already know me as the "plant lady," and I couldn't be prouder of it.

text_es: When beginners plant indoors, the first priority is to choose suitable plant species based on the natural light conditions in their home. There are many plants available on the market; it is recommended to start with those that are hardy and do not require excessive care, so you can enjoy the fun of planting while learning the basics. To ensure healthy plant growth, be sure to use a suitable potting mix for each type of plant and pay attention to watering appropriately, avoiding overwatering which can lead to root rot; between each watering, you can observe the soil's moisture level. When fertilizing, follow product instructions and apply moderately to avoid burning delicate roots. Place plants in a location where they can receive ample light, but avoid direct sunlight during the hottest part of the day. At the same time, consider the specific needs of each plant and maintain appropriate environmental humidity. Regularly check plants for pests and diseases, and take prompt action to control them if found.
text_tgt_raw: 初學者在室內種植植物時，首要之務是依據家裡自然光線條件，挑選適合的種類。市面上有著許多植物可供選擇，建議從那些生命力強韌、不需過多照料的軟體開始著手，這樣您就能在學習基礎知識的同時，享受種植樂趣。為確保植物健康生長，請務必使用適合各類植物的介質，並注意適量澆水，避免過度灌溉導致根部腐爛；在每次澆水之間，可觀察土壤的濕潤度。施肥時應遵循產品說明，適度給予，以免燒傷纖弱的根系。將植物放置在能獲得充足光照的地方，但要避免在一天中最熱時段受到陽光直射。同時，考量每種植物的特定需求，維持適宜的環境濕度。定時檢查植物是否有病蟲害，並在發現時迅速採取行動加以防治。
base_en: When starting out with indoor plant care, it's essential to choose suitable species for your home, while considering the natural light available. Look for resilient plants, among the many existing varieties, that don't require excessive attention, while you learn the basics. Make sure the substrate is correct for each type of plant and that you water them properly, avoiding excess water that can rot the roots; observe the soil between waterings. Fertilize in moderation, while following product instructions, so as not to burn delicate roots. Place plants in locations where they receive sufficient light, but avoid direct sun exposure during the hottest hours of the day. Maintain adequate ambient humidity, while considering the specific needs of each plant. Regularly inspect your plants for pests or diseases, while acting quickly to control them.

text_es: Choosing a mattress that is right for you is crucial for ensuring quality sleep and good spinal health; conversely, a poor choice can lead to back problems. When selecting, it's essential to consider the firmness, as it must match your individual weight and sleeping position; when trying out a mattress, it's recommended to lie on it for at least ten minutes to truly feel its support. Common materials on the market include latex, memory foam, and pocketed coils, each with its unique conformity and breathability. Furthermore, mattress size is a major consideration, especially when two people share it, as you must ensure there is enough space for both to avoid disturbing each other during the night. Faced with numerous options, do not rush to make a decision; comparing different models online and referring to other users' reviews will be very helpful. It is advisable to visit a professional mattress store, where sales associates can offer customized advice and help you evaluate various lying sensations. Finally, budget is also a factor to consider; nevertheless, investing in a good mattress is the best long-term investment in your health.
text_tgt_raw: 選擇一張適合自己的床墊，對於確保優質睡眠和良好的脊椎健康至關重要，反之則可能導致背部問題。挑選時，務必考量軟硬度，因為它必須符合個人的體重和睡姿；在試躺床墊時，建議至少躺上十分鐘，才能真正感受它的支撐性。市面上常見的材質包括乳膠、記憶棉和獨立筒彈簧等，每種都有其獨特的服貼度與透氣性。此外，床墊的尺寸也是一大考量，特別是兩人共用時，必須確保彼此有足夠的空間，才不會在夜裡互相干擾。面對眾多選擇，請不要急著做決定；透過網路比較不同款式，並參考其他使用者的評價，會非常有幫助。建議到專業的床墊店鋪，那裡的銷售人員能提供客製化建議，協助您評估各種躺臥感受。最後，預算也是一個需要考量的因素，儘管如此，投資一張好的床墊，長遠來看是對健康的最佳投資。
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is crucial for ensuring restful sleep and good postural health, while a poor choice can lead to back problems. It's essential to consider the type of firmness, as it must adapt to each person's weight and sleeping position; while trying out a mattress, it's important to lie on it for at least 10 minutes. Among the most common materials are latex, memory foam, and springs, each with its own characteristics of adaptability and breathability. Furthermore, it's essential to think about the size of the mattress, especially if it's shared, to ensure enough space for both, while avoiding interruptions during the night. Don't rush amid so many options; comparing models and reading reviews from other users can be very helpful. It's advisable to go to specialized stores where staff can offer personalized advice, while evaluating the different sensations. Finally, budget is another factor to consider, although investing in a good mattress is a long-term investment in health.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress for our double bed was truly a nearly two-week journey. My partner and I both wanted to find one we both liked, striving for the perfect balance between firmness and adaptability. I remember that in the showroom, we tried lying on at least fifteen different models, while the salesperson showed amazing patience. We lay down, rolled over, and debated the pros and cons of each mattress with laughter and jokes. Finally, after much deliberation and as fatigue began to set in, we decided on a memory foam mattress, which promised a good night's sleep. Now, every night as we sink into its soft surface, we always recall that fun search process; it was truly an unforgettable experience.
text_tgt_raw: 為雙人床挑選一張合適的床墊，真是一場長達近兩週的旅程。我和伴侶都想找到一張彼此都喜歡的，努力在軟硬度與適應性之間取得完美的平衡。我記得，那時在展售間裡，我們至少試躺了十五種不同款式，而銷售人員則在一旁展現著驚人的耐心。我們躺下、翻身，有說有笑地爭辯著每張床墊的優缺點。最終，在一番深思熟慮且疲憊感逐漸襲來時，我們決定選擇了一張記憶床墊，它承諾能帶來一夜好眠。如今，每晚當我們沉入那柔軟的表面時，總會憶起那段充滿趣味的尋覓過程，真是段難忘的經歷。
base_en: Choosing a mattress for the double bed was an odyssey that lasted almost 2 weeks. My partner and I wanted something that we both liked, while we searched for the perfect balance between firmness and adaptability. I remember that, in the middle of the showroom, we tried at least 15 different models, while the saleswoman watched us with admirable patience. We lay down, we moved around, and we debated with laughter and arguments about the benefits of each one. Finally, after much deliberation and while fatigue was starting to take its toll, we decided on a memory foam one that promised a restful sleep. Now, every night, while we sink into its soft surface, we fondly remember that fun search, among all the possible options.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, to ensure good sleep quality and avoid future back pain, we truly need to consider multiple factors. There are many types on the market, from spring mattresses, latex mattresses, to memory foam mattresses; when trying them out, be sure to note if they conform to your sleeping posture. When purchasing, you shouldn't just look at the price, but also focus on the quality of the materials, and refer to reviews from other users, which is very important. Since a mattress is a long-term investment, don't rush to make a decision; there are many options, and taking the time to research and compare is worthwhile. Among the many options, be sure to ensure the mattress provides adequate support for your spine, having both appropriate firmness and comfort. Many stores offer a trial period; make good use of this time to allow your body to adapt to the new mattress, so you won't regret it.
text_tgt_raw: 在挑選床墊時，為確保良好的睡眠品質並避免未來腰背疼痛，我們著實需要考量多重因素。市面上有許多種類，從彈簧床、乳膠床到記憶棉床墊，試躺時務必注意它是否能貼合您的睡姿。購買時，不能只看價格，更要著重於材質的品質，並且參考其他使用者的評論，這點非常重要。由於床墊是一項長期投資，千萬別急著做決定，這裡有許多選擇，花時間研究比較是值得的。在眾多選項裡，務必確保床墊能為您的脊椎提供足夠的支撐，既要有適當的硬度，也要兼顧舒適性。許多店家都提供試睡期，好好利用這段時間讓身體適應新的床墊，才不會後悔。
base_en: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider several factors to ensure good rest, while avoiding back problems in the future. Try different types, among those with springs, latex, and memory foam, while making sure it adapts to your sleeping posture. It's crucial not only to look at the price, but also at the quality of the materials, while seeking opinions from other users. Don't rush the decision, as it's a long-term investment; among the many options available, take time to research and compare. Make sure that, amid so much on offer, the mattress provides adequate support for your spine and is firm enough, while also being comfortable. Many stores offer a trial period; take advantage of it, while you get used to the new mattress.

text_es: Reducing food waste is a crucial step towards sustainable development, especially as we face resource scarcity and global food security issues. Annually, an estimated one-third of food is discarded or wasted during production, distribution, and final consumption, while millions of people worldwide suffer from hunger, which seems particularly ironic in an age of abundance. Through simple habits such as meal planning, proper food preservation, and making good use of leftover ingredients, we can do our part for the planet. Therefore, educating the public and businesses about these practices is essential for promoting lasting change. Furthermore, government policies and technological innovations also play indispensable roles; for example, developing software that tracks food movement or establishing food-sharing network platforms can seek more efficient solutions within the supply chain, and these efforts must continue even in the face of economic challenges.
text_tgt_raw: 減少食物浪費是邁向永續發展的關鍵一步，特別是當我們面對資源短缺與全球糧食安全問題時。每年，估計有三分之一的食物在生產、配送及最終消費的過程裡遭到丟棄或浪費，與此同時，全球卻有數百萬人正忍受著飢餓之苦，這在豐饒的年代裡顯得格外諷刺。透過餐點規劃、妥善保存食物以及善用剩餘食材等簡單的習慣，我們就能為地球盡一份心力。因此，教育民眾與商家有關這些實踐方式，對於促進持久的改變至關重要。此外，政府政策與科技創新也扮演著不可或缺的角色，例如開發能追蹤食物動向的軟體，或建立食物分享的網路平台，都能在供應鏈中尋求更有效率的解決方案，即便面對經濟挑戰，這些努力也必須持續著。
base_en: Reducing food waste is a crucial action for sustainability, while we address resource scarcity and global food security. Each year, it's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced is lost or wasted, among production, distribution, and final consumption. This occurs while millions of people suffer from hunger, a striking paradox amid abundance. Implementing practices such as meal planning, proper storage, and using leftovers can make a big difference, while we contribute to a healthier planet. It's vital to educate the population about these practices, among households and businesses, to foster lasting change. Furthermore, government policies and technological innovation play a fundamental role in reducing large-scale waste, while we seek more efficient solutions throughout the supply chain, even amid economic challenges.

text_es: I've always been particularly concerned about food waste; my family even calls it a "shame." About two years ago, when I was living alone, I truly realized that the fruit in my refrigerator often quietly spoiled amidst my daily busyness. Every time I threw away those originally fresh, usable ingredients, I felt very frustrated. To solve this problem, I started planning three days' worth of meals, only buying the exact amount I needed, and preparing ingredients in advance on weekends to freeze in portions. As a result, along with leftovers and portions donated to local animal shelters, I found that food waste improved by nearly 40% in just one month. Now, even when cooking for more people, I remain careful, ensuring no food is wasted, always paying attention to expiration dates and ingredient quantities, even in a busy household.
text_tgt_raw: 對於食物浪費，我向來都特別在意，家裡人甚至將其稱之為「羞恥」。大約兩年前，我一個人生活著，才真正意識到冰箱裡的水果，常常在我的日常忙碌中悄悄腐壞。每次丟棄那些原本新鮮、可以利用的食材，都讓我覺得非常沮喪。為了解決這個問題，我開始規劃三天份的餐點，只購買真正需要的份量，並且在週末預先準備好食材分批冷凍。如此一來，加上那些吃剩的飯菜和捐贈給當地動物收容所的份量，短短一個月裡，我發現食物浪費的情況改善了將近四成。現在，即使為更多人下廚，我依然小心翼翼，確保沒有任何食物被浪費掉，始終留意著有效期限和食材數量，即使在忙亂的家庭生活中也一樣。
base_en: I've always been very aware of food waste; among my family, we've called it "the shame." About 2 years ago, while living alone, I realized how much fruit was spoiling in my fridge, amid my daily absentmindedness. It was frustrating to throw away food that, while fresh, I could have used. I started planning meals for 3 days and buying only what was necessary, while on the weekend I prepared portions to freeze. Between the leftovers and what I donated to a local animal shelter, I saw a 40% improvement in just 1 month. Now, while cooking for more people, I make sure nothing goes to waste, always attentive to expiration dates and quantities, amid the family whirlwind.

text_es: For many adults, learning to swim is an achievable goal, and a lack of past experience is not an obstacle. Many people decide to learn in order to improve their physical condition, or to feel safer when participating in water activities with family, and of course, some also want to overcome long-standing fears. There are many swimming courses specifically designed for adults on the market, and these courses provide a supportive environment and a step-by-step learning approach, allowing students to grow together with like-minded companions. Finding a qualified instructor who understands the characteristics of adult teaching is crucial, and consistent practice is key to building confidence. The benefits of learning to swim include strengthening muscles, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing personal safety, while also rekindling a love for water during the learning process.
text_tgt_raw: 對於許多成年人來說，學習游泳是個可以達成的目標，即使過去沒有經驗也不是阻礙。許多人是為著改善身體狀況，或想與家人一同進行水上活動時更有安全感而決定學習，當然，也有人是為克服長久以來的恐懼。市面上有眾多專為成年人設計的游泳課程，這些課程提供了一個支持性的環境與循序漸進的學習方式，讓學員們能在志同道合的同伴裡共同成長。找到一位了解成人教學特點的合格教練至關重要，而持續的練習則是建立信心的關鍵。學習游泳的好處涵蓋了增強肌肉、改善心血管健康以及提升個人安全，同時，在學習的過程裡，也能重拾對水的熱愛。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is an achievable goal for many people, while a lack of prior experience isn't an impediment. Many adults decide to learn to swim to improve their physical condition, among other health benefits, or to feel safer in aquatic activities with their families, while others seek to overcome an old fear. There are numerous courses designed specifically for adults, which offer a supportive environment and progressive learning, among peers who share similar goals. It's essential to find a qualified instructor who understands the particularities of teaching adults, while consistent practice is key to acquiring confidence. Among the benefits of learning to swim are muscle strengthening, cardiovascular improvement, and greater personal safety, while amid the process a renewed love for water can develop.

text_es: When I was thirty, I made up my mind to learn how to swim. Growing up, watching my friends play in the water, I always felt left out. Every summer, when everyone was barbecuing outdoors or gathering by the water, I always felt like I was missing something, unable to fully enjoy that sense of ease. So I signed up for swimming lessons, and although I was a bit embarrassed because everyone around me was a small child, I still bit the bullet and went to overcome my fear. The first few lessons were indeed challenging; my limbs always seemed to disobey me, and the water felt like an unfriendly element. However, with the coach's patient guidance, I gradually felt more at ease. Now, I can swim effortlessly in the water, enjoying the sense of freedom I used to only see in others. This was undoubtedly one of the best decisions of my life, and I am now preparing for my next beach vacation.
text_tgt_raw: 在我三十歲那年，我下定決心要學游泳。從小到大，看著朋友們在水裡嬉戲，我總是望塵莫及。每到夏天，當大家在戶外烤肉或在水邊聚會時，我總覺得自己少了點什麼，無法盡情享受那份自在。於是我報名了游泳課，雖然周圍都是小小孩，讓我有些不好意思，但為了克服心中的恐懼，我還是硬著頭皮去了。起初幾堂課確實充滿挑戰，我的手腳總是不聽使喚，感覺水就像個不友善的元素。然而，在教練耐心的指導下，我逐漸感到更為自在。現在，我已能輕鬆地在水裡悠游，享受著那份過往只能從別人身上看見的自由感。這無疑是我人生中最好的決定之一，而我正為著下一次的海灘假期做準備呢。
base_en: When I was 30 years old, I decided it was time to learn to swim, a skill that eluded me while my friends splashed in the pool. I had always felt a bit limited in the summer, among the barbecues and gatherings by the water, while others enjoyed themselves without a care. I signed up for some classes, a little embarrassed among small children, but willing to overcome my fear. The 1st sessions were a challenge, while I tried to coordinate my arms and legs, feeling the water as a hostile element. Little by little, and while the instructor's patience didn't waver, I began to feel more comfortable. Now I can swim with a certain ease, enjoying the feeling of freedom that I previously only observed among others. It has been one of the best decisions of my life, while I prepare for my next beach vacation.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a very meaningful goal, and as you embark on this journey, patience will be your best companion. Be sure to find a good coach who understands your fears and can guide you step-by-step, allowing you to slowly get comfortable in the water. It's crucial to start learning in the shallow end, and if you can do so with other beginners, you'll feel even more at ease and comfortable. Repeatedly practice breathing and floating to gradually adapt your body to this new environment. Don't be discouraged if progress is slow at first; many adults experience some unease in unfamiliar environments. As long as you persevere and receive support, you'll find that by following your coach's instructions, your confidence will gradually grow, your skills will improve, and eventually you'll be able to freely enjoy the fun of being in the water.
text_tgt_raw: 成年後學習游泳是一項很有意義的目標，而當您踏上這段旅程時，耐心將是您最好的夥伴。請務必尋找一位能理解您恐懼並一步步引導您的好教練，讓您能慢慢熟悉水性。在淺水區開始學習至關重要，若能與其他初學者一起，更能讓您感到自在與安心。重複練習呼吸與漂浮，讓身體逐漸適應這個全新的環境。如果一開始進步緩慢也別氣餒，許多成年人在不熟悉的環境裡，都會經歷一些不安。只要堅持不懈並獲得支持，您會發現，跟著教練的指示做著做著，自信心會逐漸增長，技巧也會有所提升，最終讓您能自在地享受水中的樂趣。
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding goal, and while you embark on this journey, patience is your best ally. Look for a good instructor who understands your fears and guides you step by step, while you familiarize yourself with the water. It's crucial to start in a shallow pool, among other beginners if possible, to feel more comfortable and secure. Practice breathing and floating repeatedly, while your body adapts to a new environment. Don't get frustrated if progress is slow at 1st; many adults experience some apprehension amid an unfamiliar environment. With persistence and support, you'll see how, while you follow the instructions, confidence grows and technique improves, allowing you to fully enjoy the water.

text_es: Painting a room, a home improvement task, seems simple but actually requires careful planning and execution to achieve professional-level results. First, we should properly protect furniture and floors, for example, by covering them with plastic sheets or tarps, and clear the construction area. To ensure better paint adhesion, cleaning the walls is an indispensable step, and any cracks or imperfections on the walls should first be repaired with spackle. The choice of paint type, whether latex, enamel, or other, and the color scheme, all play a crucial role, as they will directly affect the overall atmosphere, spaciousness, and lighting of the entire space. When applying primer to ensure a uniform base, be sure to maintain good indoor ventilation. Paint is usually applied in two to three thin coats, with a four to six hour drying interval between each coat, and it is essential to follow the manufacturer's instructions. Finally, while enjoying the sense of accomplishment after completion, carefully remove all protective measures to avoid any unnecessary mess.
text_tgt_raw: 油漆粉刷房間這項居家修繕工作，看似簡單，實則需要仔細規劃與執行，才能達到專業級的水準。首先，我們應當將家具和地板妥善保護起來，例如用塑膠布或帆布覆蓋，同時清空施工區域。為了讓油漆能更好地附著，清潔牆面是不可或缺的步驟，牆上的裂縫或瑕疵也應先用批土修補。油漆種類的選擇，無論是塑膠漆、合成漆或其他，以及顏色的搭配，都扮演著關鍵角色，因為它們將直接影響整個空間的氛圍、寬敞感和採光。在塗刷底漆以確保基底均勻時，請務必保持室內通風良好。油漆通常分兩到三層薄塗，每一層之間需間隔四到六小時待其乾燥，並務必遵循製造商的指示。最後，在享受完成後的成就感之餘，小心地移除所有保護措施，以避免產生任何不必要的髒污。
base_en: Painting a room is a home improvement task that, while it seems simple, requires preparation and attention to detail to achieve a professional finish. 1st, furniture, and floors must be protected, using plastic sheets or tarps, while the work area is cleared. It's essential to clean the walls so that the paint adheres well, while cracks or imperfections are repaired with putty. The choice of paint type—plastic, synthetic, etc.—and color is crucial, as it will influence the overall ambiance, among the feeling of spaciousness and lighting. While applying primer to ensure a uniform base, it's important to ventilate the room well. The paint is applied in 2 or 3 thin coats, allowing each to dry for 4 to 6 hours, while observing the manufacturer's instructions. Finally, amid the satisfaction with the result, protections are carefully removed to avoid stains.

text_es: This weekend, I decided to paint my bedroom, a task I had been putting off for three months. I bought ten liters of soft gray paint, and my sister helped me move the furniture to the center of the room. The process took longer than I expected, filled with laughter and occasional paint splatters, with my favorite songs playing in the background. Amidst the chaos of drop cloths and brushes, I realized how therapeutic it was to focus on one thing, and time just flew by. Between the first and second coats of paint, we took the opportunity to have a coffee and comment on how beautiful the walls looked. Now, the walls are dry, and ninety percent of the furniture is back in place, and I look at the result with a great sense of satisfaction.
text_tgt_raw: 這個週末，我決定粉刷我的臥室，這項工作我已經拖延了三個月。我買了十公升柔和的灰色油漆，而我妹妹則幫我把家具移到房間的中央。這過程比我預期的還要長，充滿了歡聲笑語和偶爾的油漆飛濺，背景音樂裡播放著我最喜歡的歌曲。在油布和刷子的混亂中，我意識到專注於一件事是多麼具有療癒性，時間就在不知不覺中流逝了。在第一層和第二層油漆之間，我們趁機喝了杯咖啡，同時評論著牆壁看起來有多麼漂亮。現在，牆壁已經乾了，百分之九十的家具也歸位了，我望著這成果，心裡充滿了極大的滿足感。
base_en: This weekend I decided to paint my bedroom, a task I'd been putting off for 3 months. I bought 10 liters of paint in a soft gray tone, while my sister helped me move the furniture to the center of the room. It was a longer process than I expected, with laughter and the occasional splash, while the radio played my favorite music in the background. Amid all the chaos of tarps and brushes, I realized how therapeutic it can be to concentrate on just one thing, while time passed without me noticing. Between the 1st and 2nd coats, we took the opportunity to have coffee, while commenting on how good the wall was looking. Now, with the walls dry and 90% of the furniture in place, I feel great satisfaction, while looking at the result.

text_es: Beginning to learn meditation is about cultivating focus and inner peace, a practice that is increasingly popular among modern people seeking stress reduction. This is a gradual process where meditators learn to observe their thoughts without judgment, allowing their minds to slowly become calmer. The key is consistency; even in a busy life, set aside five to ten minutes each day to sit quietly and focus on your breath. When meditation becomes a habit, people can experience more benefits, such as clearer thoughts and better emotional management. Among the many meditation methods, from mindfulness meditation to Transcendental Meditation, or guided visualization, you can choose the software or method that suits you best. No matter where you are, at home, at work, or on a bus or in a taxi, as long as you are willing, you can practice anywhere. Investing time in meditation in daily life can transform one's view of the world and the way one deals with challenges.
text_tgt_raw: 開始學習冥想，是在培養專注力與內心的平靜，這項練習在尋求減輕壓力的現代人裡頭日漸普及。這是一個循序漸進的過程，冥想者學習著不帶批判地觀察自己的思緒，讓心靈逐漸變得更為寧靜。關鍵在於持之以恆，即使在繁忙的生活裡，每天撥出五到十分鐘靜坐，專注於呼吸。當冥想成為一種習慣，人們便能體驗到更多的好處，例如更清晰的思緒及更好的情緒管理。在眾多冥想方式中，從正念冥想到超覺靜坐，或者引導式觀想，可以選擇最適合自己的軟體或方法。無論你身處何處，家裡、公司或公車、計程車上，只要有心，這裡那裡都能練習。在日常生活中投入時間冥想，便能轉化一個人對世界的看法以及應對挑戰的方式。
base_en: Starting to meditate involves cultivating mindfulness and mental calm, a practice increasingly popular among people looking to reduce stress. It's a gradual process, while the practitioner learns to observe their thoughts without judging them, and while their mind becomes more serene. The key is consistency, dedicating a few minutes a day, even 5 or 10 minutes, to sit in silence and focus on breathing, amid the busy life. While meditation becomes a habit, benefits such as greater mental clarity and better emotional management can be experienced. Among the various methods, one can choose between mindfulness meditation, transcendental meditation, or guided visualization, while looking for the one that best suits their needs. Amid the daily routine, dedicating time to meditation can transform one's perception of the world and response to challenges.

text_es: Recalling my journey of learning meditation, it was truly full of ups and downs; I initially thought it would be an instant fix, but it turned out to be slow progress. When I first started, I tried to calm my thoughts, but all sorts of ideas kept swirling in my head like data and videos online, which made me very frustrated. I signed up for a beginner's meditation class, and the first week was a disaster; there was street noise here, and my own worries there, making it impossible to concentrate. The teacher told us that this was a necessary stage for the body and mind to adapt, and it was normal to feel this way at first. As time went on, I continued to practice daily and slowly discovered a difference, finding a small oasis of tranquility amidst the busyness of life. Now, I meditate almost every day, and it has brought invaluable peace to my life, a feeling that is priceless.
text_tgt_raw: 回想起我開始學習冥想的過程，真是充滿了起伏，原以為會立竿見影，結果卻是緩慢前行。剛開始時，我嘗試著讓思緒平靜下來，但腦袋裡各種念頭卻像網路上的資料和影片一樣不停地打轉，讓我覺得非常沮喪。我報名了初學者冥想課程，第一週簡直是場災難；這裡有街道的噪音，那裡又有我自己的煩惱，完全無法集中精神。老師告訴我們，這為身體和心靈適應的必經階段，初期有這種感覺很正常。隨著時間過去，我持續每天練習著，慢慢地發現了不同，在生活的忙碌中，找到了些許寧靜的綠洲。現在，我幾乎每天都會冥想，它為我的生活帶來了寶貴的平靜，這感受是無價的。
base_en: I remember that starting to meditate was a slow process full of ups and downs, while I thought it would be instantaneous. At 1st, it was frustrating trying to silence my mind, while thoughts swirled endlessly. I signed up for 1 beginner meditation course, and the 1st week was a disaster; between the street noise and my own worries, I felt unable to concentrate. The instructor told us it was normal to feel that way at 1st, while the body and mind adapt. Over time, while I practiced daily, I started to notice a difference, finding small oases of calm amid the maelstrom. Now, I meditate almost every day, and the peace it brings me amid my busy life is invaluable.

text_es: When you first start meditating, cultivating patience is crucial; don't rush to expect immediate results, and allow yourself to slowly adapt to the practice. Find a quiet place where you won't be disturbed, whether it's at home, in a park, or any corner where you feel comfortable, and let your mind gradually get used to the tranquility there. You can start with short sessions of five to ten minutes each, and as your confidence and focus grow, gradually extend the practice time. Concentrate your attention on your breath, observing how air enters and leaves your body; even if your thoughts wander, don't get frustrated, as these are normal occurrences. When you get distracted, simply gently redirect your attention back to your breath. Consistency is key; with regular practice, you can build this beneficial new habit, transforming meditation into an oasis for your mind even in the busy online world or while commuting on a bus or in a taxi. You will find that this is a set of software that can effectively help you process large amounts of data and video information, bringing peace to your life.
text_tgt_raw: 初次接觸冥想時，培養耐心至關重要，別急著期待立竿見影的效果，讓自己慢慢適應這項練習。找個能不受打擾的安靜地方，不論是在家裡、公園裡，還是任何你覺得舒服的角落，讓心靈逐漸習慣那裡的寧靜。可以從每次五到十分鐘的短時間開始，隨著自信與專注力增長，再慢慢拉長練習時間。將注意力集中在呼吸上，觀察空氣如何進出身體，即使思緒紛飛，也不要為此感到挫折，這些都是正常的。當分心時，只需溫柔地將注意力重新導回呼吸。持之以恆是關鍵，只要規律練習，就能建立起這個有益的新習慣，即使身處忙碌的網路世界，或是搭乘公車、計程車通勤時，也能將冥想轉化為一片心靈的綠洲。你會發現，這是一套能有效幫助你處理大量資料與影片資訊的軟體，為生活帶來平靜。
base_en: When you start meditating, it's essential to cultivate patience and not expect immediate results, while you get used to the practice. Look for a quiet place where you can be without interruptions, among the moments of your daily life, while your mind adapts to the silence. Start with short sessions, 5, or 10 minutes, gradually increasing the time, while you gain confidence and concentration. Focus on your breathing, observing how the air enters and exits, even amid thoughts that may arise. Don't judge yourself for distractions, they're normal; simply, return your attention to your breath while they occur. The key is consistency, practicing regularly while you build this new beneficial habit, even amid the daily hustle and bustle, you'll see that meditation becomes an oasis of calm.

text_es: To prepare for a job interview, the first priority is to thoroughly research the company and the position applied for, while carefully analyzing the job description to identify core skills. Doing so allows applicants to closely align their answers with the company's needs and anticipate potential questions. It is also recommended to practice answering common questions, including those about work experience and career goals, to ensure clear and concise communication. Furthermore, preparing some questions to ask the interviewer can demonstrate a proactive attitude in a competitive environment. In addition to dressing appropriately, it is also necessary to plan transportation for the day, such as taking a bus or taxi, to avoid any mishaps. Finally, reviewing your resume and cover letter and highlighting your strengths is crucial for leaving a good impression.
text_tgt_raw: 為應對求職面試，首要之務是徹底研究該公司及所應徵的職位，同時仔細分析職務說明，找出核心技能。這麼做能讓應徵者將回答與公司的需求緊密結合，並預先設想可能被問到的問題。這裡也建議練習回答常見問題，其中包含關於工作經驗及職涯目標的提問，確保表達清晰簡潔。此外，準備一些自己的問題詢問面試官，能在競爭激烈的環境裡展現積極主動的態度。除了注意穿著得體，也需規劃好當天的交通，例如搭乘公車或計程車，以避免任何差池。最後，重新審視履歷和求職信，並強調自身優勢，對於留下良好印象至關重要。
base_en: To prepare for a job interview, 1st it's essential to thoroughly research the company and the position being applied for, while analyzing the job description to identify key skills. This allows the candidate to align their answers with the organization's needs, while anticipating possible questions. It's also crucial to practice answers to common questions, among which are those about work experience and professional goals, ensuring that the explanation is clear and concise. Furthermore, preparing some of your own questions for the interviewer demonstrates interest and proactivity amid a competitive process. While taking care of appropriate attire, you also have to plan the logistics of the day to avoid setbacks. Finally, reviewing your resume and cover letter while reinforcing your strengths is essential to make a good impression.

text_es: For me, preparing for a job interview is always both nerve-wracking and exciting, and I carefully consider all possible scenarios. I remember last time, for an interview, I spent three whole days fully immersed in researching that company's values and latest projects. This was a challenge for me, but I firmly believed that only by doing so could I stand out among the many applicants, and I also repeatedly rehearsed the questions I might be asked in my mind. Amidst the vast amount of information online, I continuously searched for data, while also reviewing my resume and cover letter to ensure every detail was flawless. I would also practice answering questions out loud, with my cat watching me curiously from the side, all so I could calmly handle unexpected questions. I still believe that under pressure, balancing theory and practice is key to seizing important opportunities in life.
text_tgt_raw: 對我而言，每次準備工作面試總是既緊張又興奮，我會仔細思考各種可能的情境。記得上次為了面試，我花了整整三天時間，全心投入研究那家公司的價值觀和最新專案。這對我來說是一個挑戰，但我深信唯有如此，才能在那眾多應徵者裡脫穎而出，我在心裡也反覆演練著可能會被問到的問題。在浩瀚的網路資訊中，我不斷地搜尋著資料，同時也審閱著我的履歷和求職信，確保每個細節都完美無瑕。我也會大聲地練習回答，而我的貓則在一旁好奇地看著我，為的就是能從容應對那些意想不到的問題。我至今仍認為，在壓力之下，理論與實踐並重是抓住人生重要機會的關鍵。
base_en: Preparing for a job interview always generates a mix of nerves and excitement for me, while I review the possible scenarios. I remember the last time, I spent 3 days immersed in researching the company, among its values and its most recent projects. It was a challenge, but I felt it was crucial to stand out among the other candidates, while I imagined the questions. Amid all the information, I looked for my resume and cover letter, making sure every detail was impeccable. I practiced my answers out loud, while my cat looked at me curiously, and I prepared to answer unexpected questions. I still think it's essential to be prepared, between theory and practice, amid the pressure, for the opportunity of my life.

text_es: To prepare for a job interview, be sure to thoroughly research the company and familiarize yourself with its corporate culture and products. You should anticipate potential questions and prepare concise answers, including examples from your past experiences. Practice saying your answers aloud, and don't forget to pay attention to your body language, as non-verbal communication is just as important as what you say. Additionally, prepare two to three insightful questions to ask the interviewer; this will demonstrate your genuine interest in the position. Ensure your resume is up-to-date and clearly structured, and confirm your attire in advance to meet the job requirements. Finally, plan your route to the interview location beforehand, allow ample time to avoid being late, and maintain composure and confidence.
text_tgt_raw: 為了準備工作面試，務必徹底研究該公司，並熟悉其企業文化與產品。您應該預想可能被問到的問題，並為此準備簡潔的回答，其中包含您過去的經驗為例。練習大聲說出您的回答，同時也別忘了留意肢體語言，因為非口語溝通的重要性不亞於您說出的內容。另外，準備兩到三個有深度的問題詢問面試官，這會展現您對於這份職位的真正興趣。請確保您的履歷資料是最新的並且架構清楚，提前確認服裝儀容以符合職位要求。最後，預先規劃前往面試地點的路線，預留充裕時間，避免遲到，保持沉著與自信。
base_en: To prepare for a job interview, research the company thoroughly while familiarizing yourself with its culture and products. It's crucial to anticipate possible questions and formulate concise answers, among which you should include examples from your experience. Practice your answers out loud while paying attention to your body language, as non-verbal communication is just as important as what you say. Prepare 2 or 3 intelligent questions for the interviewer, which demonstrates your genuine interest in the position among all the people who apply. Make sure you've an updated and well-structured resume, while checking your attire in advance so that it's appropriate for the position. Finally, plan your route to the interview location with enough time, to avoid arriving late, while remaining calm and confident.

text_es: Last year, while camping with friends, I deeply realized the importance of safely building a campfire. At that time, I was looking for an open area, far from trees and bushes, while two of my friends were preparing food nearby. After finding the ideal spot, we used large rocks to create a perimeter, and another friend went to gather dry firewood. We placed the firewood in the center of the rock circle, ensuring there were no dry leaves around, and I carefully observed the wind direction. We were extra careful when lighting the campfire, while the others chatted and laughed easily, and we always kept a bucket of water nearby, just in case. There, we enjoyed the night; it was a great experience, and I realized how indispensable safety is in nature.
text_tgt_raw: 去年與朋友們露營時，我深深體會到安全搭建營火的重要性。當時我尋找著一處空曠的、遠離樹木和灌木叢的地方，而我的兩位朋友則在一旁準備著食物。找到理想地點後，我們用大石頭圍出一個範圍，另一個朋友則去撿拾乾燥的木柴。我們將木柴放在石堆中央，確保周圍沒有任何枯葉，而我則仔細觀察著風向。點燃營火時我們格外小心，其他人則輕鬆地聊著天、笑著，我們也始終在附近備著一桶水，以防萬一。在那裡，我們享受著夜晚，這是一次很棒的經驗，我意識到在大自然裡，安全是多麼地不可或缺。
base_en: Last year, during a camping trip with friends, I learned the importance of building a safe campfire. 1st of all, I looked for a clear spot, far from trees and bushes, while 2 friends prepared the food. Once the ideal spot was located, we marked off the area with large stones, while 1 of them went for dry firewood. We put the wood in the middle of the stones, making sure there were no dry leaves around, while I watched the wind. We lit the fire with extreme care, while the others chatted and laughed, and we always kept a bucket of water nearby just in case, while we enjoyed the night. It was a wonderful experience, and I realized how crucial safety is in the middle of nature.

text_es: To safely burn a campfire, first, choose an open area away from trees and buildings, and make sure there is no strong wind at the time. Establish a safety perimeter of at least three meters around the campfire, clear away all flammable vegetation, and have a fire extinguisher or a bucket full of water readily available during preparation. Stack the wood so that air can circulate freely, especially among dry branches, which will make ignition easier and more controllable. Never leave a campfire unattended while it is burning. Before leaving, be sure to extinguish the campfire completely, stir the ashes, and continue to pour water until there are no embers left. Remember, prevention is key in any fire-related activity; the risk of fire always exists if necessary precautions are not taken.
text_tgt_raw: 為了安全地燃燒營火，首先，請選擇一處空曠且遠離樹木及建築物的地點，並確保當時沒有強勁的風。在營火周圍設立一個至少三公尺的安全範圍，清除掉所有易燃植被，並在準備的過程裡，手邊隨時備妥滅火器或裝滿水的水桶。將木材堆疊好，讓空氣能夠順暢流通其中，特別是乾燥的樹枝間，這樣能更容易且更可控地引燃。營火燃燒著的時候，切勿讓它無人看管。離開前，請務必將營火徹底熄滅，攪拌灰燼並不斷澆水，直到沒有任何餘燼為止。請記住，在任何與火相關的活動裡，預防措施為關鍵，若未採取必要的預防措施，火災的風險總是存在著。
base_en: To light a safe bonfire, 1st, choose a clear spot, away from trees and structures, while there's no strong wind. Make sure you've a safety perimeter of at least 3 meters without flammable vegetation and, while preparing it, have a fire extinguisher or buckets of water on hand. Stack the firewood so that air circulates well, among the dry branches, for easy and controlled ignition. Never leave the bonfire unattended, while it's lit, and make sure it's completely extinguished before leaving, stirring the ashes and pouring water over them until no embers remain. Remember, prevention is key amid any activity with fire, while the risk is always present if the necessary precautions aren't taken, among other things to prevent fires.

text_es: Setting up an aquarium requires careful planning and consideration of the fish's specific needs. First, we will choose an appropriate tank size based on the available space and the number of fish. Next, the filtration system is crucial, and we must select equipment that combines biological, mechanical, and chemical filtration functions to ensure optimal water quality, which is very important for the fish's well-being. When arranging decorations, we need to avoid any items that could harm the fish and add substrate, rocks, and natural or artificial plants to create a welcoming environment for the fish. The acclimation process for the fish is quite delicate; they will be slowly introduced into the aquarium, and their adaptation to the new environment must be closely observed, while continuously monitoring water temperature and pH during this period. Regular maintenance is indispensable, including routine water changes and cleaning filter media, to ensure all organisms can live healthily and long-term here.
text_tgt_raw: 建立水族箱需要細心規劃，並考量魚隻的特定需求。首先，我們會根據可用的空間與魚隻數量，選擇合適的魚缸尺寸。接著，過濾系統至關重要，我們必須挑選兼具生物、物理及化學過濾功能的設備，以確保水質維持在最佳狀態，這對魚的福祉來說非常重要。在佈置裝飾品時，需避免任何可能傷害魚隻的物品，並添加底砂、岩石及天然或人造水草，為魚兒營造一個溫馨的環境。魚隻的馴化過程相當細膩，牠們將被緩慢地引入水族箱裡，同時必須密切觀察牠們對新環境的適應狀況，並在這段過程中，持續監控水溫與pH值。定期的維護是不可或缺的，包含定期換水及清潔濾材，以確保所有生物都能在這裡健康長久地生活。
base_en: Setting up an aquarium requires careful planning, while considering the specific needs of the fish. 1st, the appropriate tank size is chosen, while thinking about the available space and the number of inhabitants. Then, filtration is crucial; a biological, mechanical, and chemical filter must be selected, while ensuring optimal water quality for the well-being of the species. Among the decorative elements, while avoiding any object that could harm the fish, substrate, rocks, and plants—natural or artificial—are added, creating a welcoming environment. The acclimatization of the fish is a delicate process, while they're slowly introduced into the aquarium, monitoring their adaptation to the new environment and, amid this process, the temperature and pH are controlled. Regular maintenance is essential, while partial water changes are performed periodically and the filter is cleaned, ensuring the longevity and health of all organisms.

text_es: I still remember the excitement I felt the first time I decided to set up an aquarium; it was truly indescribable. At that time, I fully immersed myself in researching various fish and aquatic plants, and carefully planned the decorations I wanted for this small ecosystem. It took me a full three days, browsing articles online and watching videos, with every step meticulously thought out. To be honest, among my friends, I was the only one passionate about this hobby, and when I explained the nitrogen cycle to them, they all looked at me strangely. It was indeed a slow process, but also captivating, especially when the first inhabitants swam freely in the tranquil aquarium in my living room. Watching the guppies explore their new home, and the Anubias growing steadily at the bottom, brought a great sense of accomplishment. And now, as I share all this with you, I can't help but smile, looking forward to setting up my second aquarium.
text_tgt_raw: 我還記得第一次決定要佈置水族箱時，那份興奮的心情真是難以言喻。當時我全心投入研究各種魚類和水草，也仔細規劃著這個小生態系裡我想要的裝飾。足足花了三天，我在網路上爬文、看著影片，每個環節都經過深思熟慮。說實話，身邊的朋友裡，只有我對這項嗜好情有獨鍾，當我為他們解釋著氮循環時，他們都用一種奇特的眼光看著我。這確實是一個緩慢的過程，卻也令人著迷，特別是當第一批居民在我客廳裡靜謐的水族箱中自由自在地悠游時。看著孔雀魚探索著新家，而水榕則安穩地生長在底部，那是一種極大的成就感。而現在，在跟您分享這些的同時，我不禁微笑著，期待著即將著手佈置的第二個水族箱。
base_en: I remember when I decided to set up my 1st aquarium; it was a project that filled me with excitement. I was very excited while researching the different types of fish and plants, while planning the decoration I wanted for that small ecosystem. I spent 3 days reading forums and watching videos, and the choice of each element was very carefully considered. The truth is that, among all my friends, I was the only one with such a hobby, and they looked at me a little strangely, while I explained the nitrogen cycle to them. It was a slow process, yes, but fascinating, especially when, in the midst of the tranquility of my living room, the 1st inhabitants began to swim freely. Seeing the guppies exploring their new home, while the anubias settled at the bottom, was a wonderful reward. And now, as I tell you this, I can't help but smile thinking about the 2nd aquarium I'll be setting up soon.

text_es: To begin setting up an aquarium, the first priority is to carefully plan and research the species you wish to keep. Among the many options on the market, choose an appropriate size, considering both space and budget. The aquarium cycling process is extremely crucial, usually taking three to four weeks for nitrifying bacteria to establish themselves to process fish waste. Place the aquarium in a stable location, away from direct sunlight, and ensure it is level to avoid creating stress. Based on these fundamental elements, don't forget the filter, heater, and lighting equipment, while closely monitoring water quality. In the initial few weeks, you should carefully observe the fish's behavior and familiarize yourself with their specific needs. Never overstock due to momentary enthusiasm, as this will cause stress and health problems for the fish in the aquarium.
text_tgt_raw: 要著手設置水族箱，首要之務是仔細規劃並研究您想飼養的物種。在市面上的眾多選項裡，挑選適合的尺寸，同時考量空間與預算。水族箱的養水過程極為關鍵，通常需時三到四週，讓硝化細菌建立起來，以便處理魚隻排泄物。將水族箱放置於穩固的位置，遠離陽光直射，並確保其水平以避免產生壓力。在這些基本元素為基礎下，別忘了過濾器、加溫棒和照明設備，同時密切注意水質。在最初的幾週裡，應仔細觀察魚隻的行為，並熟悉牠們的特殊需求。切勿因為一時的熱情而造成過度飼養，這會導致水族箱裡的魚隻產生壓力並引發健康問題。
base_en: To begin setting up an aquarium, plan carefully while researching the species you want to keep. Choose the appropriate aquarium size from the options available on the market, while considering space and budget. It's crucial to cycle the aquarium, a process that takes 3 to 4 weeks, while nitrifying bacteria establish themselves to process waste. Place the aquarium in a stable location, away from direct sunlight, while making sure it's level to avoid stress. Among the essential elements, don't forget the filter, heater, and lighting, while keeping an eye on water quality. During the 1st weeks, closely observe the fish's behavior while familiarizing yourself with their specific needs. Avoid overpopulation amid your initial enthusiasm, as this can cause stress and health problems among the aquarium inhabitants.

text_es: I remember that time I changed a flat tire. It was a hot August day, and I was driving on a country road, with sunflower fields on both sides, and the radio was playing music. Suddenly, I felt the car shake, the steering wheel vibrated violently, and the car started to drift out of its lane. I got out and, sure enough, the front tire was completely flat. I couldn't help but sigh. I held the owner's manual, and in this place with no towns nearby, I was sweating profusely as I looked for the spare tire and tools. In the high temperature, and with the bolts difficult to loosen, it was truly a big job. Fortunately, after thirty minutes, I finally succeeded in putting on the spare tire, and I felt a great sense of accomplishment.
text_tgt_raw: 記得那一次換爆胎的經驗，那是一個炎熱的八月天，我開著車行駛在鄉間小路上，兩旁盡是向日葵花田，車裡收音機正播放著音樂。突然，我感覺到車子一陣晃動，方向盤也跟著劇烈震動起來，車子開始偏離車道。下車一看，果不其然，前輪完全洩氣了，當下不禁嘆了一口氣。我拿著車主手冊，在這前不著村後不著店的地方，滿頭大汗地找著備胎和工具。在高溫的環境裡，加上螺栓難以鬆開，這真是個大工程。所幸，費時三十分鐘後，我終於成功換上備胎，心裡有著滿滿的成就感。
base_en: I remember the time I had to change a flat tire. It was a hot August day, and I was driving on a secondary road, among sunflower fields, while listening to the radio. Suddenly, I felt a jolt and the car started to swerve, while the steering wheel vibrated strongly. When I got out, I saw the front tire completely flat, and a sigh escaped my mouth. With the manual in hand, and in the middle of nowhere, I started looking for the spare tire and tools, while sweat ran down my forehead. It was a quite complicated task, between the suffocating heat and the difficulty of loosening the bolts. Finally, after 30 minutes of effort, I managed to change it, while feeling great satisfaction.

text_es: When changing a flat tire, safety is absolutely the top priority. If you have support, park your vehicle in a quiet place away from traffic and wait for assistance there. If not, you need to find a flat and solid surface, and engage the handbrake even if you're on the side of the road. Next, put on a reflective vest and place emergency cones at an appropriate distance before you start changing the tire. Before jacking up the vehicle, be sure to slightly loosen the lug nuts with a wrench while the tire is still on the ground. After the vehicle is raised, completely remove the lug nuts and take off the flat tire, remembering not to leave it in the middle of the road. After installing the spare tire, tighten the lug nuts, then lower the vehicle, and finally thoroughly tighten all the lug nuts. Afterward, you should have the flat tire repaired as soon as possible, or book roadside assistance online to seek professional help, so you won't be caught unprepared next time you need it.
text_tgt_raw: 更換爆胎時，安全絕對是首要考量。若有支援，請將車輛停在遠離車流的安靜地方，在那裡等候救援。若無，則需找尋平坦堅固的路面，即使在車道旁也要將手煞車拉起。接著，請穿上反光背心並在適當距離處擺放緊急三角錐，然後才開始換胎。在用千斤頂頂起車輛前，務必先用板手稍微鬆開螺帽，此時輪胎仍應著地。待車身升高後，再完全卸下螺帽並取下爆胎，記得別將它留在路中央。裝上備胎後，先將螺帽鎖緊，然後放下車身，最後再將所有螺帽徹底鎖牢。事後應盡快將爆胎送去修補，或透過網路預約道路救援，尋求專業協助，免得下次需要時手忙腳亂。
base_en: When changing a flat tire, safety is 1st. Park the car in a safe place, away from traffic, while you wait for assistance, if you've it. If not, find flat, firm ground, among the lanes if you can, and set the parking brake. Put on the reflective vest and emergency triangles at an adequate distance, while you proceed with the change. Loosen the lug nuts a little with the lug wrench before lifting the car with the jack, while the wheel is still touching the ground. Once lifted, remove the lug nuts completely and take off the flat tire, while you make sure not to leave it in the middle of the road. Put on the spare tire, tighten the lug nuts, lower the car, and, finally, tighten them fully; then, take the flat tire to be repaired as soon as possible.

text_es: A well-planned museum visit with children can be a rich and educational experience. To achieve this, we should choose museums with interactive exhibits and avoid overwhelming children with too much information. It's recommended to introduce what they will see before going and spark their curiosity by asking about things that interest them. During the visit, it's best to schedule frequent breaks between galleries to allow them to relax and process what they've seen and heard; we can also use these breaks to play games like finding colors or shapes among the exhibits. This way, children will remain engaged and learn through play. The key here is to maintain a flexible pace in such a vast cultural environment, enjoy the fun of parent-child co-learning, and avoid putting too much pressure on them.
text_tgt_raw: 帶孩子參觀博物館若能妥善規劃，將會是一次寓教於樂的豐富體驗。為此，我們應選擇設有互動式展覽的博物館，並避免讓孩子們面對過多的資訊而感到不知所措。建議在出發前，先向孩子們介紹將會看到什麼，並透過提問他們感興趣的事物來激發好奇心。在參觀過程中，最好能在各展廳之間安排頻繁的休息時間，讓他們得以放鬆，並消化所見所聞；我們也能趁著這些空檔，在展品陳列處玩找尋顏色或形狀的遊戲。如此一來，孩子們會持續保持投入，在遊戲裡學習。這裡的重點是，在如此廣闊的文化環境裡，我們必須保持彈性的步調，享受親子共學的樂趣，避免給予他們過多的壓力。
base_en: Visiting a museum with children can be an enriching and fun experience if planned properly. It's essential to choose museums with interactive exhibits, while avoiding information overload that could overwhelm them. It's recommended to prepare the visit in advance, explaining to the little ones what they'll see, while fostering their curiosity with questions about what interests them. During the tour, it's helpful to establish frequent breaks between rooms so they can rest and process what they've seen. We can take advantage of this to play games like identifying colors or shapes, while walking among the collections. This way, children will remain engaged, while learning in a playful way. It's essential to maintain a flexible pace, while enjoying family learning, without excessive pressure amid such a vast cultural environment.

text_es: Last Saturday, I took my two children to the National Museum of Natural Science, and every time I go there, I feel a mix of emotions. I thought about how much fun they would have, while also imagining myself strolling alone through the quiet exhibits. Upon arrival, my six-year-old daughter's excitement was evident, while my ten-year-old son was already among the crowd gathered at the entrance, looking for the dinosaur exhibit. I tried to explain the models to them, but they just ran around, exclaiming in awe at the giant skeletons, their shouts echoing throughout the exhibition hall. It was then that I realized that while I was trying to understand scientific knowledge, they simply wanted to touch everything, and that childlike curiosity, after all, is the true driving force of learning.
text_tgt_raw: 上週六，我帶著兩個孩子前往國立自然科學博物館，每次去那裡總讓我有種百感交集的心情。我一邊想著他們會玩得有多開心，一邊又想像著自己能獨自漫步在展品間的寧靜。一抵達，六歲女兒的興奮之情溢於言表，而十歲的兒子則已在入口處聚集的人群裡，尋找著恐龍展間。我試著向他們解釋那些模型，然而他們卻只顧著跑來跑去，對著巨大的骨骼發出驚嘆的叫聲，迴盪在整個展覽室裡。我這才發現，當我試圖理解科學知識時，他們只是單純地想觸摸所有東西，那份孩子般的好奇心，終究才是學習的真正動力。
base_en: Last Saturday, I decided to take my 2 children to the National Museum of Natural Sciences, an experience that always gives me mixed feelings. I was thinking about how fun it would be for them, while I imagined the tranquility of walking alone among the exhibits. Upon arrival, my 6-year-old daughter's excitement was palpable, while my 10-year-old son was already looking for the dinosaur room, amid the crowd that was gathering at the entrance. I tried to explain the models to them, while they ran from one side to the other, marveling at the giant skeletons, amid shouts of amazement that echoed in the room. I realized that, while I was trying to understand the science, they just wanted to touch everything, amid the childlike curiosity that's, after all, the true engine of learning.

text_es: Visiting a museum with three children requires crucial preparation. While researching the exhibition content, pre-selecting three to four impressive pieces helps maintain the children's interest. Before arriving, consider weaving the tour into stories and anecdotes, making the visit an adventure rather than an obligation. When the children are in the museum, encourage them to interact through open-ended questions, avoid lengthy lectures, and allow them to explore at their own pace, even if it means seeing fewer exhibits. Faced with so much art, timely breaks for snacks or drinks are essential for them to process the information they've seen. If the visit is kept to about one or two hours, it will be more effective than a four-hour ordeal, as children have limited attention spans and adults can also lose patience. After the visit, plan follow-up activities, letting them talk about their favorite parts to solidify the experience.
text_tgt_raw: 帶著三個孩子參觀博物館，事前準備著實為關鍵。在研究展覽內容的同時，預先挑選三到四件精彩作品，有助於維持孩子們的興趣。抵達前，不妨將導覽融入故事和奇聞軼事裡，讓參觀成為一場冒險，而非義務。孩子們在館裡時，鼓勵他們透過開放式問題互動，避免冗長的說教，並允許他們按照自己的步調探索，即使這表示會少看一些展品。面對著那麼多藝術品，適時的小憩，享用點心或飲料，對於他們消化所見資料是不可或缺的。若參觀時間控制在約一、兩個小時，將會比四小時的疲憊來得更有效益，畢竟孩子們的注意力有限，而大人也可能失去耐心。參觀後，再規劃後續活動，讓他們談論自己最喜歡的部分，以鞏固這次的體驗。
base_en: For a successful museum visit with 3 children, preparation is key: while researching the exhibition, pre-select 3 or 4 standout pieces to maintain interest. Explain what they'll see before arriving, amid stories and curiosities, so the tour is an adventure, not an obligation. While they're there, encourage interaction with open-ended questions; avoid long speeches and allow them to explore at their own pace, even if this means seeing less. Amid so much art, a small break for a snack or a drink is essential, while they assimilate what they've seen. If the visit lasts 1 or 2 hours, it will be more productive than 4 hours of exhaustion, as children lose attention and adults lose patience. Plan subsequent activities, while they talk about their favorite parts, to consolidate the experience.

text_es: Organizing a closet is an important process for maintaining home tidiness and functionality, while also optimizing usable space. This requires emptying everything from the closet and carefully categorizing clothes and other items into "keep," "donate," or "discard," with each piece of clothing needing careful consideration. It's important to evaluate what we truly use and what we don't need, to avoid accumulating unnecessary items on shelves and in drawers. Next, we must thoroughly clean the inside of the closet while considering various storage solutions, such as appropriate hangers, storage boxes, or dividers. Logically categorizing clothes, for example by type or season, makes them easier to find in daily life. A well-organized closet not only saves time when getting dressed but also extends the lifespan of clothes, while also bringing us a more peaceful living environment.
text_tgt_raw: 整理衣櫥是維持居家整潔與機能性，並同時最佳化可用空間的重要過程。這需要將衣櫥裡所有物品清空，並將衣物及其他物品仔細分類為「保留」、「捐贈」或「丟棄」，每一件衣物都得好好審視。重要的是評估哪些是我們真正用得著的，哪些又是不需要的，以避免在層架和抽屜裡堆積不必要的物品。接著，我們必須徹底清潔衣櫥內部，同時思考各種收納方案，像是合適的衣架、收納盒或分隔板。將衣物有邏輯地分門別類，例如依類型或季節擺放，能讓它們在日常生活中更容易被找到。一個井然有序的衣櫥不僅能省下打扮的時間，還能延長衣物的壽命，同時也為我們帶來更寧靜的生活環境。
base_en: Organizing the closet is an essential process for maintaining order and functionality in our home, while optimizing the available space. It involves completely emptying the closet, classifying clothes and other items into categories such as "keep," "donate," or "discard," while carefully reviewing each garment. It's crucial to evaluate which items we actually use and which we don't, to avoid accumulating unnecessary things among the shelves and drawers. Then, we proceed to thoroughly clean the inside of the closet, while thinking about storage solutions like appropriate hangers, boxes, or dividers. Distributing clothes logically, grouping them by type or season, will make them easier to find amid the daily routine. A well-organized closet not only saves time when getting dressed, but also extends the useful life of our garments, while we maintain a more serene environment.

text_es: I always procrastinate organizing my closet; it always seems like a huge undertaking for me, yet my clothes keep growing. Yesterday, I finally decided to face it, with 80s music playing in the background. I spent three hours folding shirts, hanging pants, and putting away sweaters, watching the initial chaos gradually transform into order. This was undoubtedly a challenge, and my frustration grew with the clothes that no longer fit and the items I kept purely for sentimental reasons. I realized that during my organizing process, there were some clothes I had completely forgotten about, and now they looked like new. Now, when I open my closet door, I enjoy the neat and orderly sight before me; it's a personal achievement in a chaotic life. I know the struggle against clutter is ongoing, but at least for now, my closet is perfect.
text_tgt_raw: 我總是拖延整理衣櫃，這對我來說似乎是件浩大的工程，然而衣服卻不斷地增長著。昨天，我終於下定決心面對它，背景裡播放著80年代的音樂。我花了三個小時摺疊襯衫、掛起褲子，並放置毛衣，看著最初的混亂逐漸轉變為秩序。這無疑是個挑戰，在那些已經不合身的衣服以及純粹因為情感而留著的衣物之間，我的挫折感也隨之增加。我意識到，在我整理的過程中，有些衣服我已經完全忘記了，現在看來卻像新的一樣。如今，當我打開衣櫃門時，我享受著眼前井然有序的景象，這是混亂生活裡的一項個人成就。我知道與雜亂的抗爭是持續不斷的，但至少現在，我的衣櫃堪稱完美。
base_en: I always put off organizing my closet, a task that seems monumental to me, while I accumulate more and more clothes. Yesterday, I finally decided to face it, while 80s music played in the background. I spent 3 hours folding shirts, hanging pants, and placing sweaters, while the initial chaos slowly transformed into order. It was a challenge, among clothes that no longer fit me and garments I kept purely for sentimental reasons, amid growing frustration. I realized that, while I was tidying up, I had completely forgotten some pieces that now looked new. Now, as I open the doors, I enjoy the organized view, a personal achievement amid my chaotic life. I know the battle for order is constant, but at least for now, my closet is impeccable.

text_es: To effectively organize your closet, first empty all the clothes from it, and examine each item one by one during the process. This is an excellent time to discard clothes you no longer wear or that are damaged, and to consider when you last wore them. Once the closet is empty, thoroughly clean the interior, including shelves and drawers, and simultaneously plan your ideal storage arrangement. Next, group your clothes by category, such as T-shirts, pants, etc., while also finding the most suitable storage solutions, like appropriate hangers or storage bins. Frequently worn clothes should be placed in prominent and easily accessible locations, while seasonal clothing can be stored in less frequently used spots. During this process, don't hesitate to readjust several times to find the organizing system that best suits your daily habits.
text_tgt_raw: 想要有效整理衣櫃，首先應將裡頭所有衣物清空，並在過程中逐一審視每件單品。這是一個絕佳的時機，可以丟棄那些不再穿著或已損壞的衣物，同時思考上一次穿著它們是何時。一旦衣櫃空了，請徹底清潔內部，包含層板與抽屜，並同時構思理想的收納規劃。接著，將衣物依照類別分組，例如T恤、褲子等，同時尋找最適合的收納解決方案，像是合適的衣架或整理箱。經常穿著的衣物應擺放在顯眼且容易拿取的地方，而季節性服飾則可儲存於較不常用到的位置。在這個過程中，請不要猶豫重新調整數次，以找出最符合您日常習慣的整理系統。
base_en: To effectively organize your closet, start by emptying it completely, while reviewing each garment. It's a good time to discard what you don't use or what's damaged, while asking yourself when you last wore it. Once empty, thoroughly clean the interior, including shelves and drawers, while thinking about the ideal layout. Group clothes by categories—T-shirts, pants, etc.—while looking for the best storage solutions, such as appropriate hangers or organizing boxes. Keep the most frequently used garments in plain sight and easily accessible, while seasonal items can be stored in less prioritized places. Amid this process, don't hesitate to reorganize things several times, while finding the system that best suits your daily life, among all possible options.

text_es: Canning tomatoes is a traditional preservation method that fully retains their flavor and nutrients for later use. This process typically involves peeling and seeding the tomatoes, then adding salt or various seasonings, and finally cooking them. The cooked tomatoes are then placed into sterilized glass jars and sealed to ensure air is excluded. Creating a vacuum environment through a water bath or pressure sterilization is an indispensable step in this technique, as it effectively prevents microbial growth. This way, we can enjoy delicious off-season tomatoes during the cold winter months. Furthermore, making them yourself allows complete control over the ingredients, avoiding the extra artificial additives and preservatives often found in commercially available products. There are many benefits to this, which is truly reassuring.
text_tgt_raw: 製作罐裝番茄是一種傳統的保存方式，能將其風味與營養完整保留，以備日後使用。這項製程通常會將番茄去皮去籽後，加入鹽巴或各式調味，接著烹煮。煮好的番茄會被裝進經過消毒的玻璃罐裡，並進行密封，以確保排除空氣。透過水浴法或高壓滅菌的方式來創造真空環境，這能有效防止微生物滋生，是這項技術裡不可或缺的一步。如此一來，我們便能在寒冷的冬季裡，享受非當季的美味番茄。此外，自己動手做也能完全掌控食材，避免市售產品中常常會有的額外人工添加物與防腐劑，這裡面的好處多多，著實令人安心。
base_en: Making canned tomatoes is a traditional technique for preserving the fruit, while maintaining its flavor and nutrients for later use. This process involves cooking the tomatoes—generally peeled and deseeded—while adding salt and, sometimes, other seasonings. The mixture is packed into sterilized glass jars, which are then hermetically sealed, while ensuring the elimination of air. A water bath or autoclave process is essential to create a vacuum, while preventing the proliferation of microorganisms. Among the benefits is the possibility of enjoying seasonal tomatoes throughout the year, amid winter scarcity. In addition, it allows total control over the ingredients, while avoiding artificial additives and preservatives present in industrial products.

text_es: Every September, canning tomatoes is a family tradition for us. I clearly remember processing fifteen kilograms of tomatoes; my eighty-year-old grandmother, full of energy, led everyone like an orchestra conductor, while my mom and I helped peel the tomatoes. The air was filled with the scent of fresh basil, steam fogged up the windows, and outside, the chill of autumn could already be felt. Amidst laughter and family anecdotes, time flew by, and eventually, we had batches of glass jars filled with "red gold." These weren't some online videos, but the results of our own hands. We gave many of them to our neighbors and friends, and saved the rest for winter to enjoy later. Honestly, whenever I'm busy with these things, I always feel incredibly grateful for these moments.
text_tgt_raw: 每年九月，將番茄製成罐頭是我們家的傳統。我清楚記得我們曾處理過十五公斤的番茄；八十歲的奶奶精神充沛，像是交響樂團指揮般帶領著大家，而媽媽和我在一旁幫忙剝番茄皮。那裡瀰漫著新鮮羅勒的香氣，蒸氣讓窗戶都起了霧，窗外則已能感受到秋天的涼意。在歡聲笑語與家庭軼事中，時間飛快地流逝，最終我們得到了一批批滿載著「紅色黃金」的玻璃罐。這些可不是什麼網路上的影片，而是我們親手製作的成果。我們將其中許多分送給左鄰右舍和朋友們，剩下的則為冬天儲備著，以便日後享用。說真的，每當我為這些事忙碌著，總會為這些時刻感到無比感恩。
base_en: Every September, canning tomatoes is a tradition in my family. I fondly remember the time we prepared 15 kg of tomatoes; my grandmother, 80 years old and with inexhaustible energy, was the orchestra conductor, while my mother and I helped her peel the tomatoes. The aroma of fresh basil filled the entire kitchen, and the steam fogged up the windows, while outside the autumn chill was already noticeable. Amid laughter and family anecdotes, the hours flew by, and the result was a treasure of glass jars full of red gold. We distributed many among neighbors and friends, while we saved the rest to enjoy during the winter. The truth is that, while one works, it's impossible not to feel grateful for those moments.

text_es: Learning photography is like immersing oneself in a captivating art form that blends technology and creativity, opening up new perspectives on how we see the world. Many people embark on this journey initially to capture precious moments, while others focus on the artistic expression it can offer. To master photography, beyond basic camera operation and understanding exposure principles like aperture, shutter speed, and ISO, many fundamental concepts are crucial. While theoretical knowledge is important, continuous practice is key to developing a personal style and keen observation skills. Whether through online tutorials or professional courses, abundant learning resources are readily available, allowing everyone to continuously improve their photography skills even in their busy daily lives. Photography is an ever-evolving discipline, and with the emergence of new technologies and trends, there is always something new to learn. This learning enables us to transform ordinary things into extraordinary ones, opening up a universe full of endless possibilities.
text_tgt_raw: 學習攝影就像沉浸在一門迷人的藝術裡，它融合了技術與創意，為我們開啟了看待世界的新視角。許多人剛開始踏上這趟旅程，是為了捕捉那些珍貴的瞬間，而另外一些人則著重於其所能提供的藝術表現。要精通攝影，除了相機的基本操作，理解光圈、快門速度和ISO等曝光原理，還有許多基本概念是至關重要的。雖然理論知識很重要，但不斷地實踐才是發展個人風格和敏銳觀察力的關鍵。無論在網路上的教學影片，或是專業課程裡，處處都能找到豐富的學習資源，這讓大家即使在繁忙的日常生活中，也能不斷提升攝影技巧。攝影是一門不斷演進的學科，隨著新科技與趨勢的出現，總有新的事物值得學習。這項學習能讓我們將尋常事物轉變為不凡，為我們開創一個充滿無限可能性的宇宙。
base_en: Learning photography is immersing oneself in a fascinating art that combines technique and creativity, offering a new perspective of the world. Many people start this journey looking to capture special moments, while others are interested in the artistic expression this medium offers. It's essential to understand the basic principles of exposure—aperture, shutter speed, and ISO—among other essential concepts to master the camera. While theoretical knowledge is acquired, constant practice is key to developing one's own style and a keen eye. Numerous resources can be found, from online tutorials to specialized courses, that facilitate learning and skill improvement, even amid the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Photography is a discipline that continuously evolves, while new technologies and trends emerge. This learning allows one to transform the ordinary into the extraordinary, opening up a universe of possibilities.

text_es: My adventurous journey into photography began three years ago when I was looking for a new hobby to escape my monotonous life. I still remember the excitement I felt when I got my first DSLR, a Canon EOS 2000D, and the bewilderment of facing its numerous buttons and settings. At that time, with the last rays of the setting sun streaming through the window, I spent hours trying to understand the relationship between aperture, shutter speed, and ISO; the learning curve was very steep, there were countless YouTube tutorial videos online, and the manual read like a foreign language. As time went on, even though my friends gradually lost patience when we went out, I started to see the world from a different perspective, looking for compositions and playing with light and shadow. Now, I really enjoy the pleasure of editing photos with software during my busy daily life, capturing a moment, and transforming ordinary scenes into fantastical works.
text_tgt_raw: 我接觸攝影的冒險之旅始於三年前，當時我正尋找一項新的嗜好來擺脫一成不變的生活。我還記得第一台單眼相機 Canon EOS 2000D 帶給我的興奮感，以及面對繁多按鈕和設定時的不知所措。那時，夕陽餘暉灑落窗邊，我花了好幾個小時摸索光圈、快門速度和 ISO 之間的關係；學習曲線十分陡峭，網路上有著無數的 YouTube 影片教學，說明書讀起來也像天書一樣。隨著時間過去，儘管朋友們在我們出遊時漸漸失去耐心，我卻開始以不同的視角看待這個世界，尋找構圖並玩轉光影。現在，我非常享受在日常忙碌中，透過軟體編輯照片，將一個瞬間捕捉下來，並把平凡的場景轉化為奇幻作品的樂趣。
base_en: My adventure in learning photography began 3 years ago, while I was looking for a new hobby to get me out of my routine.
