I remember the excitement of my 1st DSLR camera, a Canon EOS 2000D, and how overwhelmed I felt among the countless buttons and settings. I spent hours, while the sunset light streamed through my window, trying to understand the relationship between aperture, shutter speed, and ISO; the learning curve was steep, amid YouTube tutorials and manuals that seemed written in another language. Over time, and while my friends grew impatient during our outings, I began to see the world in a different way, looking for compositions and playing with light. Now I greatly enjoy, while editing my photos, the possibility of capturing an instant and transforming an ordinary scene into something magical, amid the daily hustle and bustle.

text_es: To learn photography, you should first start by understanding the basic principles and getting familiar with your equipment. Daily practice is crucial; only by continuously trying different lighting and compositions can you develop a unique artistic eye. Don't be afraid to make mistakes, because true learning often accumulates within those errors. You might consider enrolling in high-quality courses or workshops, and also appreciate the work of other photographers to draw inspiration, as there are all sorts of styles out there. When facing technical challenges, patience is indispensable, because mastering photography takes time. Enjoy the process, capture unique moments in daily life, and don't forget that post-processing software also plays a pivotal role in the entire photography workflow, just like taking a bus or a taxi, both of which are indispensable parts of reaching your destination.
text_tgt_raw: 學習攝影，首先應從理解基礎原理著手，並熟悉自己手裡的器材。每天練習至關重要，透過不斷嘗試不同的光線和構圖，才能培養出獨特的藝術眼光。別害怕犯錯，因為真正的學習往往就是在這些錯誤裡累積的。您可以考慮報名參加優質的課程或工作坊，同時也要多欣賞其他攝影師的作品，從中汲取靈感，畢竟那裡有著各式各樣的風格。面對技術挑戰時，耐心是不可或缺的，因為精通攝影需要時間。享受這個過程，捕捉日常生活裡獨特的瞬間，並且別忘了後製軟體在整個攝影流程中也佔有舉足輕重的地位，如同搭乘公車或計程車般，都是為達目的地所不可或缺的一部分。
base_en: To learn photography, start by understanding the basic fundamentals while exploring your equipment. It's crucial to practice every day while experimenting with different types of light and compositions to develop your artistic eye. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; in fact, it's through trial and error that you learn the most. Invest in a good course or workshop while seeking inspiration in the work of other photographers, among whom you'll find very varied styles. Patience is key, especially amid technical challenges, as mastering photography takes time. Enjoy the process while capturing unique moments amid your everyday surroundings, and don't forget the importance of editing as an integral part.

text_es: As cats age, we need to provide them with special care to help them adapt to the aging process. It's crucial to take them for regular veterinary check-ups at least once or twice a year to detect any health issues early. At the same time, we also need to adjust their diet to prevent obesity and support kidney function. Among many considerations, providing them with a calm and safe environment, ensuring food, water, and litter boxes are easily accessible, and trying to avoid sudden changes in the home that could stress them are important. It's mentioned here that we should pay special attention to their behavior, and any signs of pain or discomfort should be evaluated promptly. Maintaining a stable daily routine and giving them continuous love are indispensable, including gentle petting and playtime adjusted to their energy levels, allowing them to live out their final years with dignity and comfort. Especially when facing the challenges that age can bring, patience is key.
text_tgt_raw: 隨著貓咪年歲增長，我們需要為牠們提供特別的照護，讓牠們能適應老化的過程。每年至少帶牠們進行一到兩次的定期獸醫檢查至關重要，以便及早發現任何健康問題。同時，我們也要調整牠們的飲食，避免肥胖並支持腎臟功能。在眾多考量裡，提供牠們一個平靜且安全的環境，確保食物、飲水和貓砂盆都容易取得，並盡量避免家中突如其來的變動造成牠們的壓力。這裡提到要特別留意牠們的行為，任何疼痛或不適的跡象都應迅速評估。維持穩定的日常生活作息，並給予牠們持續的關愛是不可或缺的，包含溫柔的撫摸和根據牠們精力調整的玩耍時間，讓牠們能有尊嚴且舒適地度過最後的歲月。特別是面對年齡可能帶來的挑戰，耐心為關鍵。
base_en: Caring for an older cat involves special attention, while they adapt to the changes of age. It's crucial to make regular veterinary visits, at least 1 or 2 times a year, to detect any health problems early, while also adjusting their diet to meet their specific needs, avoiding obesity and supporting kidney function. Among other considerations, it's essential to provide them with a calm and safe environment, with easy access to their food, water, and litter box, while avoiding stress amid sudden changes in the home. You also have to pay attention to their behavior, while any sign of pain or discomfort should be evaluated quickly. Stable routines should be maintained, and constant affection is vital, including gentle petting and playtime adapted to their energy, while they enjoy their last years with dignity and comfort. Patience is key, especially amid the challenges that may arise with age.

text_es: Taking care of my sixteen-year-old cat, Lola, always fills my heart with tenderness, watching time fly by and seeing the marks it has left on her. Every day I am surprised by her vitality, yet sometimes I also find her sound asleep in the sofa cushions. I still remember how she used to run around the house when she was young, and now, I accompany her on walks in the garden, watching her explore everything around her with astonishing calmness. Sometimes, she gazes at me in the quiet atmosphere of the house, her wise eyes seeming to want to tell me something. Whenever Lola gently approaches my bedside in the early morning light, purring, I can feel that unbreakable bond between humans and pets.
text_tgt_raw: 照顧我十六歲的老貓蘿拉，總讓我心中充滿溫柔，看著時光飛逝，歲月在她身上留下了痕跡。每天我都會為她的活力感到驚訝，有時卻也發現她正熟睡在沙發的軟墊裡。我仍記得她年輕時在家裡跑來跑去的模樣，而現在，我則陪伴著她在花園裡散步，看著她以令人讚嘆的平靜探索著周遭的一切。有時候，她會在屋裡靜謐的氛圍中凝視著我，那雙睿智的雙眼彷彿想對我說些什麼。每當蘿拉在清晨微光中，輕柔地靠近我的床邊，發出咕嚕咕嚕的聲音時，我便能感受到人與寵物之間那份牢不可破的連結。
base_en: Caring for my cat Lola, who is already 16 years old, is an experience that fills me with tenderness, while I watch how time has flown by. Every day I'm surprised by her energy, while other times I find her sleeping soundly among the sofa cushions. I remember her youth, when she ran all over the house; now, I accompany her on her short walks in the garden, while she explores with admirable calm. There are days when she stares at me, amid the silence of the house, as if trying to tell me something with those old, wise eyes, in the middle of the tranquility. While Lola approaches my bed in the mornings, purring, amid the dim light, I feel an unbreakable connection that only the coexistence between a human and their pet can forge.

text_es: Caring for elderly cats requires owners to put in more patience and careful observation, as their needs will change with age. First, it is essential to provide them with food specifically designed for senior cats; this type of soft food is not only easy to digest but also maintains kidney health, and overfeeding should be avoided to prevent obesity. Owners should pay special attention to any changes in their behavior, appetite, or even elimination habits, as these are important signals of potential health problems. Additionally, veterinary check-ups at least once a year, or even every six months, are crucial for early disease detection. To give cats a peaceful old age, owners should create a calm and safe environment in the home, ensuring they can easily access food, water, and the litter box. At the same time, prepare a comfortable resting area for them so they can enjoy tranquility in this warm home. When it comes to playtime, it should be done gently, and the intensity adjusted according to their physical condition, allowing them to enjoy appropriate play in the digital age. Finally, don't forget to spend time with them regularly, providing love and mental stimulation, so they feel loved.
text_tgt_raw: 照顧年邁的貓咪，需要飼主付出更多的耐心與細心觀察，因為牠們的需求會隨著年齡增長而有所不同。首先，務必為牠們提供專為老年貓設計的飲食，這類軟體食物不僅易於消化，更能維護腎臟健康，同時也要避免過度餵食導致肥胖。飼主應特別留意牠們行為、食慾，甚至排泄習慣上的任何改變，因為這些都是潛在健康問題的重要訊號。此外，每年至少一次，甚至每六個月一次的獸醫檢查，對於早期發現疾病至關重要。為了給予貓咪一個安穩的晚年，飼主應在住家裡創造一個平靜且安全的環境，確保牠能輕鬆取得食物、飲水與貓砂盆。同時，為牠準備一個舒適的休息區域，讓牠能在這充滿著溫馨的家裡享受寧靜。在玩耍方面，應以溫和的方式進行，並根據牠的體力調整強度，讓牠在網路時代也能享受到適切的遊戲樂趣。最後，別忘了定時陪伴，提供關愛與心智刺激，讓牠感受到被愛。
base_en: Caring for an older cat requires patience and careful observation, while its needs change with age. Make sure to offer it a specific diet for senior cats, one that's easy to digest and contributes to its kidney health, while avoiding excesses that could lead to obesity. Pay special attention to any change in its behavior or appetite, among other signs of possible health problems, while an annual veterinary check-up—or even every 6 months—is crucial for detecting diseases early. Create a calm and safe environment for it, facilitating access to its food, water, and litter box, while offering it a comfortable place to rest amid the tranquility of your home. Play gently with it, while adapting the intensity to its energy level, among the various activities it can still enjoy. Don't forget the importance of affection and mental stimulation, while dedicating quality time to it.

text_es: Last year, to surprise Grandma for her 80th birthday, we decided to host a family picnic in the densest woods of Central Park while she was on vacation. I was in charge of preparing the food, my sister planned various games, and my cousin arranged the drinks. It was a delightful chaos, with everyone laughing and quietly arguing about which sandwiches to bring. I remember Mom was busy making a cake, and Dad was trying hard to inflate twenty balloons; we were all in a flurry, almost dropping the dishes. Everyone here contributed their efforts, searching for recipes online or using software to edit party videos. Finally, when Grandma arrived there by taxi, we were all set, and the air was filled with a palpable sense of anticipation.
text_tgt_raw: 去年，為了給奶奶八十大壽一個驚喜，我們趁她度假時，決定在中央公園裡最茂密的樹林間舉辦一場家庭野餐。我負責準備食物，姊姊則籌劃著各種遊戲，表弟則張羅飲品。那真是一團愉快的混亂，大家邊笑邊為要帶哪些三明治而小聲爭執著。我記得，那時媽媽忙著做蛋糕，爸爸則努力想充飽二十顆氣球，我們大家手忙腳亂，差點把碗盤都給摔了。這裡的每個人都貢獻著自己的力量，透過網路搜尋食譜，或用軟體編輯派對影片。最後，當奶奶搭著計程車抵達那裡時，我們已經萬事俱備，現場洋溢著可以被感受到的期待氣氛。
base_en: Last year, we decided to prepare a surprise picnic for my grandmother on her 80th birthday, while she was on vacation. The idea was to gather the whole family in the central park, among the leafiest trees. I was in charge of the food, while my sister organized the games and my cousin, the drinks. It was a fun chaos, amid laughter and small disputes about which sandwiches to bring. I remember that, while my mother was preparing the cake, my father was trying to inflate 20 balloons and, among all of us, we almost dropped the dishes. Finally, while my grandmother was arriving at the place, we already had everything ready, amid palpable anticipation.
